name: 1980s Culture and Society
description: Compiled from archives of zines, newspapers and ephemera to oral histories, films and photographs from across the United States, United Kingdom, Australia, and Canada. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer .

Accessibility statement for ProQuest .

name: AES E-Library

name: Africa and the New Imperialism

name: Africa Bibliography
description: The online version of Africa Bibliography is an authoritative guide to works in African studies published under the auspices of the International African Institute annually since 1984.

name: Africa Commons
types: Full-text resource; Grey literature; Primary Sources; Video streaming
description: This collections consists of five modules: African History and Culture ; Black South African Magazines ; Southern African Films and Documentaries ;  East African Magazines, Newspapers, and Films: The Hilary Ng’weno Archive ;  West African Magazines

name: African American Communities
description: Focusing predominantly on Atlanta, Chicago, New York, and towns and cities in North Carolina this resource presents multiple aspects of the African American community through pamphlets, newspapers and periodicals, correspondence, official records, reports and in-depth oral histories, revealing the prevalent challenges of racism, discrimination and integration, and a unique African American culture and identity. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer .

name: African American Music Reference
alternate_names: Music Online: African American Music Reference
description: Chronicling the diverse history and culture of the African American experience through music, this database contains the full text from major reference works, biographies, and personal narratives from oral histories. Accessibility statement for African American Music Reference .

name: African American Newspapers, Series 1: 1827-1998

name: African American Newspapers, Series 2: 1835-1956
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources

name: African Diaspora, 1860-Present

description: After the abolition of slavery, African diasporic communities formed throughout the world. Accessibility statement for African Diaspora, 1860-Present .

name: African Journals Online

name: African Newspapers: The British Library Collection

description: This collection, originally archived by the British Library, features nearly 60 newspapers from across the African continent, all published before 1900.

name: Age of Exploration

name: Aging in the Modern World

alternate_names: Global Issues : Aging in the Modern World
description: Exploring global aging complexities, diverse cultural perspectives, personal narratives, and scholarly insights from 1900 to 2020. This collection features coverage of government approaches, societal attitudes, and key themes, to provide understanding and address the challenges and opportunities associated with an aging population. Accessibility statement for Alexander Street.

name: Agriculture Science Database (ProQuest)

name: AI translation and language tools (European Commission)

name: Akhbar Filastin Digital Archive, 1963-1967

name: Al-Ahram Digital Archive, 1876-2024

description: Founded in 1875, Al-Ahram (الأهرام‎, “The Pyramids”) is one of the longest-running newspapers in the Middle East. It is one of Egypt’s most authoritative and influential newspapers, and one of the most important newspapers in the Arab world, with a circulation of over 1 million

name: Almanach in Wirtschafts-Compass (previously known as ZEDHIA)
description: The Almanach  features digitalized full text about the history of Central Europe’s business, economy and genealogy. name: Alpha Vantage Open-Access Stock API

Technical support is available to UCL members via support@alphavantage.co.

name: Alternative Press Index (1991-) & Alternative Press Index Archive (1969-1990)

name: Altmetric
description: Altmetric is a tool for measuring the impact and engagement of research beyond traditional citations, indexing sources such as social media (eg twitter, blogs), news publications, and grey literature (eg policy documents).

name: AM Explorer
description: Access millions of pages of primary source collections across the entire portfolio of AM, spanning content from the 15th-21st centuries. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer .

name: Amateur Newspapers from the American Antiquarian Society
description: Cross-search with other Gale/Cengage primary sources in Gale Primary Sources . Published primarily by young people, aged 12-20, during the second half of the 19th century, this archive features tens of thousands of issues, and includes editorials, original short fiction, essays, poetry, and more from over 3,300 amateur newspaper titles. Accessibility statement for Amateur Newspapers from the American Antiquarian Society .

name: AMED (Allied and Complementary Medicine)
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to Ovid . This database can be accessed by no more than 4 users at a time. Contains references to articles on allied and alternative medicine. Many of the journals covered are not indexed by any other biomedical sources.

name: America in World War Two: Oral Histories and Personal Accounts

name: America: History and Life
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . Complete bibliographic reference to the history of the United States and Canada from prehistory to the present.

Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer .

Accessibility statement for American Historical Periodicals from the American Antiquarian Society .

Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: American Institute of Physics Conference Proceedings

name: ARTbibliographies Modern (ProQuest)
description: ARTbibliographies Modern (ABM) provides full abstracts of journal articles, books, essays, exhibition catalogs, PhD dissertations, and exhibition reviews on all forms of modern and contemporary art, with more than 13,000 new entries being added each year. Full coverage begins in 1974 when the first volume was digitised, but entries date back to the late 1960s. ABM is the premier source of information on modern and contemporary arts dating from the late 19th century onwards, including photography since its invention. It includes abstracts of English and foreign-language material on famous and lesser-known artists, movements, and trends. The coverage of ABM is wide-ranging and includes performance art and installation works, video art, computer and electronic art, body art, graffiti, artists' books, theatre arts, conservation, crafts, ceramic and glass art, ethnic arts, graphic and museum design, fashion, and calligraphy, as well as traditional media including illustration, painting, printmaking, sculpture, and drawing. ABM is used by students and researchers around the world to pinpoint publications and writings relevant to their area of study. Its extensive classification system and comprehensive abstracts make it an ideal source for information on artists, art movements, art history and theory, design, photography, and crafts.

name: Artforum Archive

name: Atla - Perspectives on Ancient Civilizations, 1200-1922
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . An archive of publications related to ancient civilizations and cultures from to the Biblical and Classical periods. It features cultures that existed alongside the Hebrew people and had an influence on the formation of Hebrew scriptures.

name: Australia & New Zealand Database (ProQuest)
description: Contains ongoing full-text academic journals published in Australia and New Zealand. Subjects covered include business, science, technology, engineering, social sciences, education, and humanities

name: Australian Education Index (Proquest)
description: Database which indexes documents relating to educational research, policy and practice in Australia.

name: Avant-Garde and Architecture in Czechoslovakia 1909-1938
description: This collection makes available a number of leading periodicals and monographs with special importance for the study of the Czechoslovak avant-garde and architecture in the period before the Second World War. Accessibility statement for Brill Primary Sources .

name: Avery Index to Architectural Periodicals (ProQuest)
description: Comprehensive tool for research in architecture, urban design, historic preservation, and urban planning history. B

name: BAILII (British and Irish Legal Information Institute)
description: The British and Irish Legal Information Institute (BAILII) provides access to the most comprehensive set of British and Irish primary legal materials that are available for free and in one place on the internet

name: Baltic News Service
description: News from the BNS agency based in the Baltic states of Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania. Distributes daily around 1,000 news items in Estonian, Latvian, Lithuanian, Russian and English.

name: BankFocus
description: Access for UCL students and staff only, UCL sign in required . Covering global information on over 47,000+ of the world’s public and private banks

name: Baptisteria Sacra Index
description: An extensive inventory list of baptismal fonts dating from the early Christian period to the 17th century.

name: BAR Digital Collection
description: Access for UCL students and staff only . Complete archive and current content from BAR Publishing, includes the British (blue) and the International (red) series

name: Barbour Compendium
description: Database of technical & product information for construction and health and safety experts, comprising product catalogues, regulatory documents, and directory information for manufacturers.

name: Bartlett Quotations (Bartleby)
description: Including over 11,000 quotations, the first new edition of John Bartletts corpus to be published after his death in 1905 keeps most of his original work intact.

name: BASE - Bielefeld Academic Search Engine
types: Full-text resource; Indexing and abstracting database; Open Access
description: A search engine especially for academic open access web resources, BASE provides more than 70 million documents from more than 3,000 sources, including the full text of about 70% of the indexed documents

name: BBC Landmark Video Collection : Academic Video Online
description: The BBC Landmark Video Collection features streaming content concerning the natural world, including series such as Planet Earth and Blue Planet. Accessibility statement for Academic Video Online .

name: BBC Monitoring
description: Access for UCL students and staff only - login with UCL username and password . BBC Monitoring covers reports from radio, television, news agencies, press and new media in over 180 countries, in over 100 languages. Access is to the global portal plus Terrorism Digest, Regional Political and Security Round ups and Cyber Security Review

name: BBC Monitoring: Summary of World Broadcasts, 1939-2001
description: Access to the full collection, series 1-4. These previously inaccessible transcripts of original radio and television broadcasts from around the world, collected and translated into English by BBC Monitoring, provide real-time coverage of critical world events, from the start of WWII to the early 21st century. The collection features nearly 70,000 individual multi-page reports. Accessibility statement for Readex .

name: BBC Shakespeare Archive Resource
description: UCL users must register for an account with your UCL email and create a password . Features over 900 programmes from the BBC’s archive of Shakespeare’s plays, poems and sonnets

name: BCIN (Bibliographic Database of the Conservation Information Network)
alternate_names: Bibliographic Database of the Conservation Information Network
description: A complete bibliographic resource for the conservation, preservation and restoration of cultural property. The BCIN contains nearly 200,000 citations, including the first 34 volumes of the Art and Archaeology Technical Abstracts (AATA), published between 1955 and 1997

name: BCIS Online (Building Cost Information Service)
description: Access for UCL staff and students only. Register using the BCIS referring url on the E-Resources password page . You will need to use your UCL username without @ucl.ac.uk to access the password page. Database of elemental cost analyses for over 16,000 building projects, plus lifecycle cost information. Access includes the BCIS Life Cycle Evaluator.

name: Beazley Archive Pottery Database
description: The BAPD is the world's largest database of ancient Greek painted pottery (‘Greek vases’). It contains records of more than 130,000 ancient pots and 250,000 images.

name: Beck Online
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. On initial use, users will need go to Beck Online whilst onsite, via the UCL VPN , using Cisco AnyConnect, or Desktop@UCL Anywhere and register for a username and password. Registration must be with a @ucl.ac.uk email. Further use will still need to be via a UCL IP (onsite, VPN or Desktop@UCL) and you will be required to sign in with your Beck Online password. UCL has access to Europarecht PLUS, Verfassungsrecht PLUS and Zivilrecht PLUS

name: Beckett Digital Manuscript Project
description: The Beckett Digital Manuscript Project consists of two parts: a digital archive of Samuel Beckett's manuscripts and a series of 26 volumes, analyzing the genesis of the texts contained in the corresponding modules.

name: Belarus Parliamentary Election, 2012
description: The September 23, 2012 Parliamentary Elections in Belarus were notable for the fact that the majority of the opposition parties were absent from the ballot despite having campaigned in the weeks leading up to the elections. This database contains a sample of ephemera in circulation during the elections.

name: Belarus Presidential Election, 2010
description: Ephemera and official documents related to the 2010 presidential election in Belarus

name: Beowulf online : British Library
description: Old English epic poem, Beowulf. Produced by the British Library.

name: Berg Fashion Library
description: Provides access to interdisciplinary and integrated text and image content on world dress and fashion. It covers all regions of the world, with in-depth content from pre-history to the present day contributed by internationally-renowned scholars. Accessibility statement for Bloomsbury Berg Fashion Library .

name: Best Practice (BMJ)
description: Clinical evidence, guidelines and expert opinion on health care, from the BMJ Publishing Group. Presented in a step-by-step approach, covering prevention, diagnosis, treatment and prognosis.

name: BFI Player
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. To set up access to your BFI Player subscription follow these steps: 1. Go to BFI Player and create an account OR sign in if you already have one by selecting 'Already have an account? Sign in' 2. Select University College London from the dropdown list  3. Login using your UCL username and password. Once you've set up your subscription, you can login on BFI Player for the remainder of this academic year; BFI Player is unavailable outside the UK; it is to be used by UCL students and staff for academic purposes only and access is limited to the subscription content

name: BIAZA (British and Irish Association of Zoos and Aquariums)
alternate_names: British and Irish Association of Zoos and Aquariums
description: more... less... Professional body representing the best zoos and aquariums in the UK and Ireland

name: Bible Gateway
description: Searchable full text of many translations of the Bible, in English and many other languages. MetaLib searches by default in New International Version.

name: Bibliografia generale della lingua e della letteratura italiana (BiGLI)
description: Focusing on all aspects of the study of Italian language and literature the online version of the bibliography covers all issues published in print from 1991-2016.

name: Bibliographie de la littérature française / Bibliography of French Literature
description: Compiled by three institutions : the Bibliothèque nationale de France, the Société d’histoire littéraire de la France and Classiques Garnier. The BLF online lists all the studies published from 1998 until today, in France and abroad, on French and Francophone literature, from the sixteenth century to the present day. It contains more than 150,000 detailed entries including more than 17,000 reviews and over 70,000 articles.

name: Bibliography of British and Irish History
description: Index to literature on British and Irish history from the Roman period to the present day. Formerly known as Royal Historical Society Bibliography.

name: Bibliography of Russian Newspapers
description: Features 10 bibliographic indexes to Russian 19th Century periodicals

name: Bibliography of the Hebrew Book 1470-1960
description: Bibliography of approx 90% of books printed in the Hebrew language 1470-1960. Complete list of books in Hebrew, plus books with text in Ladino, Yiddish and lesser-known Jewish languages such as Judeo-Arabic and Bucharit.

name: Bibliography of the History of Art
description: Covers scholarly literature on western art published 1990-2007. For 2008 onwards see the International Bibliography of Art (IBA).

name: Biblioteca Virtual Miguel de Cervantes
description: The Biblioteca Virtual Miguel de Cervantes is a digital library and archives that offer free electronic access to Spanish and Latin American classical literature.

name: Bibliotheca Teubneriana Latina
description: The BTL Online database provides electronic access to all editions of Latin texts published in the Bibliotheca Teubneriana, ranging from antiquity and late antiquity to medieval and neo-Latin texts. Accessibility statement for De Gruyter .

name: Biography Index Retrospective: 1946-1983 (H.W. Wilson)
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . Containing thousands of citations, Biography Index Retrospective is an archive index covering notable individuals from antiquity through 1983. Indexing and citations include book reviews, interviews, obituaries, diaries and memoirs.

name: Biology Database (ProQuest)
types: Full-text resource; Indexing and abstracting database
description: Providing access to a wide range of biology topics from approx 400 titles, with more than 325 available in full text.

name: BioMed Central Journals
description: BioMed Central (BMC) publishes peer-reviewed open access journals. Including access to Arthritis Research & Therapy, Breast Cancer Research, Genome Biology and journal of biology. Covering all areas of Biology and medicine.

name: BioOne Complete
description: Collection of full-text bioscience research journals focusing on biological, ecological, and environmental sciences

name: BIOSIS Citation Index
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to BIOSIS Citation Index . Get a comprehensive view of life sciences research, including the most important discoveries, significant influences and relevant connections. Biosis Citation IndexSM combines critical life sciences research with powerful citation indexing.

name: Black Central Europe
description: Black Central Europe collects sources on Black History in German speaking lands, arranged chronologically from 1000 AD until the present day. This bilingual database is available in English and German. Sources include paintings, photographs, letters, excerpts of novels, sculptures, newspaper articles and more.

name: Black Thought and Culture
description: Containing approximately 100,000 pages of non-fiction writings by major American black leaders—teachers, artists, politicians, religious leaders, athletes, war veterans, entertainers, and other figures—covering 250 years of history

name: Bloomberg.com / Bloomberg News
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. Log in with UCL email address then via the UCL Single Sign On. Please note that Bloomberg terminal / Bloomberg Anywhere is not included. Includes access to the Bloomberg.com and the Bloomberg mobile app plus unlimited streaming of Bloomberg TV, radio and podcasts. Bloomberg.com delivers business and markets news, data, analysis, and video featuring stories from Businessweek and Bloomberg News.

name: Bloomsbury Architecture Library : Bloomsbury Visual Arts
description: Hosted as part of Bloomsbury Visual Arts, this collection of fully-searchable text and image content, incorporates the new edition of Sir Banister Fletcher’s Global History of Architecture. Accessibility statement for Bloomsbury Architecture Library .

name: Bloomsbury Cultural History
description: Includes Bloomsbury’s Cultural Histories series, an extensive e-book collection, image partnerships with the Wellcome Collection and supporting features to support the study of culture throughout the ages from antiquity to modernity. Accessibility statement for Bloomsbury Cultural History .

name: Bloomsbury Medieval Studies
description: With a global perspective this platform brings together high-quality secondary content with visual primary sources, a brand new reference work, and material culture images. Accessibility statement for Bloomsbury Medieval Studies .

name: Bloomsbury Video Library: Arts and Humanities Collection
description: Previously called ArtFilms. Featuring international content across the visual arts and performing arts, this collection features exclusive indie films and shorts, avant-garde performances, interviews with renowned writers, artists, choreographers, performers and practitioners, documentaries and more

name: BMJ Learning
description: Access to freely available content only. Online learning resources for professionals in primary care and hospital medicine. Learning resources are based on the BMJ Clinical Evidence. Requires institutional Shibboleth login then additional registration and login.

name: BNF : British National Formulary
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. Essential reference resource, providing up-to-date, practical guidance on prescribing, dispensing, and administering medicines.

name: BoB (Box of Broadcasts)
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. Access to BoB is only permitted within the United Kingdom . Requires login with UCL username and password. BoB is Learning on Screen’s on demand TV and radio service for education allowing users to record programmes from over 75 free-to-air channels, access over 2.2 million broadcasts dating back to the 1970s, create playlists, clips and clip compilations; search programme transcripts and subtitles; embed content in VLEs and share on social media

name: Book Citation Index - Science (part of WoS Core Collection)
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to Web of Science . Indexes over 30,000 editorially selected books with 10,000 new books added each year. To search only content from this database, go to More settings and select Book Citation Index Science only.

name: Book Citation Index - Social Sciences and Humanities (part of WoS Core Collection)
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to Web of Science . Indexes over 30,000 editorially selected books with 10,000 new books added each year. To search only content from this database, go to More settings and select Book Citation Index SSH only.

name: Book Industry Communication
description: Independent organisation which promotes supply chain efficiency in the book trade through e-commerce and the application of standard processes and procedures.

name: Book Review Digest Retrospective: 1903-1982 (H.W. Wilson)
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . Providing over a million book review citations from 1903 to 1982. This archive covers adult and juvenile fiction and nonfiction and provides at least one review excerpt per book.

name: Borges Center
description: The Borges Center is dedicated to the work of the Argentine writer Jorge Luis Borges (1899-1986). The site includes an index to his work (the Finder's Guide), a large collection of full-text criticism and several bibliographies.

name: Bridgeman Education
description: Access to over 390,000 images. To download iPhone app click here and enter username/password .

name: Britannica Academic Online
description: Online version of the Encyclopaedia Britannica, with added content from magazines, videos and websites. Also includes a world atlas, Merriam-Webster dictionary and thesaurus, quotations database and introduction to classic literary works.

name: Britannica Image Quest
description: Britannica Image Quest is an online image library which contains images from the worlds best providers including National Geographic, Getty Images, National History Museum and many more. This easy-to-use online portal provides quick access to rights-cleared high-quality images.

name: Britannica Original Sources
description: Collection of primary sources and personal accounts of humankind's social, political, legal, and religious development, as well as some of the greatest discoveries, insights, and literary achievements in the words of the authors, discoverers, and knowledge-seekers.

name: British Association for the Advancement of Science (Collections on the History of Science: 1830-1970): BAAS
types: Full-text resource; Grey literature; Images; Primary Sources
alternate_names: Wiley Digital Archives: British Association for the Advancement of Science (Collections on the History of Science: 1830-1970) BAAS
description: The Archive of the British Association for the Advancement of Science (BAAS) and connected collections from UK universities covers astronomy, biology, technology, industrial design, chemistry, engineering, mathematics, agriculture, meteorology, physics, history of science and STEM, and government grants for scientific research. It contains administrative records, correspondence, illustrations, manuscripts, photographs, prototypes, clippings, personal papers, grey literature—all presented as fully searchable digital images.

name: British Broadcasting Corporation, 1927-2002
description: Comprising of the collections: BBC Handbooks, Annual Reports and Accounts, 1927-2002; BBC Listener Research Department Reports, 1937-c.1950; and British Government Information and Propaganda, 1939-2009

name: British Cartoon Archive
description: To download any cartoon - select UCL from drop down menu and login with your UCL username and password. The British Cartoon Archive is dedicated to the history of British cartooning over the last two hundred years.

name: British Colonial Policy and Intelligence Files on Asia and the Middle East, c. 1880–1950
description: Series comprising of fourteen collections of historical British government documents relating to countries in Asia and the Middle East on which intelligence was gathered, such as India, Afghanistan, Saudi Arabia, and Persia/Iran. Accessibility statement for Brill Primary Sources .

name: British Communism at Home and Abroad, 1883-1991
description: Comprising of the collections: Agitation and the Internal Politics of British Communism, 1907-1977; British Communism in Campaigns and Events, 1947-1991; British Communism through Committee Work, 1926-1992; Communism and Popular Culture in the 20th Century; Communism, Culture and Society in the 20th Century; Communism in Crisis in Britain and Abroad, 1931-1979; Communisms and the Cold War, 1944-1986; Debate and Division on the British Left, 1917-1964; Democratic Centralism during the Cold War, 1943-1991; Gender, Feminism, and the British Left, 1944-1991; Marxist History and Historians in the 20th Century; Notable Individuals of British Communism, 1886-1997; Policymaking and Revolutionary Politics, 1924-1991; The Political Culture of British Communism, 1920-1991; Political Programmes of British Communism, 1944-1990; Radical Trade Unionism in Britain, 1921-1991; Science and Marxism, 1956-1985; and Trade Unions in Crisis: the 1961 ETU Ballot-Rigging Scandal

name: British Education Index (EBSCO)
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . Database of information on research, policy and practice in education and training in the UK. Particular strengths include aspects of educational policy and administration, evaluation and assessment, technology and special educational needs. Useful resource for museum education.

name: British History Online
description: Digital library of some of the core printed primary and secondary sources for the medieval and modern history of the British Isles. Covers administrative and legal, ecclesiastical and religious, economic, intellectual, scientific, cultural, local, parliamentary, urban and metropolitan history.

name: British Illustrated Periodicals, 1869-1970
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Comprising of the collections: Britannia and Eve, 1926-1957; The Bystander, 1903-1940; The Graphic, 1869-1932, The Illustrated Sporting and Dramatic News, 1874-1970; Illustrated War News, 1914–1918 & 1939; London Life, 1965-1966, The Sketch, 1893-1958; The Sphere, 1900-1964 and The Tatler, 1901-1965.

name: British Intelligence and Policy on Persia (Iran), c. 1900–1945
alternate_names: Brill Primary Source British Colonial Policy and Intelligence Files on Asia and the Middle East, c. 1880–1950
description: Part of British Colonial Policy and Intelligence Files on Asia and the Middle East, c. 1880–1950. This collection focuses on the position of Persia between two powerful neighbours, Russia to the north and the British Government of India to the east. Accessibility statement for Brill Primary Sources .

name: British Intelligence Files on the Chinese in Tibet (c. 1900–1950)
alternate_names: Brill Primary Source British Colonial Policy and Intelligence Files on Asia and the Middle East, c. 1880–1950
description: Part of British Colonial Policy and Intelligence Files on Asia and the Middle East, c. 1880–1950. This collection contains files and associated confidential print which accumulated at the India Office in London during the first half of the twentieth century. Accessibility statement for Brill Primary Sources .

name: British Intelligence on Afghanistan and Its Frontiers, c. 1888–1946
alternate_names: Brill Primary Source British Colonial Policy and Intelligence Files on Asia and the Middle East, c. 1880–1950
description: Part of British Colonial Policy and Intelligence Files on Asia and the Middle East, c. 1880–1950. This collection focuses the defense of the North-West Frontier of British India and the status of Afghanistan in the face of real or imagined Russian threats which were dominant themes in the political and military strategies of British India for more than a hundred years, beginning with the First Afghan War intervention of 1838–1842. Accessibility statement for Brill Primary Sources .

name: British Intelligence on Russia in Central Asia, c. 1865–1949
alternate_names: Brill Primary Source British Colonial Policy and Intelligence Files on Asia and the Middle East, c. 1880–1950
description: Part of British Colonial Policy and Intelligence Files on Asia and the Middle East, c. 1880–1950. This collection contains intelligence gathered by the British India Office on the political, economic, strategic and social history of Central Asia. Materials and files were labelled Secret, Confidential, or For Official Use Only. Accessibility statement for Brill Primary Sources .

name: British Intelligence on Siam (Thailand) and Mainland Southeast Asia, c. 1887–1948
alternate_names: Brill Primary Source British Colonial Policy and Intelligence Files on Asia and the Middle East, c. 1880–1950
description: Part of British Colonial Policy and Intelligence Files on Asia and the Middle East, c. 1880–1950. This collection focuses on British-French policies and attempts to steer local politics into a "favourable" direction with attention paid to countering nationalism and communism in the area. The files presented here document the rising influence of Japan, the Second World War, and its immediate aftermath. Accessibility statement for Brill Primary Sources .

name: British Intelligence on the Gulf Arab States, c. 1914–1948
alternate_names: Brill Primary Source British Colonial Policy and Intelligence Files on Asia and the Middle East, c. 1880–1950
description: Part of British Colonial Policy and Intelligence Files on Asia and the Middle East, c. 1880–1950. Containing the archives of the Political and Secret Department of the India Office, this collection focuses on the strategic and geopolitical importance of this area as the route between Europe and Asia, and it’s transformation in the 1920s and 1930s after the discovery of oil. Accessibility statement for Brill Primary Sources .

name: British Intelligence on The North-West Frontier, 1901–1949
alternate_names: Brill Primary Source British Colonial Policy and Intelligence Files on Asia and the Middle East, c. 1880–1950
description: Part of British Colonial Policy and Intelligence Files on Asia and the Middle East, c. 1880–1950. This material covers the period 1901, when the 'North-West Frontier Province' was created, to 1949, by which time the Province had become an administrative region of Pakistan Accessibility statement for Brill Primary Sources .

name: British Intelligence on Yemen, c. 1880–1967
alternate_names: Brill Primary Source British Colonial Policy and Intelligence Files on Asia and the Middle East, c. 1880–1950
description: Part of British Colonial Policy and Intelligence Files on Asia and the Middle East, c. 1880–1950. Since the unification of the Yemen Arab Republic and the People’s Democratic Republic of Yemen in 1990, the Republic of Yemen has occupied an important position in the geopolitical landscape of the Arabian Peninsula region and in the wider context of Middle Eastern and international relations, this collection contains material from the Aden Archives. Accessibility statement for Brill Primary Sources .

name: British Library
description: Information about the British Library, the scope of its collections, and how to use its services.

name: British Library Images Online
description: A growing collection of images from the British Library's collections. Offers full search facilities and the option to purchase and download small image files.

name: British Library Newspapers
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Cross-search with other Gale/Cengage primary sources in Gale Primary Sources . British Library Newspapers consists of collections from the British Library which span three hundred years of newspaper publishing. The resource consists of seven collections and covers Britain and Ireland during the period from 1732-1950 and Southeast Asia from 1806-1980s. Accessibility statement for British Library Newspapers .

name: British Library Sound and Moving Image Catalogue
description: Archive of 12,000 selected recordings of music, spoken word, and human and natural environments, made available by the British Library.

name: British Literary Manuscripts Online: Medieval and Renaissance
types: Full-text resource; Play texts; Primary Sources
description: This digital archive features British manuscripts dating from roughly 1120 to 1660. It offers hundreds of thousands of pages of letters, poems, stories, plays, chronicles, religious writings, and other materials.

name: British Military Intelligence on China and the Boxer Rising, c. 1880–1930
alternate_names: Brill Primary Source British Colonial Policy and Intelligence Files on Asia and the Middle East, c. 1880–1950
description: Part of British Colonial Policy and Intelligence Files on Asia and the Middle East, c. 1880–1950. This collection focuses on British India’s, and the India Office in London’s, interest and in and expertise on China. Accessibility statement for Brill Primary Sources .

name: British National Bibliography
description: Database of books and new journal titles published or distributed in the United Kingdom and Ireland since 1950, provided by the British Library.

name: British Newsreels, 1911-1930: Culture and Society on Film
description: Showcasing a large collection of newsreels produced by the Topical Film Company, and sourced from the BFI and Imperial War Museums, this collection provides a glimpse into the early twentieth century - from everyday interests, such as sport and fashion, to coverage of key events, such as the First World War, the Suffragette Movement, and the establishment of the Irish Free State. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: British Online Archives
description: Access to all 124 of British Online Archives collections

name: British Periodicals (ProQuest)
description: Searchable full text of hundreds of British periodicals from the late seventeenth century to the early twentieth century. Access to collections 1-4.

name: British Pharmacopoeia
description: Access for UCL staff and students only. Sign in is required both on and off site. Search for and select UCL (University College London) to sign in. Please see the BP Help Guide for additonal information. The British Pharmacopoeia provides the only comprehensive collection of authoritative official standards for UK pharmaceutical substances and medicinal products and incorporates all the monographs and texts of the European Pharmacopoeia.

name: British Poor Schools in the Nineteenth Century, 1812-1901
description: Part of British Online Archives' Industrial Revolution in Britain and the World, 1635-1970 series, this collection explores the history of poor schools and the societies that ran them in Britain.

name: British Standards Online
description: Access for UCL students and staff only via the Institutional Login option with UCL username and password. Standards must be downloaded and opened via Adobe. The plug in FileOpen will also need to be installed. From UCL desktops this will need to be installed via the UCL Software Centre . British, European and International Standards, in current, draft and historic form.

name: British Union of Fascists: Newspapers and Secret Files, 1933-1951
description: Part of British Online Archives' Politics and Protest, 1102-1994 series, this collection charts the rise and fall of fascism in Britain during the 1930s and 1940s, with a particular focus on Oswald Mosley’s blackshirt movement.

name: Broadcasting America
description: Discover how the expansion of radio and television technology, and the rise of mass media empires, accelerated America's transformation into a consumer-based society, through the lens of pioneer David Sarnoff, President of the Radio Corporation of America (RCA), and other industry papers. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Browzine Web
description: Browzine presents UCL's academic journals in a browsable format. Browzines easy to navigate bookshelves and compelling visual display allows users to easily find subject areas of interest, to see available scholarly journals, and get to content with a single click. Also available via the Browzine app .

name: Building Products Index
description: Index of building product manufacturers and suppliers, aimed at the UK construction industry. Over half a million pages of data. Free registration required.

name: Business Market Research Collection
description: Contains company, industry, economic and geopolitical market research from: Hoover's Company Profiles, OxResearch and Snapshots

name: Business Periodicals Index Retrospective: 1913-1982 (H.W. Wilson)
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . An archive index covering nearly 70 years of business scholarship. Indexing and citations include scholarly journals, trade publications, magazines and the complete files of Industrial Arts Index (1913-1957).

name: Business Source Ultimate (EBSCO)
types: E-journal collection; Full-text resource; Indexing and abstracting database
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . Offering access to full-text journals including  Harvard Business Review, Fortune , and  MIS Quarterly , plus business videos from top providers .  BSU spans various business topics, from current trends to historical information and global perspectives. Accessibility statement for Business Source Ultimate .

name: Business, Economic and Labour History
description: Features a range of sources from Britain and America, covering key subjects within this historical field, including Keynesian economic policy in post-war Britain; international labour movements; the London Stock Exchange; and the papers of important economists. Accessibility statement for Business, Economic and Labour History. C

name: CAIRN Humanities & Social Sciences Collection
alternate_names: CAIRN Sciences Humaines et Sociales Cairn.info
description: Collection of publications in the French language in the areas of humanities and social sciences with access to over 500 journals and more than 8,500 e-books from major French, Belgian and Swiss publishers.

name: California Digital Newspaper Collection
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Repository of historical California newspapers published from 1846-present, including the first California newspaper, the Californian, and the first daily Californian newspaper, the Daily Alta California. It also contains issues of current California newspapers, collected as PDFs, as part of a project to preserve and provide access to contemporary papers.

name: Cambridge Companions Online
description: A collection of ebooks from Cambridge University Press. Accessibility statement for Cambridge Core .

name: Cambridge Edition of the Works of Ben Jonson Online
description: The Cambridge Edition of the Works of Ben Jonson Online presents a complete reappraisal of this major Renaissance writer, complementing and extending the seven-volume print edition of Jonsons works published in 2012. Accessibility statement for Cambridge Edition of the Works of Ben Jonson Online .

name: Cambridge Shakespeare: The Works and Worlds of Shakespeare Online
description: Includes the complete works of Shakespeare together with a wealth of integrated reference material and the entire collection of Shakespeare Survey. Accessibility statement for Cambridge Core .

name: Camden Local Studies and Archives collections
description: Guide to the Camden Local Studies and Archives Centre in the London borough of Camden. Information about collections and services.

name: Campbell Collaboration
description: The Campbell Collaboration is an international research network that produces systematic reviews of the effects of social interventions.

name: Canadian Business & Current Affairs Database
types: Full-text resource; Indexing and abstracting database
description: Canadian Business & Current Affairs database combines full text and indexed content from four subsets (Business, Current Events, Education, and Reference). Covers over 4.5 million records from approx 1,680 titles.

name: Canadian Heritage Information Network (CHIN)
description: Subject guide to internet resources and other documents for heritage and museum professionals. Canadian focus.

name: Canadian Newsstream
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Updated daily, Canadian Newsstream offers access to the full text and all available backfiles of nearly 300 newspapers from Canada's leading publishers, including The Globe and Mail. Some backfiles date back to the late 1970s and 1980s.

name: Career & Technical Education Database (ProQuest)
types: Full-text resource; Indexing and abstracting database
description: Focusing on vocational information, this database includes over 750 titles, with more than 650 available in full text.

name: Caribbean Colonial Statistics from the British Empire, 1824-1950
description: Part of British Online Archives' Running the West Indies, 1678-1950 series, this collection features records for each colony prefaced by a brief introduction. The statistics include population returns, education reports, grants of land, imports and exports and prison records.

name: Caribbean Newspapers, 1718-1876
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Focuses on the evolution of the region across two centuries chronicled within more than 140 titles from 22 islands

name: CB Insights
description: Users must access via Desktop@UCL or the UCL VPN . When using the database for the first time, register with a UCL email address to create a password. Click 'New user? Sign-up' to create an account when you have reached the UCL CB Insights portal. CB Insights tech market intelligence platform analyses millions of data points on venture capital, startups, patents, partnerships and news mentions. UCL users have access to Core Research, we don't have access to the Expert Intelligence content which appears with a padlock icon. The ChatCBI assistant can provide useful insights into the data, but be aware of the limitations of using generative AI for your academic work.

name: CDP: Corporate Response Data, 2013-present
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. Contact the e-resources team to request access. Dataset containing environmental disclosures submitted to CDP (formerly Carbon Disclosure Project) by companies representing about two-thirds of global market capitalization across 130 countries. It provides key information on climate, water, and biodiversity impacts, risks, and management practices.

name: Cecil Papers
description: The Cecil Papers are a privately held archive of approximately 30,000 sixteenth and seventeenth-century manuscripts, consisting principally of the correspondence of William Cecil, Lord Burghley (1520-1598) and his son Robert, the 1st Earl of Salisbury (1563-1612).

name: CEEOL: Central and Eastern European Online Library
alternate_names: Central and Eastern European Online Library - CEEOL
description: Ongoing full-text database of 2,300+ academic journals, 4,200+ eBooks and 5,500 Grey Literature documents published in Central, East and Southeast Europe dedicated to Humanities, Social Sciences and Arts. Full-text content is indexed and included in 30+ languages.

name: Cell Signalling Biology
description: Online reference work on the biology of cell signalling by Professor Sir Michael J. Berridge. The emerging information on cell signalling pathways is integrated and presented within the context of specific cell types and processes.

name: Census : 1921 Census of England & Wales (Social History Archive)
description: Access for UCL students and staff only . The 1921 Census of England & Wales includes 38 million records covering every person in England and Wales on 19 June 1921. It’s searchable by over 35 fields including keyword, name, address and employer.

name: Census Dissemination Unit (CDU)
description: Access to, and support for use of, aggregate statistics from 1851-1911, 1961 onwards UK Census. You will need to register on the web site in order to access much of the data.

name: Central Asia, Persia and Afghanistan 1834-1922
description: This collection of Foreign Office files explores the history of Persia (Iran), Central Asia and Afghanistan from the decline of the Silk Road in the first half of the nineteenth century to the establishment of Soviet rule over parts of the region in the early 1920s. It is comprised of correspondence, intelligence reports, agents’ diaries, minutes, maps, newspaper excerpts and other materials from the FO 65, FO 106, FO 371 and FO 539 series. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Centre for Interaction Data Estimation and Research (CIDER)
description: Origin-destination statistics from UK Censuses 1981-2001. Data relating to flows of people between places. Pre-registration required

name: CHCC - Historical Censuses Collection
description: Searched via UK Data Service. Access to nineteenth-century UK censuses. Pre-registration required for downloading

name: CHEA - Council for Higher Education Accreditation
description: Information about the Council for Higher Education Accreditation, its work on behalf of accreditation and its member services.

name: Chemical Abstracts
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. On first use, go to the Scifinder registration page to create a personal password. Access to the databases produced by the Chemical Abstracts Service (CAS). Covers documents (journals, proceedings, patents, technical reports and books), substances and reactions.

name: Chicago Manual of Style
description: The Chicago Manual of Style Online is a guide to style, usage, and grammar in an accessible online format.

name: Chicano Database
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . Database focusing on the Mexican-American and Chicano experience, as well as the broader Latino experience of Puerto Ricans, Cuban Americans and Central American immigrants. Explores the broad dimensions of class, race and gender within the Chicano and Latino U.S. experience.

name: Child Development and Adolescent Studies
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . Provides references to the current and historical literature related to the growth and development of children through the age of 21. Covering more than 400,000 records, including all issues of Child Development Abstracts & Bibliography from 1927-2001. Over 10,000 new records are added each year.

name: Children's leisure activities in Russia Online
description: Focusing on the movement for ‘socialisation through play’ and ‘rational leisure’ this collection gives an overview of the different trends in children leisure activities and games from 1917 to the late 1930s. Accessibility statement for Brill Primary Sources .

name: Children's Literature and Culture
description: A collection of rare books, games, ephemera, and artwork from the nineteenth and early twentieth centuries that reveals the socio-cultural history of the times. Showcasing innovative new publishing methods characteristic of the golden age of children’s literature, from mass-produced chapbooks to richly illustrated ‘book-beautifuls’. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Children's Magazine Archive, 1866-2020
description: Backfiles of 20th-century serials covering many aspects of children's lives and interests. Include titles focusing on education, entertainment / literature, news, and religion / moral development. As well as shedding light on the history of childhood and family life during this period, these titles provide alternative perspectives in the study of 20th-century advertising/marketing, popular culture, society, education, media, and print culture. Accessibility statement for ProQuest .

name: China Academic Journals, Series F: Literature, History and Philosophy
description: Provides access to articles published in approx 700 Chinese scholarly journals in the disciplines of literature, history, and philosophy. Users can switch to Chinese-language interfaces (both simplified and traditional) from within the database.

name: China on Film: Twentieth Century Sources from the British Film Institute
description: Collection of documentary and actuality film footage from the British Film Institute (BFI), filmed through the eyes of predominantly Western travellers from 1900-1997. Through a combination of amateur films, travelogues and newsreels, this resource provides a unique perspective on both everyday life and some of the key events of modern Chinese history. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer .

name: China Online Journals (Wanfang Data)
description: China Online Journals (COJ) is a multi-disciplinary resource which includes approx 8,000 journal titles published in mainland China in both Chinese and English.

name: China, America and the Pacific: Trade & Cultural Exchange
description: Containing archival material connected to the trading and cultural relationships that emerged between China, America and the Pacific region between the 18th and early 20th centuries. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: China: Culture and Society
description: Spanning three centuries (c1750-1929), this resource makes available the extremely rare pamphlets from Cornell University Library’s Charles W. Wason Collection on East Asia which form part of one of the deepest and most extensive collections of literature on China and the Chinese in the Western world. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: China: Trade, Politics & Culture, 1793-1980
description: Featuring sources from the School of Oriental and African Studies and the British Library, London: 1793-1980. With documents encompassing events from the earliest English embassy to the birth and early years of the People’s Republic, this resource collects sources from nine archives to give an incredible insight into the changes in China during this period. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Chinese ERIC
description: No longer updated after 2010. Free database of educational studies in Chinese communities. Containing approx 13,000 entries and abstracts, including English and Chinese articles from 19 leading Chinese educational journals, dating back to 1990. Also includes theses and dissertations.

name: Chinese Newspapers Collection : ProQuest Historical Newspapers
description: Providing insight into Chinese political and social life during the turbulent 120 year period from 1832 to 1953 with 12 English-language Chinese historical newspapers.

name: Choya Shinbun Digital Archive, 1875-1889
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Choya Shinbun was a major Japanese newspaper published in Tokyo during the early and mid-Meiji periods. Best known for its support of the Freedom and People’s Rights Movement, Choya Shinbun shaped public opinion during a political era that saw the establishment of the Meiji Constitution and the Imperial Diet.

name: Chronicling America : American Historical Newspapers
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Chronicling America contains millions of newspaper pages published until 1963 from all 50 states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, and the U.S. Virgin Islands. New newspaper pages are added on a regular basis.

name: Church Missionary Society Archive
description: Including records of both the CMS and the many other missionary societies which have become associated or amalgamated with it over its lifetime. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew.

name: Church Missionary Society Periodicals
description: Including publications from the CMS, the Church of England Zenana Missionary Society and the South American Missionary Society. Documenting missionary work from the nineteenth to the twenty-first century, the periodicals include news, journals and reports offering a unique perspective on global history and cultural encounters. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: CIAO - Columbia International Affairs Online
description: Full text of published theory and research in international affairs, including working papers, project reports, conference proceedings, books and articles.

name: CILIP : Chartered Institute of Library and Information Professionals
description: Information about CILIP, the leading professional body in the UK for librarians, information specialists and knowledge managers. The website includes information about jobs and careers, professional guidance, policy and research, and training, events and conferences.

name: CINAHL Plus
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . This database can be accessed by no more than 4 users at a time. The authoritative source of information for the professional literature of nursing, allied health, biomedicine, and healthcare.

name: Cities/Buildings Database
description: Collection of over 5,000 images of buildings and cities drawn from across time and throughout the world, available to students, researchers and educators on the web.

name: Civil War: Antebellum to Reconstruction
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Featuring more than 150 newspapers from all regions of the United Statesplus approximately 50,000 government documents and 4,000 rare broadsides and pieces of ephemera. This diverse collection of primary materials provides unprecedented local and national coverage of American culture, politics and society from 1840-1877 a tumultuous time that redefined a nation

name: Clavis Clavium
description: Clavis Clavium, or ‘Key of Keys’, provides access to Late Antique and Medieval Christian literature. It incorporates the almost 8,000 pages of data found in six so-called claves: the Clavis Patrum Latinorum and the Bibliotheca Hagiographica Latina, the Clavis Patrum Graecorum and the Bibliotheca Hagiographica Graeca, the Clavis Apocryphorum Veteris Testamenti and the Clavis Apocryphorum Novi Testamenti.

name: Clinical Knowledge Summaries (CKS)
description: Concise, accessible summaries of current evidence for primary care professionals. Focuses on most common and significant presentations in primary care

name: ClinicalKey Student - Medical Education and Pharmacy
alternate_names: Clinical Key Student - Medical Education and Pharmacy
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. If you see a Choose organization pop-up, just click continue. You will need to login with an Elsevier account. If you don’t already have one please register with your UCL email address on initial login. Information will be processed by Elsevier in accordance with their privacy policy. UCL username and password still required for off-site access. To download books for offline reading use the ClincalKey Student Bookshelf app for iOS or Android. First access the book on your computer and create your Elsevier account as described above. Go into any of the book sections and click Add to bookshelf . Then download the app and click sign in. Scroll down and click on Log in via your institution . Search for and select UCL (University College London). Sign in on the UCL single sign on screen and you will then be recognised by the app and the book will appear in your library. Click on the book to download it. Accessibility statement for Clinical Key Student .

name: Cochrane Library
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to The Cochrane Library . The Cochrane Library is a collection of databases that contain different types of high-quality, independent evidence to inform healthcare decision-making. Cochrane Databases include: Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews (CDSR) and Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials (CENTRAL).

name: CogNet (MIT Press)
description: CogNet provides access to over 700 books published by the MIT Press. New books are added on an ongoing basis and CogNet also offers the complete text of some of MITs major cognitive science reference works such as Gazzaniga and Manguns The cognitive neurosciences. Accessibility statement for MIT Press Direct .

name: Cognitive Linguistics Bibliography (CogBib)
description: Cognitive Linguistics Bibliography (CogBib) consists of 7000 entries covering a wide range of subjects within the broader field of cognitive linguistics.

name: Cold War Intelligence
description: This collection of 2,360 formerly classified U.S. government documents (most classified Top Secret or higher) provides a declassified documentary record of successes and failures of the U.S. intelligence community in its efforts to spy on the Soviet Union during the Cold War. Accessibility statement for Brill Primary Sources .

name: Collage - Corporation of London Image Database
description: More than 20,000 images from the collections of the Guildhall Art Gallery and Guildhall Library Print Room. Users can view high-quality images, read information about them, and order printed or digital images.

name: Colonial America
description: Colonial America makes available all 1,450 volumes of the CO 5 series from The National Archives, UK, covering the period 1606 to 1822. CO 5 consists of the original correspondence between the British government and the governments of the American colonies. Accessibility statement for Colonial America

name: Colonial Caribbean
description: Colonial Caribbean makes available materials from 27 Colonial Office file classes from The National Archives, UK. Covering the history of the various territories under British colonial governance from 1624 to 1870, this resource includes administrative documentation, trade and shipping records, minutes of council meetings, details of plantation life, colonial settlement, imperial rivalries across the region, and the growing concern of absentee landlords. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Colonial Missionaries' Papers from America and the West Indies, 1701-1870
description: Part of British Online Archives' American Studies, 1621-1952 series, this collection contains the United Society Partners in Gospel's (USPG) founding documents, in-house journal, annual sermons, and reports. These documents provide an insight into the relationship between colonisers and the colonised.

name: Colonial State Papers
description: Colonial State Papers provides access to thousands of papers concerning English activities in the American, Canadian, and West Indian colonies between the sixteenth and eighteenth centuries.

name: Comercio Digital Archive, 1839-2023
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Founded in 1839, El Comercio is the longest-running newspaper in Peru and one of the oldest Spanish-language newspapers in the world.

name: Communist Historical Newspaper Collection : ProQuest Historical Newspapers
description: Offering archival access to the 9 publications of the Communist Party USA, 1919-2013. The content includes news articles, photos, advertisements, classified ads, obituaries, cartoons etc covering the themes of workers’ rights, social issues, national and international politics, culture and Party activity and more. Accessibility statement for ProQuest .

name: Companies House
description: Website of Companies House, the UK organisation which incorporates and dissolves limited companies, examines and stores company information and makes this information available to the public.

name: Comparative Political Data Sets (Universitt Bern)
description: Comparative Political Data Sets (CPDS) are three separate datasets compiled by researchers at the University of Berne. Each contains a collection of political and institutional data and covering different countries and time periods.

name: Comparative Study of Electoral Systems (CSES)
description: CSES is a collaborative program of research among election study teams from around the world.

name: Compendex
description: Interdisciplinary index of engineering and applied science publications.

name: Complete Dictionary of Scientific Biography
description: Information on the history of science through articles on the professional lives of scientists. All periods of science from classical antiquity to modern times are represented.

name: Complete Prose of T. S. Eliot
alternate_names: The Complete Prose of T. S. Eliot
description: Gathering in one place the collected, uncollected, and unpublished prose of T. S. Eliot - including essays, reviews, lectures, commentaries from The Criterion, and letters to editors. Featuring more than 700 uncollected and 150 unpublished pieces from 1905 to 1965. Accessibility statement for Project Muse .

name: Comprehensive English-Yiddish Dictionary
description: Containing nearly 50,000 entries and 33,000 subentries, the Comprehensive English-Yiddish Dictionary emphasizes Yiddish as a living language that is spoken in many places around the world

name: Compustat - Capital IQ
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. Compustat data. Access is via a WRDS account: select the Register tab, complete the Account Request form to create a username and password and wait for a confirmation access email (this can take a few days).

name: Computing Database (ProQuest)
description: Covering over 450 titles, dating back to the early 1990's, the database includes full-text from scholarly journals, trade publications and consumer titles. Includes product reviews.

name: Conference Proceedings Citation Index - Science (part of WoS Core Collection)
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to Web of Science . The Conference Proceedings Citation Index lets you use cited reference searching to see the full impact of conferences and other professional meetings.

name: Conference Proceedings Citation Index - Social Science & Humanities (part of WoS Core Collection)
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to Web of Science . Conference proceedings depict the leading edge of research revealing emerging trends and new ideas before they appear in journals.The Conference Proceedings Citation Index, a Web of Science database, lets you use cited reference searching to see the full impact of conferences and other professional meetings. You can track the influence of papers, authors, and conference series. And you can see how conferences influence all aspects of your research.

name: Confidential Print: Africa, 1834-1966 (Archives Direct)
alternate_names: Archives Direct : Confidential Print: Africa, 1834-1966 AM Explorer
description: The Confidential Print series, issued by the British Government between c. 1820 and 1970, is a fundamental building block for political, social and economic research. The documents begin with coastal trading in the early nineteenth century and the Conference of Berlin of 1884 and the subsequent Scramble for Africa. They then follow the abuses of the Congo Free State, fights against tropical disease, Italy’s defeat by the Abyssinians, World War II, apartheid in South Africa and colonial moves towards independence. Accessibility statement for Confidential Print: Africa

name: Confidential Print: Latin America, 1833-1969 (Archives Direct)
alternate_names: Archives Direct: Confidential Print: Latin America, 1833-1969 AM Explorer
description: This collection consists of the Confidential Print for Central and South America and the French- and Spanish-speaking Caribbean. Topics covered include slavery and the slave trade, immigration, relations with indigenous peoples, wars and territorial disputes, the fall of the Brazilian monarchy, British business and financial interests, industrial development, the building of the Panama Canal, and the rise to power of populist rulers such as Perón in Argentina and Vargas in Brazil. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Confidential Print: Middle East, 1839-1969 (Archives Direct)
alternate_names: Archives Direct: Confidential Print: Middle East, 1839-1969 AM Explorer
description: Focusing on the countries of the Levant and the Arabian peninsula, Iran, Turkey, Egypt and Sudan this series preserves the most important papers generated by the Foreign and Colonial Offices. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Confidential Print: North America, 1824-1961 (Archives Direct)
alternate_names: Archives Direct: Confidential Print: North America, 1824-1961 AM Explorer
description: This collection consists of the Confidential Print for the United States, Canada and the English-speaking Caribbean, with some coverage of Central and South America. Covering topics such as slavery, Prohibition, the First and Second World Wars, racial segregation, territorial disputes, the League of Nations, McCarthyism and the nuclear bomb. The bulk of the material covers the late nineteenth century and the first half of the twentieth century. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Conflict in Indochina: Foreign Office Files for Vietnam, Cambodia and Laos, 1959-1979 (Archives Direct)
description: This collection of Foreign Office Files provides a comprehensive history of key events across Vietnam, Cambodia and Laos during a period of political upheaval, civil unrest and escalating conflict. Published in two sections, Conflict in Indochina explores the rising tension across Indochina after 1959: Crisis and Upheaval, 1959-1964 and Escalation, Reunification and Withdrawal, 1965-1979. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Congressional Research Digital Collections
types: Full-text resource; Indexing and abstracting database; Primary Sources
description: This resource combines Reports from the Legislative Reference Service and the Congressional Research Service from 1916 to present and Congressional Committee Prints (from 1830 to present)

name: Connected Histories
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Cross-search of 11 major digital resources on British History for the period 1500-1900. Includes newspapers, images, maps, parliamentary papers and pamphlets.

name: Construction Centre
description: Directory of manufacturers and suppliers of building materials and components. Searchable by product, brand or company. Also includes indexes of tradespeople, courses, jobs and trade shows.

name: Construction Information Service
description: Index of standards, regulatory and advisory documents for the UK construction industry plus their full-text images, either scanned facsimiles or in Adobe PDF format.

name: Context of Scripture Online
types: Full-text resource; Primary Sources; Reference works
description: A reference work focused on the study of the Bible and the ancient Near East, it provides access to a collection of Ancient Near Eastern texts that have an impact on the interpretation of the Bible. Accessibility statement for Brill Scholarly Editions .

name: Continental Europe Database (ProQuest)
description: Contains ongoing full-text academic journals published by scholarly organizations and educational institutions in many European countries, including France, Italy, Germany, Denmark, Norway, Sweden, Switzerland, Spain, and Portugal. Subject areas include business, science, technology, engineering, social sciences, education, and humanities.

name: Coptic Dictionary Online
description: The Coptic Dictionary Online enables users to look up Coptic words in all dialects and supplies accessible translations in English, French and German

name: Coptic Scriptorium: Digital Research in Coptic Language and Literature
description: Digital research in Coptic language and literature. Including Coptic texts, dictionary and linguistic analysis tools

name: Coptica
description: French language Coptic Studies portal providing digital access to resources for Egyptian language and Coptic literature. Includes texts, indexes, dictionaries and other key resources, some in full text format.

name: Cornell University Library Historical Mathematics Monographs
description: Collection of over 500 selected mathematics monographs with expired copyrights.

name: Coronavirus Research Database (ProQuest)
description: The Coronavirus Research Database is a collection of open access journal articles, preprints, conference proceedings, dissertations and more related to COVID-19 and other coronaviruses.

name: Corpus of Anglo-Saxon Stone Sculpture
description: The Corpus of Anglo-Saxon Stone Sculpture identifies, records and publishes in a consistent format, English sculpture dating from the 7th to the 11th centuries. The Corpus documents the earliest Christian field monuments from free-standing carved crosses and innovative decorative elements, to grave-markers

name: Corpus Vasorum Antiquorum
description: This database consists of a series of high-quality catalogues of mostly ancient Greek painted pottery in collections around the world. The first fascicule appeared in 1922 and since then almost 400 have appeared, illustrating more than 100,000 vases in 24 countries

name: CPI: Competition Policy International
description: Competition Policy International (CPI) is an independent knowledge-sharing organization focused on the most relevant antitrust information and content worldwide.

name: Creation of Modern Iraq, c. 1914–1921
alternate_names: Brill Primary Source British Colonial Policy and Intelligence Files on Asia and the Middle East, c. 1880–1950
description: Part of British Colonial Policy and Intelligence Files on Asia and the Middle East, c. 1880–1950. This collection consists of India Office Political & Secret Department confidential reports, memoranda, maps, and handbooks, as well as policy files describing the background and practicalities of the creation of a political administration, as well as of a social and an economic infrastructure. Accessibility statement for Brill Primary Sources .

name: Creation of Modern Saudi Arabia, c. 1914–1939
alternate_names: Brill Primary Source British Colonial Policy and Intelligence Files on Asia and the Middle East, c. 1880–1950
description: Part of British Colonial Policy and Intelligence Files on Asia and the Middle East, c. 1880–1950. This collection consists of confidential printed reports, maps, memoranda, and handbooks, together with policy files describing the wider context of international relations from the Political and Secret Department of the India Office, London. Accessibility statement for Brill Primary Sources .

name: Creative Commons
description: Search for free content in the public domain and under Creative Commons licenses. CC Search is a tool that allows openly licensed and public domain works to be discovered and used by everyone. CC Search searches across more than 300 million images from open APIs and the Common Crawl dataset. Currently CC Search only searches images.

name: CRILCQ : Centre de recherche interuniversitaire sur la littrature et la culture qubcoises
description: Open access resource from Centre de recherche interuniversitaire sur la littrature et la culture qubcoises if offers online and downloadable access to publications such as monographs, research papers, essays and theses relating to Quebequoise Culture, Literature and Poetry including representation of the North and cultural forms originating from the Northern territories of French and English speaking Canada

name: Criminal Justice Database (ProQuest)
types: Full-text resource; Indexing and abstracting database
description: Covering U.S. and international criminal justice journals this database provides research support in criminal justice, law enforcement, corrections administration, drug enforcement, rehabilitation, family law, and industrial security. Accessibility statement for ProQuest .

name: Criminology Collection (Proquest)
types: Full-text resource; Indexing and abstracting database
description: Covering research on crime, its causes and impacts, legal and social implications, and law enforcement and security services. The collection includes the Criminal Justice Database, the National Criminal Justice Reference Service (NCJRS) Abstracts Database, and full-text coverage of scholarly journals along with correctional and law enforcement trade publications, crime reports and crime blogs. Accessibility statement for ProQuest .

name: Cross-National Time-Series Data Archive (CNTS Archive)
description: The CNTS archive has 196 variables and contains data for over 200 countries from 1815 onward (excluding 1914-1918 and 1940-1945). Data covers economic, political, population and demographic variables. Emphasis is on domestic conflict (eAssassinations, General Strikes, Terrorism/Guerrilla Warfare, Major Government Crises, Purges, Riots, Revolutions, and Anti-government Demonstrations), political, legislative and economic data.

name: CRSP: Center for Research in Security Prices
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. CRSP data. Access is via a WRDS account: select the Register tab, complete the Account Request form to create a username and password and wait for a confirmation access email (this can take a few days).

name: Cult of body
description: This collection comprises unique material on sports and physical culture in Russia, 1891-1919. Sports provided opportunities for transitions from tradition to modernity: athletic competition broke down class barriers, brought women into public spaces, and encouraged new modes of behavior and self-presentation. Accessibility statement for Brill Primary Sources .

name: Current Chemical Reactions (part of WoS Core Collection)
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to Web of Science . Included in Web of Science, Current Chemical Reactions delivers the latest synthetic methods reported in over 100 of the world's leading organic chemistry journals. Each reaction provides complete reaction diagrams,critical conditions, bibliographic data, and author abstracts

name: Current Contents Connect
description: Current Contents Connect is a current awareness database that provides access to complete tables of contents, abstracts, bibliographic information, and abstracts from the most recently published issues of leading scholarly journals, as well as from more than 7,000 relevant, evaluated websites.

name: Current Digest of the Russian Press : 1949-
description: Founded in 1949, each week the Current Digest of the Russian Press presents a selection of Russian-language press materials, carefully translated into English.

name: Current Index to Statistics
description: Index to publications in statistics and related fields.

name: Cyburbia
description: Gateway to web resources on topics related to planning, originating at the University of Buffalo. D

name: Daily Mail Historical Archive, 1896-2004
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Cross-search with other Gale/Cengage primary sources in Gale Primary Sources . The Daily Mail Historical Archive 1896-2004 provides more than 100 years of the Daily Mail newspaper online. As well as the regular edition of the newspaper, the Daily Mail Historical Archive also includes the Daily Mail Atlantic Edition, which was published on board the transatlantic liners that sailed between New York and Southampton between 1923 and 1931. Accessibility statement for Daily Mail Historical Archive.

name: Daily Observer Digital Archive, 1981-2016
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Founded in 1981, the Daily Observer is Liberia’s best-known, independent, national newspaper.

name: Dalloz Revues
description: To access, click on Connexion, UCL students and staff only. Access is for 3 concurrent users. Access to the complete collection of legal journals from Dalloz

name: DANS Data Station Archaeology
description: Previously included in OpenGrey. Data station enabling users to deposit data and search for data within the domain of archaeology

name: DANS Data Station Social Sciences and Humanities
description: Previously included in OpenGrey. Data station enabling users to deposit data and search for data within the social sciences and humanities domains

name: Darwin Online
description: Online collection of the writings of Charles Darwin, including more than 50,000 searchable text pages and 40,000 images of both publications and handwritten manuscripts.

name: Data Citation Index
types: Data and statistics; Indexing and abstracting database
description: Searches research data, including data studies, data sets from a wide range of international data repositories and connects them with the scientific literature to track data citation

name: Database and Dictionary of Greek Loanwords in Coptic (DDGLC)
