description: A systematic, comprehensive and detailed lexicographical compilation and description of Greek loanwords as attested in the entire Coptic corpus through every dialect, each kind of text, and in pre-Coptic Egyptian.

name: Database of Coins
description: The information gathered in the database has been taken from key scholarly works in the field of numismatics. The source of each entry (sometimes involving multiple works) is provided in the bibliography, and those seeking further information are invited to consult these works.

name: Database of Latin Dictionaries: DLD
description: Offering an overview of Latin vocabulary this database covers various kinds of dictionaries: defining and translating, thematic, medieval and early modern including the Dictionary of Medieval Latin from British Sources.

name: Datastream
description: See record for LSEG Workspace (Eikon) .

name: Dataverse Project (Harvard University)
description: Spatial datasets to support publications have been stored in Harvard's Dataverse. All are freely downloadable.

name: DBNL (Digitale bibliotheek voor de Nederlandse letteren)
description: Growing collection of digital full-text primary and secondary information on Dutch language and literature and its historical, societal and cultural context.

name: Decolonization: The Politics of Independence in former Colonial Territories
description: Cross-search with other Gale/Cengage primary sources in Gale Primary Sources . Bringing together material from within former British colonies and Commonwealth nations, alongside some from former French and Portuguese territories, this archive provides primary source material created for local audiences by local actors during a period of enormous global change.

name: Defining Gender, 1450-1910
description: Featuring a vast body of British source material from the fifteenth to early twentieth century including correspondence, advice literature, periodicals, ephemera and government documents. Accessibility statement for Defining Gender.

name: Delineating British Burma, c. 1826–1949
alternate_names: Brill Primary Source British Colonial Policy and Intelligence Files on Asia and the Middle East, c. 1880–1950
description: Part of British Colonial Policy and Intelligence Files on Asia and the Middle East, c. 1880–1950. This collection of official and confidential print reflects the long process of information gathering, codification, and dissemination that both accompanied the three stages of the British annexation of Burma. Accessibility statement for Brill Primary Sources .

name: Demokratychna Ukraina Digital Archive: 1992-2020
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Can also be viewed and cross-searched within East View Global Press Archive . Established initially as a Russian-language daily newspaper the paper underwent dramatic transformation after the August 1991 coup attempt against Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev. As well as changing it's name, it began publishing in Ukrainian and altered its editorial policies to encourage a new kind of journalism that valued democratic ideas and ideals.

name: Dentistry & Oral Sciences Source (EBSCO)
types: E-journal collection; Full-text resource; Indexing and abstracting database
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . Dentistry & Oral Sciences Source covers all facets relating to the areas of dentistry including dental public health, endodontics, facial pain & surgery, odontology, oral & maxillofacial pathology/surgery/radiology, orthodontology, pediatric dentistry, periodontology, and prosthodontics.

name: Derwent Innovations Index
types: Indexing and abstracting database; Patents and standards
description: Value-added patent information from Derwent World Patent Index as well as patent citation information from Patents Citation Index.

name: Design and Applied Arts Index (DAAI)
alternate_names: ProQuest Design and Applied Arts Index
description: Design and Applied Arts Index (DAAI) is the leading source of abstracts and bibliographic records for articles, news items, and reviews published in design and applied arts periodicals from 1973 onwards. An indispensable tool for students, researchers, and practitioners worldwide, DAAI covers both new designers and the development of design and the applied arts since the mid-19th century, surveying disciplines including ceramics, glass, jewellery, wood, metalsmithing, graphic design, fashion and clothing, textiles, furniture, interior design, architecture, computer aided design, Web design, computer-generated graphics, animation, product design, industrial design, garden design, and landscape architecture. Around 1200 new records are added in each monthly update.

name: DETAIL Digital
description: A research and inspiration source for architects and structural engineers with access to more than 3,600 project documentations from over 30 years of DETAIL.

name: Deutsches Theater-Lexikon Online
description: Containing all volumes of the Deutsches Theater-Lexikon [Encyclopaedia of German Theatre], the comprehensive bio-bibliographic encyclopaedia of the world of theatre in German speaking countries. Accessibility statement for De Gruyter .

name: Diccionario Biográfico Electrónico
description: The electronic edition of the Diccionario Biográfico Español collates biographical information on prominent people in the history of Spain. The dictionary contains more than 40,000 bibliographic entries on people who, working in various fields and disciplines, shaped Spanish history and culture. Chronologically the dictionary covers 2500 years of Spanish history from the VII to the XX century, while geographically it covers areas across the world with particular focus on the territories that were part of the Spanish administration.

name: Dictionary of Medieval Latin from British Sources: DMLBS
description: Covering the period from Gildas (fl. 540) to William Camden (1600) the DMLBS focuses on British Medieval Latin.

name: Dictionary of Old English - A to Le
description: First portion of the dictionary defining the vocabulary of the first centuries (600-1150 A.D.) of the English language, part of an ongoing project. The DOE complements Middle English Dictionary (which covers the period 1100-1500 A.D.) and Oxford English Dictionary, the three together providing a full description of the vocabulary of English

name: Dictionary of Old English Corpus
description: Corpus of the dictionary defining the vocabulary of the first centuries (600-1150 A.D.) of the English language. Contains at least one copy of every Old English text. The DOE complements the Middle English Dictionary (which covers the period 1100-1500 A.D.) and the Oxford English Dictionary, the three together providing a full description of the vocabulary of English. Can be searched by word, phrase or citation.

name: Dictionnaires des 16e et 17e s. / Dictionaries of the 16th and 17th centuries
description: Dictionnaires des 16e et 17es offers online access to ten French dictionaries published in the 16th and 17th centuries

name: Diensttagebuch von Wolfram Sievers und das SS-Ahnenerbe (1941–45)
alternate_names: Sievers Diaries and the Nazi Research Network “Ahnenerbe"
description: Containing Wolfram Sievers’ complete service diaries (1941–1945) this source enhances study of the Nazi research network “Ahnenerbe.” Accessibility statement for De Gruyter .

name: Digimap - Aerial Digimap
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. Users must register with their UCL username and password on first use and agree to licence conditions. Online access to detailed aerial imagery from Getmapping. Login and choose "Aerial".

name: Digimap - agCensus
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. Users must register with their UCL username and password on first use and agree to licence conditions. Access to a time-series database of grid square based data derived from the regular Agricultural Censuses of England, Scotland and Wales. Login and choose "agCensus".

name: Digimap - Environment Digimap
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. Users must register with their UCL username and password on first use and agree to licence conditions. Online access to the Land Cover Maps from the Centre for Ecology and Hydrology (CEH). Login and choose "Environment".

name: Digimap - Geology Digimap
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. Users must register with their UCL username and password on first use and agree to licence conditions. Online access to geological maps and data from the British Geological Survey. Login and choose "Geology".

name: Digimap - Global Digimap
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. Users must register with their UCL username and password on first use and agree to licence conditions. Login and choose "Global".

name: Digimap - Historic Digimap
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. Users must register with their UCL username and password on first use and agree to licence conditions. Online access to historic Ordnance Survey maps from Landmark Information Group. Login and choose "Historic".

name: Digimap - Lidar Digimap
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. Users must register with their UCL username and password on first use and agree to licence conditions. Login and choose "Lidar".

name: Digimap - Marine Digimap
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. Users must register with their UCL username and password on first use and agree to licence conditions. Login and choose "Marine". View and download hydrographic and marine data from SeaZone Solutions Ltd. Two datasets: Hydrospatial (in ESRI and MapInfo formats) and Charted Raster (GeoTiff format) are available.

name: Digimap - Ordnance Survey
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. Users must register with their UCL username and password on first use and agree to licence conditions. Online digital mapping and data extraction facilities using Ordnance Survey data of Great Britain and Northern Ireland. Login and choose "Ordnance Survey". Includes the Improvement Service, LandClan Collection, OS National Geographic Database, OS Northern Ireland data and the National Tree Map Collection.

name: Digimap - Pilot
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. Users must register with their UCL username and password on first use and agree to licence conditions. Pilot provides access to data that Digimap are trying out and evaluating against demand from users. Login and choose "Pilot".

name: Digimap - Society Digimap
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. Users must register with their UCL username and password on first use and agree to licence conditions. Login and choose "Society".

name: Digimap - Verisk Digimap
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. Users must register with their UCL username and password on first use and agree to licence conditions. Map data from VeriskUK. Login and choose "Verisk".

name: Digital Education Resource Archive
description: Digital archive of all documents published electronically by government and related bodies in the area of education.

name: Digital Library of the Caribbean
description: The Digital Library of the Caribbean (dLOC) provide access to digitized versions of Caribbean cultural, historical and research materials currently held in archives, libraries, and private collections. Featuring resources from and about the Caribbean and circum-Caribbean. Also contains materials on ancient Maya.

name: Digital National Security Archive
description: Access to collections 1-37. Unlocking important declassified U.S. government documents, providing vital primary source material to advance research in twentieth and twenty-first century history, politics, and international relations. Collections cover the most critical world events, countries, and U.S. policy decisions from post-World War II through the 21st century, with more than 150,000 indexed, declassified government documents. Accessibility statement for Digital National Security Archive .

name: Digital Public Library of America
description: Making millions of materials from libraries, archives, museums, and other cultural institutions across America available to all in a one-stop discovery experience.

name: Digital Scholar Lab
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. Sign in with UCL username and password, then select 'Login / Create Account' then 'Use University Credentials'. Gale's Digital Scholar Lab is a cloud-based digital humanities platform that enables access to UCL's content and OCR data from Gale Primary Sources and provides the means to analyse these with text and data mining tools.

name: Digital Theatre+
description: Best streamed on Chrome, Safari, or Edge. Featuring filmed productions, practitioner interviews, and a wide range of written introductory/contextual materials. Including Digital Theatre's own recordings alongside collections such as the Shakespeare's Globe, the Royal Shakespeare Company, the BBC, Broadway Digital Archive, Eclipse, Royal Opera House, London Symphony Orchestra and LA Theatre Works audio radio-plays. Practitioner interviews exploring process, craft and technique with academics, playwrights and industry insiders and expert research resources such as encyclopedia entries, workshops, lectures and essays written by academics and industry insiders.

name: Digital Topographical Bibliography
types: Indexing and abstracting database; Reference works
description: An essential and comprehensive reference resource for Egyptologists, presenting and analysing both published and unpublished information about ancient Egyptian monuments.

name: Dikke Van Dale
description: Access for UCL students and staff only, UCL username and password login required. Key dictionary of the Dutch language includes definitions, etymology, grammar, spelling and literary quotes.

name: Dimensions
types: Data and statistics; Full-text resource; Indexing and abstracting database
description: UCL staff and students only. Login using your UCL email address. Multi-disciplinary database covering all fields of research, with the ability to search by full-text as well as title/abstract. Includes Dimensions Analytics, for more detailed bibliometric analyses including citation metrics, networks, and funder data. Please see the Research Metrics Dimensions guide for more information.

name: Directory of UK ELT Research
description: Database providing a user-friendly overview of recent ELT research

name: Disability in the Modern World: History of a Social Movement
types: Full-text resource; Primary Sources; Video streaming
description: Containing 150,000 pages of primary sources, supporting materials, and archives, along with 125 hours of video. The content supports the growing disciplines of disability history and disability studies, and also history, media, the arts, political science, education

name: DOAJ : Directory of Open Access Journals
types: Indexing and abstracting database; Open Access
description: Index of diverse open access journals from around the world, covering approximately 21,500 journals

name: Documents on British Policy Overseas
description: This historical collection gathers together tens of thousands of UK Government documents relating to Britains international relations, including foreign policy instructions, letters and memos, business reports, and more. These primary source materials have been selected by the official historians of Britains Foreign and Commonwealth Office (FCO) and, in many cases, have been declassified at their request for inclusion in this series.

name: Dokumentasjonsprosjektet
description: A range of digital texts on Norwegian language, literature and culture. Also includes digitised catalogues.

name: Drama Online
types: Audio; Full-text resource; Images; Play texts; Primary Sources; Video streaming
description: Drama Online introduces new writers alongside iconic names in playwriting history, providing contextual and critical background through scholarly works and practical guides. Access includes the Bloomsbury & Faber Collection, Nick Hern Books, National Theatre Collection, RSC Live and Shakespeare's Globe on Screen.

name: Drug and Therapeutics Bulletin
description: Independent evaluations of, and practical advice on, individual treatments and the overall management of disease for doctors, pharmacists and other healthcare professionals. Articles are based on a synthesis of evidence with opinions from a wide range of specialist and generalist commentators, typically up to 100 individuals and organisations for each article.

name: Duden Online
description: Key dictionary of the German language including definitions and grammar. E

name: e-Clavis: Christian Apocrypha
description: A comprehensive bibliography of Christian Apocrypha research, including Coptic Christian materials. Entries for each text include a detailed description, an inventory of manuscript sources, bibliography (including online resources), and information about the text’s use in iconography and popular culture.

name: e-LiS : e-prints in library and information science
alternate_names: e-prints in library and information science
description: International open repository focusing on the field of library and information science

name: Early American Newspapers: Early Colonial to Articles of Confederation Era, 1690-1789
description: The newspapers in Early Colonial to Articles of Confederation Era, 1690-1789 can be searched by choosing “Select All” in the search interface, individual newspapers can also be found in “Browse Publications". Featuring titles from every region of the U.S. to provide a record of people, issues and events from the time period such as: Salem witchcraft, Slavery institutionalized, First Great Awakening, Pontiac's Rebellion, Royal Proclamation of 1763, Stamp Act Crisis, Boston Massacre, Boston Tea Party, First Continental Congress, Battle of Lexington and Concord, Declaration of Independence, Rise of Republicanism, Treaty of Paris, Shays' Rebellion, U.S. Constitutional Convention, Rise of Republican Motherhood.

name: Early Egypt Bibliography : Bibliography of the Prehistory and the Early Dynastic period of Egypt and Northern Sudan
alternate_names: Bibliographie de l’Égypte des Origines : Bibliographie de la préhistoire et de la protohistoire de l’Égypte et du Nord du Soudan
description: Includes abstracts relating to the Prehistory and Early Dynastic period of Egypt and Northern Sudan. Bilingual French and English searching.

name: Early English Books Online
description: Digital facsimile page images of virtually every work printed in England, Ireland, Scotland, Wales and British North America and works in English printed elsewhere from 1473-1700. Also some searchable full-text. Accessibility statement for Early English Books Online .

name: Early European Books
description: Access to collections 1-12, 27 and the Wellcome Trust Collection. Selected printed European works from before 1701, mostly in non-English European languages. Accessibility statement for Early European Books .

name: Early Modern England: Society, Culture & Everyday Life, 1500-1700
description: Examining the lived experience of 'ordinary' people through to more prominent individuals and families, this resource shows how everyday working, family, religious and administrative life was experienced across England from 1500-1700. Accessibility statement for Early Modern England: Society, Culture & Everyday Life.

name: Early Russian Cinema
description: Information on domestic and foreign films shown on screens in Russia from 1907-1918, including full text of film magazines and newspapers, detailed description of films, reviews by critics and censored materials. Accessibility statement for Brill Primary Sources .

name: Early Soviet Cinema Collection
description: Collection of 116 e-books originally published in print from 1928 to 1948, on everything related to the Golden Age of Soviet cinema

name: Earth, Atmospheric and Aquatic Science Database (Proquest)
description: Featuring scholarly and learned material with a focus on geoscience, meteorology, climatology, aquatic science, and related disciplines. Coverage includes thousands of full-text publications including peer-reviewed journals, trade publications, dissertations, conference proceedings, reports and video material. Accessibility statement for ProQuest .

name: East & South Asia Database (ProQuest)
description: Full-text academic journals published by scholarly publishing organizations and educational institutions in many East Asian and South Asian countries. Subject areas covered include business, science, technology, engineering, social sciences, education, and humanities.

name: East Europe, Central Europe Database (ProQuest)
description: Ongoing full-text academic journals published in East and Central Europe. Covers business, science, technology, engineering, social sciences, education, and humanities

name: East India Company
description: Access to modules 1-7. Containing royal charters, correspondence, trading diaries, minutes of council meetings and reports of expeditions, among other document types, this resource charts the history of British trade and rule in the Indian subcontinent and beyond from 1599 to 1947. Accessibility statement for East India Company .

name: East View Online Databases
description: Database of full-text newspaper articles, journal articles and government publications from Russia, plus newspaper articles from Central and Eastern Europe, Central Asia and the Caucasus.

name: Eastern European LGBTQ Collections
description: This collection of ephemera materials documents LGBTQ movements in several Eastern European countries. With the resurgence of conservative political activism in Eastern Europe, which embraces and emphasizes traditionalist social, sexual, and gender norms, LGBTQ persons and LGBTQ activism are largely rejected and repudiated for undermining national values and social cohesion. This collection of ephemera, (brochures, clothing items, booklets, flyers, etc.) offers important insights into LGBTQ activism in Eastern Europe and the Balkans in the past decade

name: Eastern European Newspapers
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Newspapers published in Eastern Europe between 1835 and 1922.

name: Ebart Medijska Dokumetacija Newspaper Archive (East View)
description: Serbian newspaper database.

name: Ecological Flora of the British Isles
description: Flora consisting of data on over 2200 species of higher plants that occur in the British Isles, together with a bibliography of sources. Browsable by species, vernacular name, synonym, ecological characteristic, phytophagous insects and associated fungi.

name: EconBiz
types: Full-text resource; Indexing and abstracting database
description: Virtual library for economics and business studies. German-based with English translation. Covers internet resources, full-text resources, and German library catalogues and services. Offers a browse by resource type, a search of internet resources and a cross-search of various economics databases.

name: EconLit
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . This database can be accessed by no more than 4 users at a time. Index of international publications on economics, with selected abstracts.

name: Economic and Social Research Council / ESRC Research Catalogue
description: UK’s largest funder of economic, social, behavioural and human data science, website lists the major research investments funded by the ERSC, including programmes, centres, large grants, collaborations and ventures.

name: Economics Research Network (ERN)
description: Economics section of the Social Science Research Network (SSRN), which aims for rapid dissemination of research in the social sciences. Includes abstracts of scholarly working papers and forthcoming papers, plus thousands of full-text documents. Can be searched or browsed.

name: Economist Historical Archive, 1843-2025
description: Cross-search with other Gale/Cengage primary sources in Gale Primary Sources . The Economist Historical Archive delivers a complete searchable copy of every issue of The Economist from 1843 to 2020. The Economist presents the world's political, business, scientific, technological and cultural developments and the connections between them.

name: Economist Intelligence Unit Country Reports Archive, 1952-1995
description: The Economist Intelligence Unit has published Country Reports since 1952, covering almost 200 countries. Each report presents detailed statistics alongside expert commentary and forecasting from the EIU’s analysts. This database presents the historical reports up to 1995. For current reports, access EIU Viewpoint .

name: EconPapers
description: Collection of economics working papers and journal articles. Based on RePEc bibliographic and author data.

name: EDP Open
types: E-journal collection; Full-text resource; Open Access
description: EDP Open is the Open Access arm of EDP Sciences, providing access to free content made available from the EDP Sciences platform. Includes journals, conferences and e-books.

name: Education Abstracts
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . Covering key areas of education and related fields, content areas include educational specialties and administration. Includes indexing and abstracts for more than 1,000 periodicals and yearbooks (indexing dating back to 1983, abstracts back to 1994) and books on education published after 1995.

name: Education Database (ProQuest)
types: Full-text resource; Indexing and abstracting database
description: Giving users access to over 900 top educational publications, including more than 600 of the titles in full text. The coverage spans the literature on primary, secondary and higher education as well as special education, home schooling and adult education. Many titles are indexed in ERIC.

name: Education Index Retrospective: 1929-1983 (H.W. Wilson)
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . Archive index chronicling over a half a century of important education literature. Covering all levels of education and education specialties, it indexes hundreds of publications, many of them peer-reviewed.

name: Education Magazine Archive‎, 1910-2015
description: Archive of magazines in the field of education, ranging from the early 20th to 21st centuries offering insights into educational history, theory, and perspectives

name: Education Research Index
types: Grey literature; Indexing and abstracting database
description: Education Research Index combines ERIC, the leading education research database produced by the U.S. Department of Education, with the new Supplemental Education Index, which was created to expand upon the current scope of ERIC. Together, they offer journal articles, reports, documents, books, all indexed with the ERIC vocabulary for a unified search experience. Covers from 1966 onwards.

name: Educational Administration Abstracts
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . Includes bibliographic records covering areas related to educational administration such as educational leadership, educational management and educational research. The index contains more than 190,000 records.

name: eHRAF Archaeology
types: Full-text resource; Indexing and abstracting database
description: An online cross-cultural database containing information on world’s prehistory organized by archaeological traditions. The documents are subject-indexed at the paragraph level

name: eHRAF World Cultures
types: Full-text resource; Indexing and abstracting database
description: An online cross-cultural and ethnographic database containing descriptive information on all aspects of cultural and social life. The annually-growing eHRAF database is organized by cultures and ethnic groups, and every document is subject-indexed at the paragraph level, facilitating precise retrieval within documents.

name: Eighteenth Century Collections Online
description: Cross-search with other Gale/Cengage primary sources in Gale Primary Sources . Digital library of eighteenth-century publications, based on the English Short Title Catalogue. Covers history and geography; social science and fine arts; medicine, science and technology; literature and language; philosophy and religion; law; general reference. Accessibility statement for Eighteenth Century Collections Online .

name: Eighteenth Century Drama
types: Full-text resource; Play texts; Primary Sources
description: Archive of almost every play submitted for licence between 1737 and 1824, and hundreds of documents that provide social context for the plays. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Eighteenth Century Journals
description: Bringing together rare journals printed between c.1685 and 1835, this resource illuminates all aspects of eighteenth-century social, political and literary life. Accessibility statement for Eighteenth Century Journals.

name: EIU Viewpoint
description: Combines the EIU’s expert political insights, policy analysis and economic outlook with forward-looking forecasts and proprietary data. Includes EIU Country Reports.

name: Electronic Arts Intermix (EAI): Educational Streaming Site
description: EAI's Educational Streaming Site, contains full-length streaming videos for the featured artists.

name: Electronic Capito Project
description: Letters from and to Wolfgang Faber Capito (c. 1478-1541), German religious reformer.

name: Electronic Enlightenment: Letters & Lives
description: With approx 80,000 letters and documents and 10,300 correspondents , EE is a collection of edited correspondence from the early modern period, linking people across Europe, the Americas and Asia from the early 17th to the mid-19th century.

name: Electronic Medicines Compendium (EMC)
description: Summaries of Product Characteristics and Patient Information Leaflets for medicines from 200 pharmaceutical companies.

name: Elsevier Reference Collection in Biomedical Sciences
description: This resource is designed to serve as an in depth and comprehensive compendium of Biomedical sciences.   Accessibility statement for ScienceDirect .

name: Elsevier Reference Collection in Earth Systems and Environmental Science
description: This reference collection contains trusted, peer-reviewed, comprehensive content from Elsevier's reference works. It contains "Featured Articles" for quick, clear overviews and subject hierarchies to put information in context. Accessibility statement for ScienceDirect .

name: Elsevier Reference Collection in Life Sciences
description: This resource is designed to serve as an in depth and comprehensive compendium of life sciences. Accessibility statement for ScienceDirect .

name: Elsevier Reference Collection in Neuroscience and Biobehavioral Psychology
alternate_names: Neuroscience and Biobehavioral Psychology : Elsevier Reference Collection
description: This resource is designed to serve as an in depth and comprehensive compendium of Neuroscience and Biobehavioral Psychology. Accessibility statement for ScienceDirect .

name: EMBASE
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to Ovid . Comprehensive pharmacological and biomedical database renowned for extensive indexing of drug information.

name: EMBASE Classic
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to Ovid . Historic edition of the pharmacological and biomedical database renowned for extensive indexing of drug information. For recent content, see EMBASE

name: Emcare
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to Ovid . Covering all nursing specialties and nursing healthcare professions Emcare includes international coverage and includes unique content not found in other nursing and allied health databases including more than a thousand journals not covered by Embase.

name: Emerald Expert Briefings
description: Powered by Oxford Analytica. Expert Briefings are responses to macro-economic and geopolitical events, prepared for global political and business leaders to help them understand the implications providing a backdrop of developments recorded now and over the past five years allowing students and researchers to position their work in a real-world context.

name: Emerald Insight
description: Access to Emerald ejournals and ebooks which have been subscribed or purchased by UCL. Accessibility statement for Emerald Insight .

name: Emerging Sources Citation Index (part of WoS Core Collection)
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to Web of Science . Index of high-quality, peer-reviewed publications of regional importance and in emerging scientific fields that have not yet met the criteria for the more established Science Citation Index (SCI), Social Science Citation Index (SSCI), or Arts and Humanities Citation Index (AHCI)

name: EMIS : Emerging Markets Information Service
description: EMIS is a curator of multi-sector, multi-country industry research from over 4,500 renowned global providers and niche local sources. As well as over 10 million Emerging Market based companies and all globally listed companies. The platform is organised into: Companies, Industries and Regions/ Countries. For more information please see the EMIS Knowledge Portal for short videos on how to use different functions or for a more detailed explanation use the EMIS University User Guide

name: Empire Online
description: Spanning five centuries this resource brings together manuscript, printed and visual primary source materials for the study of 'Empire' and its theories, practices and consequences. Accessibility statement for Empire Online.

name: Empire Studies
description: Featuring material on British colonial policy and government, perspectives on life in British colonies, the relationship between gender and empire, race and class. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Encyclopaedia Britannica
description: Online version of the Encyclopaedia Britannica, with added content from magazines, videos and websites. Also includes a world atlas, Merriam-Webster dictionary and thesaurus, quotations database and introduction to classic literary works.

name: Encyclopaedia Judaica
description: An exhaustive and organized overview of Jewish life and knowledge from the Second Temple period to the contemporary State of Israel, from Rabbinic to modern Yiddish literature, from Kabbalah to "Americana" and from Zionism to the contribution of Jews to world cultures.

name: Encyclopaedia of Islam, 2nd edition
description: The Encyclopaedia of Islam (Second Edition) Online sets out the present state of our knowledge of the Islamic World. It aims to enable understanding of the world of Islam, not only for the religion, but also for the believers and the countries in which they live. Accessibility statement for Brill Reference Works .

name: Encyclopaedia of Islam, 2nd edition, Glossary and Index of Terms
types: Indexing and abstracting database; Reference works
description: Focuses on the technical terms in Arabic, Persian, Turkish, Urdu and other languages or dialects of the Islamic world. Accessibility statement for Brill Reference Works .

name: Encyclopaedia of Islam, 3rd edition
description: Covering the Islamic World and focusing on the religion and the believers and the countries in which they live. The Third Edition of the Encyclopaedia of Islam is an entirely new work and includes comprehensive coverage of Islam in the twentieth century and of Muslim minorities all over the world. Accessibility statement for Brill Reference Works .

name: Encyclopedia of Atmospheric Sciences
description: Encyclopaedia covering all aspects of atmospheric sciences, including both theory and applications. Nearly 350 articles and over 1,900 figures and photographs are presented, many in full-colour.

name: Encyclopedia of Earth
description: Encyclopedia covering the Earth, its natural environments and their interaction with society. Articles are written in non-technical language by scholars, professionals, educators and experts who collaborate and review each other's work.

name: Encyclopedia of Hebrew Language and Linguistics
description: The Encyclopedia of Hebrew Language and Linguistics offers a systematic and comprehensive treatment of all aspects of the history and study of the Hebrew language from its earliest attested form to the present day. Accessibility statement for Brill Reference Works .

name: Encyclopedia of Jews in Eastern Europe (YIVO)
description: Encyclopedia of the history and culture of Jews in Eastern Europe, from the beginnings of their settlement in the region to the present. Covers arts, daily life, places, languages and literature, history and politics, and religion.

name: Encyclopedia of Jews in the Islamic World
description: Encyclopedia covering the Jews of Muslim lands, particularly in the late medieval, early modern and modern periods. Accessibility statement for Brill Reference Works .

name: Encyclopedia of Language and Linguistics
description: Encyclopaedia covering all aspects of linguistics. Around 3000 articles, and 1500 figures, plus supplementary audio and video files.

name: Encyclopedia of Neuroscience
description: Encyclopaedia covering all aspects of neurology, neurosurgery, psychiatry and other related areas of neuroscience. Written at a level suitable for undergraduates, but with wider appeal to professionals and academics.

name: Encyclopedia of the Neurological Sciences
description: Encyclopedia incorporating over 1100+ focused entries exploring a wide variety of topics in neurology, neurosurgery, psychiatry and related areas of neuroscience.

name: Energy Transition Show
description: Access for UCL students and staff only, On first use visit UCL registration form and register with your UCL email address. This podcast portal features straight talk about the world’s transition from fossil fuels to renewables with energy expert Chris Nelder.

name: Engineering Database (Proquest)
description: Offering access to thousands of full-text publications focusing on Engineering. With a diverse range of materials available, it includes coverage across multiple engineering disciplines and industries, such as biomedical, chemical, civil, computer, electrical, and mechanical engineering. Accessibility statement for ProQuest .

name: Engineering Village
description: Index of engineering and applied science publications. Includes Inspec and Compendex.

name: English Drama
description: More than 3,900 plays in verse and prose tracing the development of drama in English from the medieval mystery cycles to the comedies of Oscar Wilde. Can also be searched as part of Literature Online (LION).

name: English Historical Documents Online
description: English Historical Documents Online contains over 5,500 expertly indexed and fully searchable primary documents from 500-1914.

name: English Poetry
description: Contains essentially the complete English poetic canon from the 8th century to the early 20th. Over 160,000 poems by more than 1,250 poets are drawn from nearly 4,500 printed sources. Can also be searched as part of Literature Online (LION).

name: English Short Title Catalogue (ESTC)
description: The English Short Title Catalogue (ESTC) lists over 480,000 items from the collections of the British Library and over 2,000 other libraries which were published between 1473 and 1800. Items are mainly, but not exclusively, in English.

name: English-Corpora.org
description: Users must register with UCL email address and a password and link account to the University College London licence once every year, signing in is necessary each time you enter a corpus . We now have access to the full range of corpora from English-Corpora.org (previously known as the 'BYU Corpora'), including corpora for the study of American, British, and Canadian English (Corpus of Contemporary American English, Corpus of Historical American English, British National Corpus 1994, Strathy Corpus), of Global Web-Based English (GLOWBE), and of specific genres such as soap operas, TIME magazine, and British parliamentary proceedings.

name: Environmental History
description: Cross-search with other Gale/Cengage primary sources in Gale Primary Sources . Starting in the late nineteenth century, in direct response to the Industrial Revolution, forces in social and political spheres across the globe struggled to balance the good of the public and the planet against the economic exploitation of resources.This collection explores the history of the environment and conservation efforts across the globe from the late 1800s onwards. UCL has access to both parts: Conservation and Public Policy in America, 1870-1980 and Colonial Policy and Global Development, 1896-1993 . Accessibility statement for Gale Primary Sources

name: Environmental Science Database (ProQuest)
description: Full-text content of global literature across this field and related disciplines. Content is selected from several specialist topic resources in disciplines such as engineering, biotechnology, bacteriology, atmospheric science, ecology, and biology.

name: Epistemonikos
description: Epistemonikos is a collaborative, multilingual database of health evidence. It is a source of systematic reviews relevant for health-decision making and includes other types of scientific evidence

name: Equinox journals, recent content
description: Free access for all to most recent 12 months of all Equinox journals during the COVID-19 pandemic . Please select the pdf icon next to the article you require from the table of contents list, not from the article level.

name: ERIC (EBSCO)
types: Full-text resource; Grey literature; Indexing and abstracting database
description: Please note that ERIC will be undergoing a significant overhaul by the 24th April 2025 and new content from some journals will no longer be included. Please see the e-resources blog post for more information . See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . The Education Resource Information Center provides access to educational literature and resources. This database provides access to information from journals included in the Current Index of Journals in Education and Resources in Education Index.

name: ERIC (ProQuest)
types: Grey literature; Indexing and abstracting database
description: Please note that ERIC will be undergoing a significant overhaul by the 24th April 2025 and new content from some journals will no longer be included. Please see Education Research Index for newer content. Index to journal articles and research reports in education, including citation and abstract information from over 750 educational journals and related documents.

name: ERICA (ERIC Archive)
types: Grey literature; Indexing and abstracting database
description: For historical documents and grey literature preserved from ERIC, this community-led Data Rescue Project has archived over 500,000 files on the Internet Archive. The PDFs were rescued using the Internet Archive's Wayback Machine by a volunteer of the Data Rescue Project. When you click on one of the publication ID links, you will be redirected to the archived PDF in the the Wayback Machine. For current content see ProQuest's Education Research Index .

name: Espacenet : Patent search
description: Espacenet contains all the patent documentation available to European Patent Office examiners and the latest patent applications from all the EPO member states.

name: Essay and General Literature Retrospective (H.W. Wilson)
types: Indexing and abstracting database; Reference works
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . Reference database citing records contained in collections of essays and miscellaneous works published in the United States, Great Britain and Canada

name: Essential Science Indicators
description: In-depth analytical tool offering data for ranking scientists, institutions, countries, and journals. Part of Web of Science Journal and Highly Cited Data.

name: Essor Du Congo Digital Archive, 1930-1960
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Comprehensive record of  L’Essor du Congo , a major regional daily based in Élisabethville (now Lubumbashi). As a prominent voice in the mineral-rich Katanga province, the newspaper serves as a critical window into the administrative, social, and economic structures of the Belgian Congo during a period defined by intense industrial expansion and colonial exploitation.

name: Establishing the Post-War International Order, 1944-1961
description: Part of British Online Archives' Global Governance in the 20th Century series, this collection provides insight into the political, economic, and military foundations of the post-war international order. Most of the documents are derived from the annals of the British Board of Trade (i.e. BT 64), Cabinet Office (i.e. CAB 128), Foreign Office (i.e. FO 371), and Treasury (i.e. T 274).

name: Estoniia Digital Archive, 1984-2009
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Founded in 1991, Estoniia (Эстония, Estonia) was a popular Russian-language broadsheet newspaper published in Tallinn

name: ETANA : Electronic Tools and Ancient Near East Archives
alternate_names: Electronic Tools and Ancient Near East Archives
description: Electronic Tools and Ancient Near East Archives

name: Ethnographic Video Online
description: UCL has access to Vols. I and II: Foundational Films and Vol. III: Indigenous Voices.

name: Ethnologue: Languages of the World
description: A comprehensive reference work that provides information and statistics for all of the world’s known living languages. Language descriptions are organized by world area, UN region and country

name: Ethnomusicology: Global Field Recordings
types: Audio; Full-text resource; Images; Primary Sources; Video streaming
description: Produced in collaboration with the UCLA Ethnomusicology Archive, this resource is comprised of over 60 field collections from ethnomusicologists dating from the mid-twentieth century to the early twenty-first century. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: EThOS (e-theses online service)
types: Full-text resource; Indexing and abstracting database
description: Descriptions of over 650,000 theses from UK universities from the 1700s onwards. In many of the records in EThOS you will find a button ‘Access thesis from university’. This links to the metadata record of the thesis in the university repository, where it may be possible to download the thesis, if the university has made it available.

name: EUI Research Data Repository
description: EUI Research Data community provides access to datasets generated from EUI research, includes data previously in the EUDO Data Centre

name: EUR-Lex
description: Providing the official and most comprehensive access to EU legal documents. It is available in all of the EU’s 24 official languages and is updated daily.

name: Eurographics Digital Library
description: Includes full text of Eurographics Association publication.

name: Euromaidan Protests in Ukraine, 2013-2014
description: Collection of ephemera and primary source material from the Euromaidan protests that rocked Kiev beginning on 21st November, 2013. The collection contains over 500 pages of unique print materials.

name: Euromonitor Passport
description: See record for Passport .

name: Europe PMC
types: Full-text resource; Indexing and abstracting database
description: Providing comprehensive access to life sciences literature from trusted sources. Search and read 41.9 million publications, preprints and other documents enriched with links to supporting data, reviews, protocols, and other relevant resources.

name: European Bibliography of Slavic and East European Studies (EBSEES) 1991-2007
description: This database contains the data of two former EBSEES databases, one for 1991-2000, the other for 2001-2006. The new unified database with about 85.500 titles has been developed by the Berlin State Library in cooperation with the Maison des Sciences de l´Homme, Paris.

name: European Pharmacopoeia
description: Access for UCL students and staff only.  Contact the e-resources team to request access. The European Pharmacopoeia is the primary source of official quality standards for medicines and their ingredients in Europe. The standards provide a scientiﬁc basis for the quality control of a product throughout its life cycle, supporting the pharmaceutical industry and healthcare systems.

name: European Sources Online (ESO)
description: European Sources Online (ESO) provides access to information on the institutions and activities of the European Union, the countries, regions and other international organisations of Europe, and on issues of importance to European researchers, citizens and stakeholders

name: European Union: Your gateway to the EU (previously named Europa)
description: Website of the European Union (EU). Provides up-to-date coverage of European Union affairs and information on European integration.

name: European Views of the Americas: 1493 to 1750
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . A free archive of indexed publications related to the Americas and written in Europe before 1750. It includes thousands of valuable primary source records covering the history of European exploration as well as portrayals of Native American peoples.

name: Eurostat
description: Eurostat is the statistical office of the European Union, providing statistics that enable comparisons between countries and regions.

name: Everyday Life & Women in America c.1800-1920
description: This collection features primary source material for the study of American social, cultural, and popular history in the 19th and early 20th centuries. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Exe Libris - History of Education Society Bibliography
description: Allows users to search for articles published in the leading historical journals founded or edited in the British Isles since 1939, and in selected international journals specialising in the history of education.

name: Exploring Race in Society
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . Covering important issues related to race in society today. This database includes essays, articles, government reports, primary source documents and speeches and more  F

name: Fachportal Pädagogik - Education Research Portal (German Education Portal)
types: Indexing and abstracting database; Open Access
description: German-language database of references in the field of pedagogy/education with links to open access full-text if available. Text in German or English.

name: FactSet Revere Relationship data
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. FactSet Revere Relationship data. Access is via a WRDS account: select the Register tab, complete the Account Request form to create a username and password and wait for a confirmation access email (this can take a few days).

name: Faculti
description: UCL staff and students have access to a wide collection of Faculti videos in subject areas, including: Medicine, Law, Education, Business, Economics, Political Science, Arts and Humanities, Sciences, History, Psychology, Sociology, Engineering and Archive.

name: Faculti Sciences collection
description: Faculti videos covering both formal and natural sciences offering academic and professional research insights.

name: FAME
description: Access for UCL students and staff only, UCL sign in required . Company data on every registered business in the UK and Ireland

name: Family Health Database
description: Covering a range of subjects from sports injuries to women's health, food and nutrition to midwifery, eye care to dentistry. It includes general medical journals such as The Lancet and The New England Journal of Medicine as well consumer and news magazines.

name: FAMSI : Foundation for the Advancement of Mesoamerican Studies
description: Created in 1993 to foster increased understanding of ancient Mesoamerican cultures.

name: Fascist Press (1930-40) : UKPressOnline
description: All content of the newspapers Action, The Blackshirt and Fascist Week from their launch until they were banned.

name: fDi Markets
description: Login with UCL email address. Access is for current UCL students and staff only . Database of cross border greenfield investments covering all countries and sectors worldwide. Provides access to real-time monitoring of investment projects, capital investment and job creation.

name: FIAF International Index to Film Periodicals Database
description: Index of published literature on film and television.

name: Film Index International
description: Index over over 120,000 films and 700,000 personalities, plus coverage of international film awards and prizes, searchable plot summaries and full cast and crew lists. Based on the Summary of Film and Television (SIFT) database collated by the British Film Institute (bfi).

name: Financial Times (FT.com)
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. UCL username and password required. Registration is required on first visit to enable off-site and ePaper access. UCL users also have access to the app

name: Financial Times Historical Archive, 1888-2021
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Cross-search with other Gale/Cengage primary sources in Gale Primary Sources . The Financial Times Historical Archive delivers the complete searchable run of the worlds most authoritative daily business newspaper. Every item ever printed in the paper, from 1888-2021, can be searched and browsed article by article and page by page.

name: FindLaw
description: Website including codes and case law, legal forms, legal publishers, legal associations, law schools and law reviews, legal experts and continuing legal education courses. Includes channels for non-lawyers (business and public).

name: First World War
description: Primary sources for the study of the Great War, brought together in four thematic modules: Personal Experiences, Propaganda and Recruitment, Visual Perspectives and Narratives and A Global Conflict. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: First World War Poetry Digital Archive
description: Repository of primary data on First World War poetry. Includes over 4000 items of text, images, audio, and video for teaching, learning, and research.

name: Flavius Josephus online
description: The first comprehensive literary-historical online commentary on the works of Flavius Josephus in English. The commentary, edited by Steve Mason (University of Groningen), also includes the full Greek texts, edited by Benedikt Niese in the 19th century.

name: Food And Drink in History
description: The materials in this collection illustrate the deep links between food and identity, politics and power, gender, race and socio-economic status, as well as charting key issues around agriculture, nutrition and food production. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Foreign Broadcast Information Service Daily Reports
description: Transcribed and translated intercepted radio broadcasts from foreign governments, official news services, and clandestine broadcasts from occupied territories, covering 1941-1996.

name: Foreign Office Files for China, 1919-1980
description: The six parts of this collection make available all British Foreign Office files dealing with China, Hong Kong and Taiwan between 1919 and 1980:  - 1919-1929: Kuomintang, CCP and the Third International - 1930-1937: The Long March, civil war in China and the Manchurian Crisis - 1938-1948: Open Door, Japanese war and the seeds of communist victory - 1949-1956: The Communist revolution - 1957-1966: The Great Leap Forward - 1967-1980: The Cultural Revolution Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Foreign Office Files for India, Pakistan and Afghanistan, 1947-1980
description: Featuring the complete run of documents in the series DO 133, DO 134 and FCO 37, as well as all documents covering the Indian subcontinent in the FO 371 series. Events covered include independence and partition, the Indian annexation of Hyderabad and Goa, war between India and Pakistan, tensions and war between India and China, the consolidation of power of the Congress Party in India, military rule in Pakistan, the turbulent independence of Bangladesh and the development of nuclear weapons in the region. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Foreign Office Files for Japan, 1919-1952
description: Published in three parts, this collection makes available extensive coverage of British Foreign Office files dealing with Japan between 1919 and 1952. - Japanese Imperialism and the War in the Pacific, 1931-1945 - Occupation of Japan, 1946-1952 - Japan and Great Power Status, 1919-1930 Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Foreign Office Files for South East Asia, 1963-1980
description: Published in two parts, this extensive collection of Foreign Office Files explores South East Asia between 1963 and 1980 in a time of conflict, growth and change. - Cold War in the Pacific, Trade Relations and the Post-Independence Period, 1963-1966 - Foundations of Economic Growth and Industrialisation, 1967-1980 Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Foreign Office Files for the Middle East, 1971-1981 (Archives Direct)
description: Focusing on the 1970s this resource addresses the policies, economies, political relationships and significant events of every major Middle East power. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Foreign Office, Consulate and Legation Files: China: 1830-1939 (Archives Direct)
alternate_names: AM Explorer Archives Direct: Foreign Office, Consulate and Legation Files: China: 1830-1939
description: Access to Module 1: Wars and Treaties: 1830-1895, other modules to appear as they are published. Correspondence from the British legation and consulates in the cities of imperial and republican China, documenting Sino-British relations and myriad aspects of Chinese history from 1830 to 1939. Themes explored in the sources include politics, diplomacy, international relations, trade and the economy, military conflict, public health, missionaries, migration, war and revolution. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Former British Colonies Enslavement Registers
description: Featuring nearly 4 million records of people enslaved in 20 former British colonies during the 19th century. The registers represent the most comprehensive records of enslaved populations during the British Empire. Access with a free Ancestry account .

name: Fortunoff Video Archive for Holocaust Testimonies
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. More than 4,400 recorded testimonies of individuals with first-hand experience of the Nazi persecutions. Testimonies were recorded in each witness's preferred language and range in length from 30 minutes to over 40 hours. You will need to create an account to access the testimonies as well as logging in via UCL. Access the database using the link above then click login (top right) and then join now (right at the bottom of the pop up) Complete the form and click register – you will receive a verification email Access the database again, login if necessary and run a search. Click on testimony and then click request access – you will need to do this even though you are logged in but you will only need to do it for the first testimony you access. Once you receive the approval email, refresh your browser and you should have access. You will now be able to access the whole collection by logging in via UCL and then with the account you just created.

name: Frantext
description: Full text of over 3650 French texts from the 16th to the 20th century, plus 1940 lemmatized modern texts of 1.5 billion characters, plus some texts from the 9th - 15th centuries.

name: frieze Magazine
description: Full text of frieze magazine, including back issues from volume 1. Features emerging artists and fresh perspectives on more established artists. Includes exhibition reviews, interviews, city reports and worldwide listings.

name: Frontier Life: Borderlands, Settlement & Colonial Encounters
description: Focusing on the various European and colonial frontier regions of North America, Africa and Australasia through documents that reveal the lives of settlers and indigenous peoples in these areas from 1650-1920. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer. G

name: Gale Academic OneFile
description: Providing access to millions of articles from over 17,000 scholarly journals and other authoritative sources, including videos from BBC Worldwide Learning to thousands of podcasts and transcripts from CNN.

name: Gale Business Insights
description: Combining Gale reference content with respected business sources and full-text periodicals to help understand today's global business environment, this collection contains more than 430,000 detailed company profiles with company financial data, in-depth country overviews, and comprehensive industry profiles.

name: Gale eBooks
description: Collection of Gale's reference and handbooks that you can view and search online.

name: Gale General OneFile
description: Gale’s largest general-interest periodical resource, Gale General OneFile, provides periodical and news information. Accessibility statement for Gale General OneFile .

name: Gale Literary Index
description: Providing access to author and title listings from over 130 literature products from Gale and the imprints Charles Scribner's Sons, St. James Press, and Twayne Publishers. The referenced products themselves contain complete biographies on authors and critical essays on their writings.

name: Gale Literature Criticism
types: Full-text resource; Indexing and abstracting database; Primary Sources
description: The ten Gale series that comprise Gale Literature Criticism represent a range of modern and historical views on authors and their works in all areas of literature. They are: Children's Literature Review, Classical and Medieval Literature Criticism, Contemporary Literary Criticism, Drama Criticism, Literature Criticism from 1400 to 1800, Nineteenth-Century Literature Criticism, Poetry Criticism, Shakespearean Criticism, Short Story Criticism and Twentieth-Century Literary Criticism

name: Gale Literature Resource Center
types: Full-text resource; Indexing and abstracting database
description: Focusing on literature analyses and providing up-to-date biographical information, overviews, full-text literary criticism and reviews on more than 175,000 writers in all disciplines, time periods, and regions of the world

name: Gale Literature: Contemporary Authors
description: Biographical information on more than 149,000 modern novelists, poets, playwrights, nonfiction writers, journalists and scriptwriters.

name: Gale Literature: Dictionary of Literary Biography
description: Online version of the Dictionary of Literary Biography, providing biographical and critical essays on the lives, works and careers of the world's most influential literary figures.

name: Gale Literature: LitFinder
types: Full-text resource; Indexing and abstracting database
description: Provides access to literary works and authors throughout history and includes more than 130,000 full-text poems and 650,000+ poetry citations, as well as short stories, speeches, and plays. The database also includes secondary materials like biographies, images, and more

name: Gale Literature: Scribner Writer Series
description: Browse original scholarly essays on authors from around the world. Places authors and their works in personal and historical context.

name: Gale Literature: Something About the Author
description: Online access to Gale's Something About the Author series, which examines the lives and works of authors and illustrators for children and young adults and is the preeminent source on authors and literature for young people. Something About the Author includes both the main series and Something About the Author Autobiography Series, totaling more than 290 volumes, 20,000 entries, and nearly 30,000 images

name: Gale Literature: Twayne's Author Series
description: Offers in-depth introductions to the lives and works of writers, the history and influence of literary movements and to the development of literary genres.

name: Gale OneFile News
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Gale OneFile: News provides access to more than 2,300 major world newspapers, and includes thousands of images, radio and TV broadcasts and transcripts.

name: Gale Primary Sources
description: Cross search many of Gale Cengage's databases in one platform

name: Gale Research Complete
types: Full-text resource; Indexing and abstracting database
description: Gale Research Complete provides access to millions of pages of primary sources, e-reference and periodical content

name: Gallica
description: Digital library from the Bibliotheque nationale de France. Includes both digitized texts and images. Focuses on French culture and life, including science and the history of science, economics, law, politics, philosophy, literature, history and ethnology. Most texts are in image (facsimile) form, although some are in fully searchable text.

name: Gallup Analytics
description: Gallup Analytics contains unique public opinion data and analysis compiled by Gallup. It includes answers to more than 125,000 questions, and responses from more than 3.5 million people interviewed in the United States since 1935.

name: Garland Encyclopedia of World Music
alternate_names: Music Online: The Garland Encyclopedia of World Music
description: Comprehensive resource devoted to World Music research. More than 9,000 pages of material and 300 audio recordings, combined with entries by over 700 expert contributors from all over the world. Accessibility statement for Garland Encyclopedia of World Music .

name: Gartner
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. For more information please see the UCL ISD Gartner page . Gartner is the leading provider of research and analysis on the global IT industry.

name: Gender: Identity and Social Change
description: Documenting the changing representations and lived experiences of gender roles and relations from the nineteenth century to the present. This collection offers sources for the study of women's suffrage, the feminist movement, the men’s movement, employment, education, the body, the family, and government and politics. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: GEOBASE
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to Ovid . This database can be accessed by no more than 4 users at a time. Index of literature in the fields of physical and human geography, geology, oceanography, geomechanics, mineralogy, ecology and development studies.

name: GeoLagret
description: Platform featuring publications, maps and other publisher material of Sveriges Geologiska Undersökning , SGU

name: GeoRef
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to Ovid . Index of literature in the geosciences. See GeoRef InProcess for provisional content.

name: GeoRef InProcess
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to Ovid . Records of the American Geological Institute's geoscience database that have not yet been indexed completely. These records will appear in GeoRef once they are indexed fully.

name: Georgia Parliamentary Election, 2012
description: Collection of election related ephemera and primary source material documenting the Georgian parliamentary elections of October 1, 2012. It contains thousands of pages of unique print materials from Tbilisi and other Georgian cities

name: Georgia Presidential Election, 2013
description: The 2013 elections were held in a highly charged political atmosphere. This collection includes flyers, leaflets, political programs, and various other ephemera produced by the candidates

name: Gilded Age and Progressive Era
description: Focusing on America’s transformative age of industrialisation, expanding wealth, inequality and social change. Personal collections, business records and rich visual content offer fresh perspectives on this influential period. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Girlhood: Magazines and Print Culture
description: Bringing together a rich collection of highly graphic and illustrative annuals, comics, magazines and periodicals that facilitate the study of print culture aimed at girls throughout the twentieth century. This collection features content from across the UK, US and Australia, and offers an insight into the lives of girls and young women as they navigate rapidly evolving significant social, cultural, and political change. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer .

name: GLA Affordable Housing Toolkit
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. UCL username and password required to view data. The GLA Toolkit provides the user with an assessment of the economics of residential development for specific schemes.

name: Global Commodities: Trade, Exploration & Cultural Exchange
description: This resource brings together manuscript, printed and visual primary source materials for the study of global commodities in world history. The commodities have been transported, exchanged and consumed around the world for hundreds of years and helped transform societies, global trading operations, habits of consumption and social practices. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Global Governance in the 20th Century
description: Comprising of the collections: Establishing the Post-War International Order, 1944-1961; Paris Peace Conference and Beyond, 1919-1939; and Prosecuting the Holocaust: British Investigations into Nazi Crimes, 1944-1949

name: Global Health (1910-present)
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to Ovid . Specialist bibliographic abstracting and indexing database dedicated to public health. Derived from over 16,000 journals, reports, books and conferences, Global Health adds over 25,000 scientific records each year.

name: Global History of Epidemics, 1800-1970
types: Full-text resource; Images; Primary Sources; Video streaming
description: Primary source collection to enable research into a pivotal part of history for public health and medicinal advancement. Sources include correspondence, official reports, diagrams, photographs and film footage exploring developments in disease prevention, outbreak management, sanitation and public welfare as well as tracking the spread and treatment of major epidemics and pandemics across the globe in the nineteenth and twentieth centuries. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Global Index Medicus
types: Full-text resource; Indexing and abstracting database
description: Provides worldwide access to biomedical and public health literature produced by and within low- and middle- income countries. The main objective is to increase the visibility and usability of this important set of resources

name: Global Plants : JSTOR
types: Full-text resource; Images; Primary Sources; Reference works
description: Global Plants is the world’s largest database of digitized plant specimens. The collection features nearly three million high-resolution type specimens and also includes partner-contributed reference works and primary sources, such as collectors’ correspondence and diaries, paintings, drawings, and photographs.   Accessibility statement for JSTOR .

name: Gnomon Bibliographic Database (GBD)
description: Classical Studies database, comprising 600.000 entries of specialized literature, including entries on the history of scholarship. The database lists monographies, edited volumes with all contributions, journal articles, reviews, and dictionaries from all of the modern era and in all academic languages, all of which are researchable in detail with a comprehensive, multinlingual thesaurus (currently ca. 25.000 catchwords)

name: Google Arts & Culture
description: Google Arts & Culture is an online platform of high-resolution images and videos of artworks and cultural artifacts from partner cultural organizations throughout the world.

name: Google Image Search
description: Search for images on the Web. Part of the Google web search engine.

name: Google Scholar
description: UCL has activated findit@UCL links in Google Scholar. If you are using a UCL computer, you should see these links automatically. If you are outside the UCL network and want to display findit@UCL links, you will need to set UCL in 'Library Links' within the Settings menu.

name: Governing Africa, 1808-1995
description: Comprising of the collections: Apartheid Through the Eyes of South African Political Parties, 1948-1994; Colonial Africa in Official Statistics, 1821-1953; Colonial Law in Africa, 1808-1919; Colonial Law in Africa, 1920-1945; Colonial Law in Africa, 1946-1966; Gambia Under Colonial Rule, in Government Reports, 1881-1966; Ghana and Togo Under Colonial Rule, in Government Reports, 1843-1957; Kenya Under Colonial Rule, in Government Reports, 1907-1964; Malawi Under Colonial Rule, in Government Reports, 1907-1967; Nigeria and Cameroon Under Colonial Rule, in Government Reports, 1887-1962; Reporting on Africa: From Apartheid to Pan-Africanism, 1949-1995; Sierra Leone Under Colonial Rule, in Government Reports, 1893-1961; Uganda Under Colonial Rule, in Government Reports, 1903-1961; and Zimbabwe Under Colonial Rule, in Government Reports, 1897-1980

name: GovInfo - U.S. Government information
description: GovInfo provides free online access to official publications from all three branches of the Federal Government

name: Grand Tour
description: A collection to primary and secondary sources: artworks, photographs and maps for the study of travel, c1550-1850. Accessibility statement for The Grand Tour .

name: Grants Index
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to Web of Science . This database indexes several million grants with metadata, linking them to associated Web of Science publications.

name: GreenFILE
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . Index of scholarly, government and general-interest publications, covering all aspects of human impact on the environment.

name: Guildhall Library
description: Public reference library which specialises in the history of London, especially the City, as well as having other significant collections of printed books, manuscripts, prints, maps and drawings. H

name: H1 Connect
description: Create a free account to access the H1 Connect content. Index of top research papers in the biological and medical sciences, based on recommendations and ratings from well over 1000 leading scientists. Papers are arranged into "faculties" or topic areas.

name: Handbook of Latin American Studies
description: Bibliography of materials selected and annotated by scholars, evaluating books, book chapters, articles, and conference proceedings published worldwide in the field of Latin American studies. Multilingual and multidisciplinary.

name: Handbuch des Antisemitismus Online
description: Compiling knowledge on the phenomenon of Judaeophobia, this database contains all of the 2,200 entries of the print version of the Handbuch des Antisemitismus (8 volumes, 2008–2015). Accessibility statement for De Gruyter .

name: Handel Reference Database
description: Handel Reference Database (HRD) is the largest collection of primary sources on any composer. Hosted by the Center for Computer Assisted Research in the Humanities at Stanford University, it offers public access to key documents on the composer and his contemporaries touching broadly on 18th-century British theatre and culture.

name: HathiTrust Digital Library
description: HathiTrust Digital Library is a digital preservation repository. UCL users can access the freely available services: search and access fully viewable materials, and download materials where there are no third-party restrictions. However UCL users can't download all books or create collections.

name: Health & Medical Collection (ProQuest)
description: Combines clinical research titles with hundreds of consumer and health administration titles. ProQuest Health and Medical Complete provides in-depth coverage from over 1,780 publications with over 1,550 available in full text and of these, over 910 include MEDLINE indexing.

name: Health and Psychosocial Instruments (HAPI)
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to Ovid . This database can be accessed by no more than 5 users at a time. Index of articles on a wide variety of evaluation and measurement tools for health and psychosocial studies, for practitioners, educators, researchers, and students.

name: Health Management Database (ProQuest)
description: This database is a collection of reliable and relevant resources in the field of health administration, including journals and dissertations.

name: Hebrew and Aramaic Lexicon of the Old Testament Online
alternate_names: The Hebrew and Aramaic Lexicon of the Old Testament Online
description: Contains the complete vocabulary of the Hebrew Bible, including texts in Aramaic. Accessibility statement for Brill Primary Sources .

name: Hebrew dictionary (Rav-Milim)
description: English-Hebrew/Hebrew-English dictionary. Includes an extensive Hebrew Thesaurus. A dictionary of idioms and phrases, an automatic rhyming dictionary

name: HEER / Higher Education Empirical Research Database
description: HEER database is an archive of summaries of published research on a range of topics related to higher education, stretching back over 10 years. Free to register and fully searchable by theme, publisher and date.

name: HeinOnline Databases
description: A collection of legal research materials, primarily US-focused, but also encompassing international law and other jurisdictions. It includes Law Journal Library; the English Reports; treatises on law and politics dating from the seventeenth to the twentieth centuries; United Nations treaties; the United States Reports and other US primary materials. Accessibility statement for HeinOnline Databases .

name: HeinOnline Intellectual Property Law Collection
description: Collection of intellectual property material including legislative histories, treatises, documents, books, periodicals, and more relating to copyrights, patents, and trademarks.

name: HeinOnline Law Journal Library
description: Collection of more than 3,200 fully searchable, image-based journals, each dating back to the first issue ever published. This scholarly journals database spans more than 43 million pages and 40 disciplines. Accessibility statement for HeinOnline Law Journal Library .

name: HeinOnline Philip C. Jessup Library
description: Online collection of the materials of the Philip C. Jessup International Law Moot Court Competition

name: Henry Stewart Talks - Biomedical and Life Sciences
description: Over 500 seminar style audio visual talks presented by leading world experts in the biomedical and life sciences. Animated slides with synchronized narration.

name: HeritageGateway
description: This website allows you to cross-search over 60 resources, offering local and national information relating to England’s heritage.

name: HESA Destinations of Leavers (Higher Education Statistics Agency)
