description: Access for UCL students and staff only via UCL username and password. Data files for HESA Destinations of Leavers from 2009 onwards. Files need to be decompressed (unzipped). Mac users - double-click file. PC users - save the file, right-click the zipped file and select Extract All.

name: HESA Finances of Higher Education Institutions (Higher Education Statistics Agency)
description: Access for UCL students and staff only via UCL username and password. Data files for HESA Finances of Higher Education Institutions from 2009 onwards. Files need to be decompressed (unzipped). Mac users - double-click file. PC users - save the file, right-click the zipped file and select Extract All.

name: HESA HE Business and Community Interaction (Higher Education Statistics Agency)
alternate_names: Higher Education Statistics Agency Data Files
description: Access for UCL students and staff only via UCL username and password. Data from 2015 onwards on HESA website. 2009-2015 data files are stored on the UCL intranet . Files need to be decompressed (unzipped). Mac users - double-click file. PC users - save the file, right-click the zipped file and select Extract All.

name: HESA Higher Education Statistics for the UK (Higher Education Statistics Agency)
alternate_names: Higher Education Statistics for the UK
description: Access for UCL students and staff only via UCL username and password. Data files for HESA Higher Education Statistics for the UK from 2008 onwards. Files need to be decompressed (unzipped). Mac users - double-click file. PC users - save the file, right-click the zipped file and select Extract All.

name: HESA Staff in Higher Education Institutions (Higher Education Statistics Agency)
alternate_names: Higher Education Statistics Agency Data Files
description: Access for UCL students and staff only via UCL username and password. Data files for HESA Staff from 2009 onwards. Files need to be decompressed (unzipped). Mac users - double-click file. PC users - save the file, right-click the zipped file and select Extract All.

name: HESA Students in Higher Education Institutions (Higher Education Statistics Agency)
alternate_names: Higher Education Statistics Agency Data Files
description: Access for UCL students and staff only via UCL username and password. Data from 2016 onwards on HESA website. 2009-2016 data files are stored on the UCL intranet . Files need to be decompressed (unzipped). Mac users - double-click file. PC users - save the file, right-click the zipped file and select Extract All.

name: Hindi Cinema: Histories of Film-making
description: Featuring candid, unedited interviews from the private collection of author and film-maker Nasreen Munni Kabir, Hindi Cinema offers a unique insight into the film industry from the years 1950-2010 through the experiences of leading film-makers. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer .

name: Hispanic American Periodicals Index (HAPI)
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . HAPI is a bibliographic database providing citations to the contents of scholarly journals published around the world on Latin America and the Caribbean since the late 1960s.

name: Historic England: Find Photos
description: Dating from the 1850s onwards, the Historic England archive holds over 9 million photographs of the historic environment

name: Historic England: Research Reports
description: Map-based search that locates Historic England research reports on specific buildings or sites, large-area aerial survey mapping programme, and commissioned research.

name: Historical Abstracts
types: Indexing and abstracting database; Reference works
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . This database can be accessed by no more than 6 users at a time. Complete reference guide to the history of the world from 1450 to the present (excl. the United States and Canada - see America: History and Life).

name: Historical Atlas of Islam
description: Featuring maps and articles covering the history and geography of Islam. Accessibility statement for Brill Reference Works .

name: Historical Data UK
description: The repository’s focus is on macroeconomic and financial market data, but it includes a range of economic data disaggregated at a sector, industry and regional level. It contains around 4,000 digitised statistical publications, including complete sets of the core Central Statistics Office (CSO) and past ONS publications.

name: Historische Bibliographie Online
description: This database contains bibliographic entries on historical specialist literature that was published between 1990 and 2013. Accessibility statement for De Gruyter .

name: Historisches Wörterbuch der Philosophie : HWPh
description: Based on the history of philosophical concepts, rather than on the history of philosophical ideas or problems, the HWPh documents the origin and genesis of a total of 3670 philosophical terms, describing the change in their meaning and function from their first appearance to the present day .

name: History of Disabilities: Disabilities in Society, Seventeenth to Twentieth Century
description: Cross-search with other Gale/Cengage primary sources in Gale Primary Sources . Providing historical evidence demonstrating how society has interacted with and regarded individuals considered to have disabilities. Accessibility statement for Gale Primary Sources .

name: History of Science, Technology & Medicine (EBSCO)
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . This database can be accessed by no more than 1 user at a time. Integrates four bibliographiesthe Isis Current Bibliography of the History of Science, the Current Bibliography in the History of Technology, the Bibliografia Italiana di Storia della Scienza and the Wellcome Library for the History and Understanding of Medicine.

name: History On-Line
description: Information about web resources for historians, and about the history profession (books, journal articles, current research and teaching, and university lecturers).

name: HM Treasury
description: Website of the Treasury, the United Kingdom's economics and finance ministry which is responsible for formulating and implementing the Government's financial and economic policy.

name: HMIC (Health Management)
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to Ovid . This database can be accessed by no more than 4 users at a time. Guide to literature on health management and policy, with an emphasis on the UK National Health Service, but also including Europe (including Eastern Europe) and developing countries.

name: Holos Ukrainy Digital Archive : 1991-
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Can also be viewed and cross-searched within East View Global Press Archive . Founded in 1991, shortly before the dissolution of the Soviet Union, Holos Ukrainy (Голос України, Voice of Ukraine) is one of the most important Ukrainian dailies. Partially funded by the state, the newspaper is the official organ of the Ukrainian parliament, the Verkhovna Rada.

name: HUDOC
description: The HUDOC database provides access to the case-law of the European Court of Human Rights (Grand Chamber, Chamber and Committee judgments and decisions, communicated cases, advisory opinions and legal summaries from the Case-Law Information Note), the European Commission of Human Rights (decisions and reports) and the Committee of Ministers (resolutions).

name: Human Rights Studies Online
types: Audio; Full-text resource; Images; Primary Sources; Video streaming
description: Providing comparative documentation, analysis, and interpretation of major human rights violations and atrocity crimes worldwide from 1900 to 2010, the collection includes primary and secondary materials across multiple media formats and content types. Selected events include Armenia, the Holocaust, Cambodia, Bosnia-Herzegovina, Rwanda and Darfur.

name: Humanities & Social Sciences Index Retrospective: 1907-1984 (H.W. Wilson)
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . Containing over a million citations, this archive index covers important humanities and social sciences journals published from 1907 to 1984. High-quality indexing includes articles and book reviews.

name: Humanities Index (BHI)
description: Previously called BHI: British Humanities Index. Index of published literature in the humanities, covering humanities journals and weekly magazines, as well as quality newspapers published in the UK and the United States.

name: Humanities Index Retrospective: 1907-1984 (H.W. Wilson)
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . Forms part of the Humanities & Social Sciences Index Retrospective: 1907-1984 (H.W. Wilson)

name: Humanities International Index
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . Humanities International Index is a comprehensive database covering journals, books and other important reference sources in the humanities.

name: Hungarian Reformation
description: Collection of writings of writings of the Hungarian reformers, 1540s-1650s, including early texts and later works for the established churches. Accessibility statement for Brill Primary Sources . I

name: i-Law Maritime & Commercial
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. On first use, users must create an account using your UCL email address and a unique password. A verification email will be sent to your UCL account. Once registered, please access i-Law Maritime & Commercial and login for full content. Please note that it is best to register on Chrome. Passwords need to be reset annually. Maritime & Commercial practice area of the i-Law database, providing cases, books, journals, legislation and treaties. Includes Lloyd's Law Reports and the Lloyd's Shipping Law Library.

name: IAReporter
description: Investment Arbitration Reporter is a news & analysis service tracking international arbitrations between foreign investors and sovereign governments

name: IBISWorld
description: Country specific and Global Industry / Business research reports providing key analysis on performance, industry outlook, markets, competitive landscape, major companies, operating conditions and key statistics.

name: IBSS: International Bibliography of the Social Sciences (ProQuest)
description: Index of literature in the social sciences and related subjects.

name: ICE Virtual Library Journals
description: Access to the ICE journals collection only . Comprehensive civil engineering journal portfolio with 19 specialist engineering journals (ICE Proceedings suite) each focusing on a sub-discipline of civil engineering, 11 leading research journals (such as Géotechnique and Magazine of Concrete Research) and our 5 material science journals.  Accessibility statement for ICE Virtual Library .

name: ICONDA
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to Ovid . This database can be accessed by no more than 5 users at a time. Index of literature on all aspects of planning and building.

name: ICPSR
description: You need to create an account in order to download data. ICPSR acquires, preserves, enhances, and distributes original social science research data for research and instruction.

name: ICRG Researchers' Dataset Table 3B (Political Risk)
description: The ICRG Researcher's Dataset - Table 3B provides annual averages of the 12 components of ICRG's Political Risk Ratings (Table 3B), as published in the International Country Risk Guide since 1984. Average ratings are provided for all countries covered by ICRG from 1984 through the last full calendar year.

name: IDP Database of Research on International Education
types: Full-text resource; Indexing and abstracting database
description: Managed by the Australian Council for Educational Research (ACER) this database indexes more than 13,800 books, articles, conference papers and reports on various aspects of international education. Content is from 1990 onwards, a period of major change in education systems around the world and in the trade in educational services.

name: IEA Statistics Package (ISP)
description: IEA statistics previously in OECD iLibrary, to be viewed via WDS, covers: World Energy Statistics World Energy Balances Coal Information Electricity Information Natural Gas Information Oil Information Renewables Information Greenhouse Gas Emissions from Energy Energy End-uses and Efficiency Indicators Energy Prices, including OECD Energy Prices and Taxes - Quarterly, World Energy Prices, Monthly Prices Energy Technology RD&D Budgets Projections: Energy policies of OECD countries Energy Projections of IEA Countries – with Extended Transitions Indicators IEA Energy and Carbon Tracker

name: IEEE Xplore
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to IEEE Xplore . Full text access to a vast collection of technical literature from IEEE and IEE primarily related to Engineering disciplines and Computer Science, including the fields of electrical engineering and electronics. Accessibility statement for IEEE Xplore .

name: IET Open Access Journals
alternate_names: Institution of Engineering and Technology Open Access Journals IET Research Hub
description: Portfolio of over 40 fully Open Access journals offers a wealth of research and information in a wide range of engineering and technology fields.

name: Illustrated London News
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Cross-search with other Gale/Cengage primary sources in Gale Primary Sources . Contains over 260,000 fully searchable and browseable full colour pages from 1842-2003. The Illustrated London News was the world's first illustrated weekly newspaper and presented a vivid picture of British and world events: including war, disasters, royalty, social affairs, the arts and science.

name: ILOSTAT
description: View and download data and metadata for over 200 countries or territories from LABORSTA, an International Labour Office database on labour statistics operated by the ILO Department of Statistics.

name: Imparcial Digital Archive, 1918-1979
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: A Puerto Rican newspaper with a liberal ideology, it began publication on November 1, 1918 and frontpage headlines included the end of the WWI, the actions of the Bolsheviks, their allies and their enemies after the Russian Revolution of 1917, along with the reactions and stances taken by the United States on these international issues

name: Imperial Russia's Illustrated Press
description: The illustrated weeklies gathered in this collection open a window on Russian cultural, social, and political life. Tracing the sweep of the Russian imagination at the apogee of Russian cultural power from the peak years of Dostoevsky and Tolstoy to the modernist era and the chaos of 1917. They captured imperial expansion, cultural innovation, high fashion, graphic arts, performing arts, grand funerals and anniversaries, occasions of state, wonders of science, and domestic and foreign politics. Accessibility statement for Brill Primary Sources .

name: Imperial Russian Newspapers, 1767-1918
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: The Imperial Russian Newspapers collection comprises out-of-copyright newspapers spanning the eighteenth, nineteenth and early twentieth centuries, up to the 1917 Bolshevik Revolution

name: InCites
description: Access until 31st October 2026. Please see Dimensions as a similar resource. Registration required to create a password for access . See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to Incites . InCites is a citation-based evaluation tool to analyze institutional productivity and benchmark research output in a national or international context. Part of Web of Science.

name: Independence Evening Post Digital Archive, 1947-1995
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Founded in 1947 as Taiwan’s first Chinese-language evening newspaper, The Independence Evening Post (Zi Li Wan Bao) quickly established a reputation as the sole pro-independence, pro-democracy newspaper during the period of martial law in Taiwan (1949-1987)

name: Independent and Revolutionary Mexican Newspapers, 1807-1972
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Comprising of nearly 1,000 titles from Mexico’s pre-independence, independence, and revolutionary periods (1807-1929), the newspapers in this collection offer documentation of the events of this era and include coverage of Mexican partisan politics, yellow press, political and social satire, as well as local, regional, national, and international news.

name: Independent Historical Archive, 1986-2021
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Cross-search with other Gale/Cengage primary sources in Gale Primary Sources . Launched in 1986, The Independent has enjoyed a reputation for quality and innovation, something its founders made as a guiding principle when they conceived the idea of a new, upmarket British newspaper.

name: Independent Publishing in America
description: Exploring the origins of the American book trade through the archival records of US-based presses, bookstores, printers, booksellers, and more. Comprising of material from both mainstream and small independent presses, the latter of which emerged predominantly in the second half of the twentieth century and often served authors and readerships from marginalized communities. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Independent Voices
types: E-journal collection; Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Digital collection of alternative press newspapers, magazines and journals produced by feminists, dissident GIs, campus radicals, Native Americans, anti-war activists, Black Power advocates, Hispanics, LGBT activists, the extreme right-wing press and alternative literary magazines during the latter half of the 20th century

name: Index Chemicus (part of WoS Core Collection)
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to Web of Science . Index Chemicus, accessed via Web of Science, provides users with quick, powerful access to the chemical compound information they need to find research data, analyze trends, journals and researchers, and share their findings.

name: Index of Medieval Art
description: A thematic and iconographic index of early Christian and medieval art objects. The database is both text and image although some works of art may not have an accompanying image. The database is based on the Index of Christian Art begun at Princeton University in 1917, and contains approximately thirty percent of the paper files developed up to 1991 as well as all works electronically indexed since then.

name: Index of References Dealing with Talmudic Literature (Saul Lieberman Institute)
description: Also searches Sol and Evelyn Henkind Talmud Text Databank and Primary Textual Witnesses to Tannaitic Literature

name: Index to Foreign Legal Periodicals
description: The Index to Foreign Legal Periodicals (IFLP) is a multilingual index to articles and book reviews that appear in hundreds of legal journals published worldwide.

name: Index to Legal Periodicals and Books (EBSCO)
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . Index to Legal Periodicals & Books provides indexing of 850 legal journals, law reviews, yearbooks, institutes, bar association publications, university publications, and government publications, as well as coverage of 1,400 monographs per year.

name: Index to Legal Periodicals Retrospective: 1908-1981 (H.W. Wilson)
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . Archive index covering legal periodicals published in the United States, Canada, Great Britain, Ireland, Australia and New Zealand between 1908 and 1981. Topics include criminal law, federal law, international law, medical law and more.

name: Index to Yiddish Periodicals (IYP)
description: An ongoing Yiddish language bibliographical project in which the contents of nearly 1000 periodicals published worldwide from 1862 onward are recorded.

name: India Database (ProQuest)
description: Multidisciplinary resource of full-text, scholarly journals published in India, supporting many subjects, including business, medicine, science, technology, social sciences and humanities.

name: India under Colonial Rule, 1752-1933
description: Comprising of the collections: The British Raj: Resistance and Reform in India, 1879-1910; The East India Company: Corrupt Governance and Cruelty in India, 1806-1814; The East India Company: Laying the Foundations for British Colonial Domination of India, 1752-1774; Indian and Sri Lankan Records from Colonial Missionaries, 1770-1931; Indian Communists and Trade Unionists on Trial: The Meerut Conspiracy, 1929-1933; and World News in Indian Newspapers, 1782-1908

name: India, Raj and Empire
description: Exploring the history of South Asia between the foundation of the East India Company in 1615 and the granting of independence to India and Pakistan in 1947, through the manuscript collections of the National Library of Scotland. Accessibility statement for India, Raj and Empire.

name: Indian Political Intelligence Files, 1912–1950
alternate_names: Brill Primary Source British Colonial Policy and Intelligence Files on Asia and the Middle East, c. 1880–1950
description: Part of British Colonial Policy and Intelligence Files on Asia and the Middle East, c. 1880–1950. This collection features files from the Indian Political Intelligence (IPI), an organization within the India Office in London, which monitored activities aimed at undermining the British government of India. These were declassified in 1997. Accessibility statement for Brill Primary Sources .

name: Indigenous Histories and Cultures in North America
description: Explore manuscripts, artwork and rare printed books dating from the earliest contact with European settlers right up to photographs and newspapers from the mid-twentieth century. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Indigenous Newspapers in North America
description: From historic pressings to contemporary periodicals, this collection explores nearly 200 years of Indigenous print journalism from the US and Canada. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Indigenous Peoples of North America
description: Cross-search with other Gale/Cengage primary sources in Gale Primary Sources . Providing insight into the cultural, political, and social history of Native Peoples from the seventeenth to the twentieth century, UCL users have access to both collections. Accessibility statement for Gale Primary Sources .

name: Industrial Revolution in Britain and the World, 1635-1970
description: Comprising of the collections: Bristol Shipping Records: Imports and Exports, 1770-1917; British Poor Schools in the Nineteenth Century, 1812-1901; The Church of England and Social Change in Manchester, 1635-1928; Essays and Dissertations of the Scottish Royal Medical Society, 1751-1970; The Industrial Revolution: Technological Innovation in the Textile Industry, 1672-1929; Liverpool Shipping Records: Imports and Exports, 1820-1900 - Parts 1-4; Liverpool Through Time: From Slavery to the Industrial Revolution, 1766-1900; and Records from Bethlem Royal Hospital, 1559-1932

name: InforM25 Library Catalogue
description: Integrated library catalogue from the M25 Consortium of academic libraries in and around London. Searches the catalogues of over 45 libraries.

name: Inscriptiones Graecae
description: The project’s publication series, the Greek inscriptions of Europe are edited on the following plan: IG I–III Athens and Attica; IG IV–VI the Peloponnese; IG VII–IX Central Greece; IG X Northern Greece, Thrace, Skythia; IG XI–XII Aegean Islands; IG XIII Crete; IG XIV Italy and Sicily; IG XV Cyprus.

name: Inspec (Engineering Village)
description: Inspec indexes journals and conference proceedings in the fields of physics, electrical engineering, electronics, computing, control engineering, manufacturing and production engineering, communications and information technology.

name: Inspec Analytics
description: A publication-based evaluation tool to analyse research activity in fields or by institutions. Focused on engineering and physics

name: Institute for Fiscal Studies
description: Website of the Institute for Fiscal Studies, an independent economic research organisation based in the UK. Its aim is to promote effective economic and social policies through rigorous analysis of their impact on individuals, families, firms and the public finances.

name: IntelliNews Pro
description: Delivering market news and reports, in English, for over 15 countries in Central and Eastern Europe and regionally for the Middle East/North Africa, Nigeria/Ivory Coast, Sub Saharan Africa, and Asia

name: International Affairs Digital Archive : 1955-
description: Journal of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Russia offers analysis of foreign policy and international security issues.

name: International African Bibliography Online
description: International and interdisciplinary specialist bibliography of African Studies offering access to approx. Includes 140,000 entries from 1971 to 2015 with approx. 4,000 new entries per year, including non-English speaking publications. Accessibility statement for De Gruyter .

name: International Encyclopedia of the Social and Behavioural Sciences
description: Encyclopedia comprising of over 4,000 articles and including over 90,000 bibliographic references as well as comprehensive name and subject indexes. Features articles on rapidly evolving subjects such as pyschiatry, neurology, evolution, artificial intelligence, human/computer interaction.

name: International Federation of Library Associations and Institutions (IFLA)
description: Information about IFLA, an international body representing the interests of library and information services and their users. The website provides directories of organisations and a collection of online documents.

name: International Herald Tribune Historical Archive, 1887-2013
description: Cross-search with other Gale/Cengage primary sources in Gale Primary Sources . Featuring the complete run of the International Herald Tribune from its origins as the European Edition of The New York Herald and later the European Edition of the New York Herald Tribune.

name: International Medieval Bibliography
description: Index of literature on all subjects relating to the Middle Ages, within the date range 400-1500 AD. Geographical areas covered are Europe, the Middle East and North Africa.

name: International Monetary Fund (IMF)
description: Website of the IMF, an organisation of 184 countries which works to promote the health and stability of the global economy, providing technical and financial assistance to developing countries.

name: International Monetary Fund Data and Statistics (IMF)
description: The IMF publishes a range of time series data on IMF lending, exchange rates and other economic and financial indicators. Manuals, guides, and other material on statistical practices at the IMF, in member countries, and of the statistical community at large are also available.

name: International Newsstream (ProQuest)
description: Incorporates the following full text Newsstreams: African, Asian, Australian & New Zealand, European, Latin American and Middle East.

name: International Pharmaceutical Abstracts
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to Ovid . This database can be accessed by no more than 2 users at a time . IPA provides worldwide, comprehensive bibliographic coverage of pharmaceutical science and health related literature. SUBJECTS COVERED: Biopharmaceutics, Drug Therapy, Economics, Education, Ethics as Related to Pharmaceutical Science + Practice and Pharmacy Practice, Information Processing, Legislation, Regulation, Technology, Toxicity, Utilization.

name: International Trade Centre Market Analysis Tools (ITC)
description: UCL's access is limited to the free content. ITC offers a range of online tools to make global trade more transparent and facilitate access to markets. These tools help identify export and import opportunities, compare market-access requirements, monitor national trade performance, and make well informed trade decisions.

name: Internet Archive
description: Non-profit library of millions of free books, movies, software, music, and more.

name: Interwar Culture
description: Showcasing popular and lesser-known periodicals published during the interwar period this database features articles covering culture, entertainment, fashion, home and family life, world current affairs, class, and social and welfare issues. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: IOE Eprints (part of UCL Discovery)
description: Now merged with UCL Discovery. Open access repository that collects the work of IOE researchers and makes it freely available.

name: Ipsos
description: Information about Ipsos, a British market and public opinion research agency. It provides quantitative and qualitative research services, working with clients in both the private and public sectors. Website includes an archive of Ipsos' published research.

name: Irish Newspaper Archives
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Covers Irish newspapers from both North and South of the Irish border dating from 1738 to the present day. This archive contains over 9 million pages of content from 106 publications.

name: Iskusstvo Kino digital archive
description: Digital Archive of Iskusstvo kino, the journal of Russian cinema critics. The journal publishes reviews of contemporary Russian and foreign movies, articles on history and theory of Russian and world cinema as well as general essays on Russian culture and arts.

name: ITER Bibliography
description: Index of literature (books, journal articles, dissertations and book chapters) pertaining to the Middle Ages and Renaissance (400-1700).

name: Itiner-e
description: Open digital dataset of roads in the entire Roman Empire. Itiner-e allows you to view, query and download roads and each road segment has a URI that allows it to be cited and linked by external resources. It also includes a route-finding tool to explore travel itineraries in the ancient world (beta version). Go to the  Tutorials pag e to learn how to use all functions

name: Izvestiia Digital Archive : 1917-
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Among the longest-running Russian newspapers, Izvestiia (Известия, News) was founded in March 1917 and was continuously published for over 100 years J

name: J. Walter Thompson: Advertising America
description: The J. Walter Thompson Company Archive documents the history, operation, policies and accomplishments of one of the world's largest and oldest advertising firms. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Jacoby Online
description: Felix Jacoby's monumental Fragmente der Griechischen Historiker ("fragments" of the Greek historians who are not preserved complete: that is, quotations from their works in other writers). Also includes Brill's New Jacoby, a completely new edition with commentaries in English by contemporary scholars. This new edition also includes facing English translations of the Greek texts, in a fully searchable and indexed online format. Accessibility statement for Brill Scholarly Editions .

name: JDiBrief
description: JDiBrief is an online library of one-page briefing notes about crime and security problems, and analytical techniques that can be applied to understand them better.

name: JET Magazine Archive
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . Covering art, news, politics and other social topics with an African-American focus, this archive includes over 3,100 issues providing a broad view of culture, fashion and entertainment from its first issue in 1951 until 2014.

name: Jewish Life in America c1654-1954
description: Exploring the history of Jewish communities in America from the arrival of the first Jews in the 17th century through to the mid-20th century. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Jewish Studies Portal - Jüdische Studien Portal
description: Portal to access: The Bibliographia Judaica Archive – German Judaism Online; German-Jewish Sources from Palestine / Israel; Klemperer Online; Encyclopedia of Jewish-Christian Relations Online; Encyclopedia of the Bible and Its Reception Online, Singerman Bibliography of Antisemitic Texts in English and Handbuch des Antisemitismus Online

name: JFLIX
description: Video streaming platform dedicated to award winning films on various topics dealing with Judaism and Israel. Films can be browsed within three themes : Science & Technology, Society and Art & History.

name: John Johnson Collection: an archive of printed ephemera
description: Selected digitised items from the John Johnson Collection of Printed Ephemera, offering insights into the changing nature of everyday life in Britain in the eighteenth, nineteenth and early twentieth centuries.

name: Johns Hopkins Guide to Literary Theory and Criticism
description: Guide to literary theory and discourse, including more than 240 entries on critics and theorists, critical schools and movements, and the critical and theoretical innovations of specific countries and historical periods

name: Joint Publications Research Service (JPRS) Reports, 1957-1995
description: This collection features English translations of foreign-language monographs, reports, serials, journal and newspaper articles, and radio and television broadcasts from regions throughout the world. With an emphasis on communist and developing countries, Joint Publications Research Service (JPRS) Reports, 1957-1995, contains a wealth of hard-to-find social science, scientific, and technical materials translated from many languages.

name: Jornal de Debates Digital Archive, 1946-47
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Founded in the aftermath of the Estado Novo dictatorship, the Brazilian newspaper Jornal de Debates is best known for its long-form reporting and commentaries on political, economic, and social issues — such as the nationalization of the oil industry — which defined the history of the Fourth Brazilian Republic.

name: Jorum
description: Jorum contains free open educational resources (OER) shared and created under Creative Commons (CC) licenses by those who teach in or create content for the further and higher education communities in the UK.

name: Journal Citation Reports
description: Quantifiable statistical data that provides a systematic, objective way to evaluate the world's leading journals and their impact and influence in the global research community. Part of Web of Science Journal and Highly Cited Data.

name: JoVE Unlimited
description: UCL users have access to all JoVE content, including over 15,000 videos in 13 sections of the JoVE Video Journal. New subject series and collections are added to the JoVE Science Education Library several times a year.

name: JSTOR
description: Archive of important scholarly journals. Core resource. Accessibility statement for JSTOR . K

name: Kanopy
description: Best streamed on Chrome, Safari, or Edge. Providing video streaming to over 26,000 films including thousands of award-winning documentaries, training films and theatrical releases. The collection includes a number of leading producers, such as the Criterion Collection, PBS, Kino Lorber, New Day Films, The Great Courses, California Newsreel, BBC and hundreds more. Accessibility statement for Kanopy .

name: KCI - Korean Journal Database
description: See the  LibrarySkills@UCL guide to Web of Science . This database covers publications from South Korean journals and researchers, including citation links to and from other Web of Science records. Papers are indexed in both English and Korean.

name: King’s Fund Library
types: Full-text resource; Grey literature; Library catalogue
description: The King’s Fund Database is a source of information on health and social care policy and management including material described as grey literature – research reports produced by trusts, charities and government agencies that are not published in journals. Search the database by keyword or consult the public lists of material on specific topics. The database is updated daily and the lists when new and relevant information pertaining to each topic is released.

name: Klassiki
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. On initial use Sign in with UCL username and create a password to register for a user account. UCL email must be be used to create the account. You will then receive an email asking you to change your password. Subsequent access via Klassiki Stream and explore films from Russia, the Caucasus and Central Asia.

name: Klemperer Online: Tagebücher 1918–1959
description: The complete and unabridged diaries of Victor Klemperer, covering the Weimar Republic, the National Socialist era, and the German Democratic Republic regimes. Accessibility statement for De Gruyter .

name: Kluwer Arbitration
description: Group of fulltext online journals and books related to arbitration. Grouped into Conventions, Legislation, Rules, Case Law, Commentary, Organizations, Countries, BITs, Events and a Newsletter (ITA Monthly Report).

name: Kluwer Competition Law
description: Primary source material, commentary, and analysis on all aspects of EU competition law.

name: Knovel
description: Searchable science and engineering data taken from leading databooks and databases. Please note that content with a padlock icon next to it is unavailable to UCL

name: Knowledge and Library Hub
description: You will be redirected to a webpage where you can select the link for your NHS Trust . Connects NHS staff and students to high quality knowledge and evidence resources in one place. Full access is free using an NHS OpenAthens account .

name: Knowledge@UChicago : Near Eastern Languages and Civilizations
description: Free access to Near Eastern Languages and Civilizations documents, data and media created by the University of Chicago

name: Krokodil Digital Archive : 1922-2008
description: Full run of the satirical magazine Krokodil from 1922-2008

name: Kungliga Biblioteket Sveriges Nationalbibliotek
alternate_names: Royal Library National Library of Sweden
description: Selected digitised works from the National Library of Sweden. Includes collections of examples, complete works and exhibitions. L

name: LABC Type Approval
description: Index of building regulation approval certificates for local authorities in England, Wales and Northern Ireland.

name: Labyrinth
description: Labyrinth provides 25,000 biographies of Russian politicians, officials and business people. Includes descriptions and guides to all federal government bodies, administrative units of the Russian Federation, major businesses, political organizations and federal elections at all levels.

name: Landmap
description: Provides orthorectified satellite image mosaics of Landsat (including Mediterranean), SPOT and ERS radar data and a high resolution Digital Elevation Model for the British Isles.

name: Landolt-Börnstein, SpringerMaterials
description: A comprehensive collection of evaluated data, SpringerMaterials includes the entire Landolt-Börnstein New Series. Accessibility statement for SpringerLink .

name: LandScan 2014 onwards
description: Using Geographic Information System and Remote Sensing, Landscan uses spatial data and imagery analysis technologies and a multi-variable dasymetric modeling approach to disaggregate census counts within an administrative boundary. LandScan population distribution models are tailored to match the data conditions and geographical nature of each individual country and region

name: LandScan, UK data 2010-2013
description: Using Geographic Information System and Remote Sensing, Landscan uses spatial data and imagery analysis technologies and a multi-variable dasymetric modeling approach to disaggregate census counts within an administrative boundary. LandScan population distribution models are tailored to match the data conditions and geographical nature of each individual country and region.

name: Larousse Dictionaries
description: 21 free online dictionaries including a French dictionary and bilingual dictionaries.

name: Late Qing and Republican-Era Chinese Newspapers, 1911-1949
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Following the 1912 establishment of China’s first post-imperial government, the Republic of China, the country experienced both industrial and social revolution, a civil war during which communist and nationalist forces battled to shape the country’s future, and looming external threats during both world wars. This collection of Chinese Newspapers provides invaluable perspective on this critical period. The press of more than twenty cities is represented, spanning the Chinese mainland and the entire half century.

name: Latin America & Iberia Database (ProQuest)
description: Multidisciplinary resource of full-text, scholarly journals published in many Latin American countries, Spain, and Portugal, supporting many subjects, including business, medicine, science, technology, social sciences and humanities

name: Latin America Commons
types: Audio; Full-text resource; Grey literature; Images; Policy documents; Primary Sources; Video streaming
description: Providing centralized full-text access to centuries of Latin American and Latinx primary-source materials, with grey literature including reports, photographs, podcasts, radio broadcasts and videos

name: Latin American Histories in the United States
description: Presenting an extensive documentary record of everyday life, culture, and grassroots activism from the mid-twentieth century onwards. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Latin American Newspapers, Series 1: 1805-1922
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: This database provides more than 50 fully searchable Latin American newspapers published in the 19th and early 20th centuries. Featuring titles from Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Cuba, Guatemala, Mexico, Peru, Venezuela and elsewhere

name: Latin American Newspapers, Series 2: 1822-1922
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: The second series of digitized Latin American Newspapers expands the number of searchable titles available from this region. Providing issues from more than 250 additional titles, this online series includes newspapers published in English, Spanish and Portuguese from 20 countries, including some countries and cities not represented in the inaugural collection of Latin American Newspapers.

name: LatinNews : including LatinNews Daily and Latin American Weekly Report
description: Includes weekly and daily reports . Source of political, economic, and security analysis on Latin America and the Caribbean since 1967. To access via the app, search for LatinNews and login using the username and password .

name: Latino Social and Political Culture and History: Perspectives on the Chicano Movement
description: Cross-search with other Gale/Cengage primary sources in Gale Primary Sources . A collection of primary source documents that illuminates the history of the Chicano Movement and related social and political movements. Accessibility statement for Gale Primary Sources .

name: Law Trove
description: Law Trove contains the content of approx. 200 law textbooks across core and optional modules. Accessibility statement for Law Trove .

name: Le Monde, 1944-2000 : ProQuest Historical Newspapers
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Written in the French language and dating from 1944 to 2000 ProQuest's Le Monde archive covers leading issues and events, such as World War II and the Fifth Republic, French, European and international politics, society and business.

name: Learning Ground - Indigenous Education Research Database
description: With over 9,000 searchable books, articles, conference papers and reports from international publishers, Learning Ground is a gateway to the latest national and international publications focusing on Indigenous education. Contains museum literature.

name: Lecture Notes in Computer Science
description: Series covering new developments in computer science and information technology research and teaching. Accessibility statement for SpringerLink .

name: Legacies of British Slave-ownership
description: Online Encyclopaedia of British Slave-ownership containing information about every slave-owner in the British Caribbean, Mauritius or the Cape at the moment of abolition in 1833.

name: Legal Journals Index (Westlaw UK)
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. Index to every significant legal journal article published since 1986, covering over 800 journals from the UK and Europe.

name: legislation.gov.uk
description: Website managed by The National Archives on behalf of HM Government, publishing most (but not all) types of legislation and their accompanying explanatory documents.

name: Leisure, Travel & Mass Culture: The History of Tourism
description: Guidebooks and brochures, periodicals, travel agency correspondence, photographs and personal travel journals provide unique insight into the expansion, accessibility and affordability of tourism for the masses and the evolution of some of the most successful travel agencies in the world. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Leuven Database of Ancient Books
description: Information about ancient literary texts, dating from the fourth century B.C. to A.D. 800, recording the oldest preserved copy of each text, plus reviews of the text's reception throughout Antiquity.

name: Lexicon Iconographicum Mythologiae Classicae (LIMC)
description: The LIMC presents what is known of the iconography of Greek, Etruscan and Roman mythology as well as of the neighbouring Mediterranean cultures.

name: Lexicon Iconographicum Mythologiae Classicae Image Database
description: Image database of the Lexicon Iconographicum Mythologiae Classicae

name: Lexis+ UK
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. Formerly LexisLibrary. The UK’s largest legal research database, containing unique content such as Halsbury’s Laws of England, Stair Memorial Encyclopaedia and Atkins’s Court Forms, specialist practitioner texts and a collection of enriched Case law. Includes Lexis+ UK International. Accessibility statement for Lexis+ .

name: LGBT Magazine Archive
description: Access to module 1 only. A searchable archive of major periodicals devoted to LGBT+ interests, dating from the 1954 to 2015. Including leading but previously hard-to-find US and UK magazines. Includes the complete backfiles of The Advocate, Gay News and its successor publication Gay Times.

name: LGBT Thought and Culture
description: Featuring books, periodicals, and archival materials documenting LGBT political, social and cultural movements throughout the twentieth century and into the present day. Accessibility statement for LGBT Thought and Culture .

name: LGBTQ+ Source
description: Trial access until 29th July 2025. Offering scholarly and popular LGBTQ+ publications in full text, plus historically important primary sources, including monographs, magazines, newspapers and videos.

name: Liberty Magazine Historical Archive, 1924-1950
description: Cross-search with other Gale/Cengage primary sources in Gale Primary Sources . Founded in 1924 the publishers set out to make Liberty magazine more topical, daring, and exciting than any competitors. Information was presented in a style heavily influenced by the emerging motion picture industry and focused on the most sensational and popular issues.

name: Library & Information Science Abstracts (LISA)
description: This database currently abstracts and Index of journal articles in librarianship and information science, including archives and records management.

name: Library & Information Science Collection
types: Full-text resource; Indexing and abstracting database
alternate_names: Library & Information Science Abstracts (LISA); Library Science Database

name: Library and Information Science Source

name: Library Hub Discover

name: Library Literature & Information Science Retrospective: 1905-1983 (H.W. Wilson)
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . Chronicling nearly 80 years of library scholarship, this archive includes thousands of citations that cover the innovations, controversies and people instrumental in the making of modern librarianship.

name: Library of Congress
description: Information from the largest library in the world, including many online resources such as library catalogues, information for the library profession, sources for American history, legislative sources, and a Global Gateway to internet materials elsewhere.

name: Library Science Database (ProQuest)
description: Full-text of leading library and information science journals. Providing full-text coverage of 125+ core titles included in Library and Information Science Abstracts

name: Library, Information Science & Technology Abstracts
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . LISTA indexes 580 core journals, over 50 priority journals, and nearly 125 selective journals; plus books, research reports and proceedings. Coverage in the database extends back as far as the mid-1960s. Content is also part of Library and Information Science Abstracts (LISA).

name: Libro rojo
description: Access for UCL students and staff only, Username/password required. Access limited to 5 concurrent users. Medical dictionary translating medical terms from English to Spanish (American English & British English)

name: Life at Sea
description: Bringing together unique primary sources drawn from maritime archives and heritage collections Life at Sea takes a sociocultural approach, focusing on the individual experiences and personal narratives of seafarers over three centuries of the Anglo-American maritime world. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: LILACS
description: LILACS is the most important and comprehensive index of scientific and technical health literature of Latin America and the Caribbean. For 26 years contributing to increase visibility, access and quality of health information in the Region.

name: Linguistic Minorities in Europe Online
description: Linguistic Minorities in Europe Online provides comprehensive documentation of indigenous and immigrant linguistic minorities in Europe. Accessibility statement for De Gruyter .

name: Linguistics Abstracts Online
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . Index of articles from linguistics journals. Includes abstracts.

name: Linguistics and Language Behavior Abstracts (LLBA)
description: Index of journal articles covering all aspects of the study of language including phonetics, phonology, morphology, syntax and semantics. Complete coverage is also given to various fields of linguistics including descriptive, historical, comparative, theoretical and geographical linguistics.See Linguistics Database (ProQuest) for full-text of some journals covered.

name: Linguistics Database (ProQuest)
description: Full-text journals and other sources in linguistics, including many titles indexed in Linguistics and Language Behavior Abstracts (LLBA). Covering all aspects of the study of language including phonetics, phonology, morphology, syntax and semantics.

name: LinkedIn Learning (incorporates Lynda.com)
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. LinkedIn Learning incorporates Lynda.com content. Log in with UCL email address to be directed to the UCL username and password sign on screen. This resource offers a huge range of video tutorials supporting learning in software, creative and business skills.

name: Listener Historical Archive, 1929-1991
description: Cross-search with other Gale/Cengage primary sources in Gale Primary Sources . Established by the BBC in 1929, The Listener was the intellectual counterpart to the BBC listings magazine, Radio Times.

name: Literary Encyclopedia
description: Encyclopaedia of topics in global literature, written by practising academics. Includes profiles of authors, works and literary and historical topics.

name: Literary Manuscripts: 17th and 18th Century Poetry from the Brotherton Library, University of Leeds
description: Complete images of 190 manuscripts of seventeenth and eighteenth-century verse held in the celebrated Brotherton Collection at the University of Leeds. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Literary Manuscripts: Victorian Manuscripts from the Henry W. and Albert A. Berg collection of The New York Public Library
description: Victorian Manuscripts from the Henry W. and Albert A. Berg collection of The New York Public Library. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Literary Print Culture: The Stationers' Company Archive
description: Focusing on understanding the workings of the early book trade, the printing and publishing community, the establishment of legal requirements for copyright provisions and the history of bookbinding. Accessibility statement for Literary Print Culture.

name: Literary Studies
description: This collection provides literary manuscripts, rare printed works and personal papers of a range of leading literary figures from Britain and America, as well as access to a goldmine of rare and obscure literary texts and genres. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Literaturnaia Gazeta Digital Archive : 1929-
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: With its focus on literary and intellectual life, Literaturnaia gazeta allowed Soviet Russia’s preeminent authors, poets, and cultural figures a particular podium for commentary, affording perhaps fewer restrictions than might be possible in other publications

name: LiteRom
description: Book reviews on literature in Dutch, published in Dutch and Flemish journals from 1900 to present.

name: Loeb Classical Library
description: The Loeb Classical Library online contains all the volumes in the series of Greek and Latin up-to-date texts with parallel English translations published since 1911. Fully searchable, there will be biannual additions to this virtual library of all that is important in classical literature.

name: London Archives
description: Guide to the largest local authority record office in the UK. Covers archives, modern records, plans, audio-visual and printed materials on London and its people, from 1067 to the present day.

name: London Lives
description: Collection of primary sources about eighteenth-century London (1690-1800), with a particular focus on plebeian Londoners. Includes over 240,000 manuscript and printed pages from eight London archives, supplemented by fifteen other datasets.

name: London Low Life
description: Collection containing rare books, ephemera, maps and other materials relating to 18th, 19th and early 20th century London. Accessibility statement for London Low Life .

name: London's Past Online
description: Now part of Bibliography of British and Irish History. Online bibliography of published material relating to the history of the Greater London area. Covers all periods to the present day.

name: LSEG Workspace (Eikon)
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. Contact the e-resources team to request a licence . Licences are initially for 1 week and may be reassigned after this depending on demand. Access includes SDC Platinum deal-making data add-on, to access SDC data, type SDC in the top search bar

name: LWW Health Library
description: A collection of medical, bioscience and pharmacy textbooks. UCL users can access the Premium Basic Science, Neurology and Integrated Pharmacy modules. Content can be viewed online and a personal account to needed to print, save content to PDF and use the self-assessment tools. M

name: Ma'agarim: Database of the Historical Dictionary of the Hebrew Language
description: A dictionary of around nine million words, drawing upon some 4,300 Hebrew sources from the classic rabbinic period (2nd century BCE) through the geonic period (11th century CE). Updated regularly.

name: Macmillan Cabinet Papers, 1957-1963 (Archives Direct)
alternate_names: Archives Direct: Macmillan Cabinet Papers, 1957-1963 AM Explorer
description: Complete coverage of the Cabinet conclusions (minutes) (CAB 128) and memoranda (CAB 129) of Harold Macmillan’s government, plus selected minutes and memoranda of policy committees (CAB 134). Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Mail on Sunday Historical Archive, 1982-2011
description: Cross-search with other Gale/Cengage primary sources in Gale Primary Sources . Established in 1982, The Mail on Sunday presents detailed reporting and analysis of events in British history from the premiership of Margaret Thatcher to that of David Cameron, and of world events from the Falklands War to international terrorism in the early 21st century . Accessibility statement for Gale Primary Sources .

name: Making of America
description: Digital library of primary sources in US history from the antebellum period through to reconstruction.

name: Making of Modern Law: Legal Treatises, 1800–1926
description: Cross-search with other Gale/Cengage primary sources in Gale Primary Sources . Covering nearly every aspect of American and British law, this archive features casebooks, local practice manuals, form books, works for lay readers, pamphlets, letters, speeches, and other works from the most influential writers and legal thinkers of the time. Accessibility statement for Making of Modern Law: Legal Treatises, 1800–1926 .

name: Making of the Modern World
description: Cross-search with other Gale/Cengage primary sources in Gale Primary Sources . The Making of the Modern World provides digital images of unique primary sources that track the development of the modern, western world through the lens of trade and wealth from the period 1450-1945. Access to all four collections. Accessibility statement for Making of the Modern World .

name: Manar al-Athar
description: This open access photo-archive provides high resolution, searchable images of archaeological sites, buildings and artworks covering the areas of the former Roman Empire which later came under Islamic rule. The chronological range is from Alexander the Great (i.e from about 300 BC) through the Islamic period.

name: Manuscriptorium
description: Freely accessible, Manuscriptorium digital library is the designated platform for the European Digital Library of Written Cultural Heritage. Providing access to more than 5 million images of manuscripts, incunabula, early printed books, maps, deeds, charters and more, up to the year 1800.

name: Market Research & American Business, 1935-1965
description: This collection provides a unique insight into the American consumer boom of the mid-20th century through access to the complete market research reports of Ernest Dichter, the era’s foremost consumer analyst, market research pioneer and widely-recognised ‘father’ of Motivational Research. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Mass Media in Russia, 1908-1918
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Complete runs of the kopeck (penny) newspapers, the most widely circulated newspapers in Russia at the beginning of the twentieth century. Accessibility statement for Brill Primary Sources .

name: Mass Observation Online
description: Featuring, amongst other material, original manuscript and typescript papers from the Mass Observation organisation. The archive was developed to create an 'anthropology of ourselves' and study the everyday lives of ordinary people in Britain. Accessibility statement for Mass Observation Online .

name: Mass Observation Project: 1981-2009
description: UCL users have full access to modules 1-3. Mass Observation Project 1981-2009 provides digital access to a unique life-writing archive, capturing the everyday experiences, thoughts and opinions of people living through the final decades of the 20th century and the advent of the 21st century. Accessibility statement for Mass Observation Project: 1981-2009 .

name: Materials Science Database (Proquest)
types: Full-text resource; Indexing and abstracting database
description: Interdisciplinary full-text and A&I collection focusing on materials and materials-related concepts. Coverage crosses multiple specialties in materials science from engineering, nanoscience, construction and ceramics.   Accessibility statement for ProQuest .

name: Maternity and Infant Care (MIDIRS)
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to Ovid . This database can be accessed by no more than 2 users at a time. Resource for academics and healthcare professionals involved in the care of women and infants. Covers the midwifery profession, pregnancy, labour, birth, postnatal care, and neonatal care and the first year of an infants life.

name: MathSciNet (AMS)
description: Comprehensive database covering the world's mathematical literature since 1940.

name: MediaPlus
types: Audio; Images; Primary Sources; Video streaming
description: A service for UK higher and further education community bringing more than 100,000 videos, images, and sound recordings to your screen.

name: Medical Photographic Library (Wellcome Trust)
description: Collection of over 160 000 pictures (with descriptions) covering the history of medicine and the history of human culture from the earliest periods of civilization to the present day. Images can be purchased in various formats from the Wellcome Library.

name: Medical Services and Warfare
description: Featuring multiple perspectives on the history of injury, treatment and disease on the front line. Sources include hospital records, medical reports and first-hand accounts. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Medici Archive Project
description: Fully searchable database describing hundreds of volumes of documents in the Medici Granducal Archive (Archivio Mediceo del Principato), 1537-1743.

name: MedicinesComplete
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. MedicinesComplete provides immediate online access to up-to-date drug information sourced from an extensive range of the world's most trusted resources.

name: Medieval Family Life
description: Consisting of full-colour images of the original medieval manuscripts that make up these family letter collections, topics covered include trade, warfare, arranging advantageous marriages, arguments between parents and children, matters of inheritance, births and deaths, estate management, legal disputes, domestic finances, women and their role in the family and everyday social and domestic life. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Medieval Travel Writing
description: Presenting manuscripts of some of the most important works of European travel writing from the later medieval period. The chief focus is on journeys to central Asia and the Far East, including accounts of travel to Mongolia, Persia, India, China and South-East Asia. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: MEDLINE (Ovid version)
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to Ovid . Index of journal articles from the National Library of Medicine. Covers medicine, nursing, dentistry, veterinary medicine, the health care system, and the preclinical sciences. Includes EPub Ahead of Print citations.

name: Meiji Japan
description: Featuring the papers of Edward Sylvester Morse (1838-1925), an American polymath notable for his work in natural history, ethnography, archaeology and art history. Morse travelled extensively in Japan in the 1870s, recording his experiences in detail and maintaining a interest in the country and its culture for the remainder of his life. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Merck Index Online
description: Merck Index Online offers the same highly authoritative information as the print edition in a easily searchable full text database. It contains over 11,500 monographs, including historic records not available in the print edition. It is updated regularly with accurate information curated by experts.

name: Merriam Webster Dictionary and Thesaurus
description: English dictionary and thesaurus, available to search through the website of the online version of the Encyclopaedia Britannica.

name: Mexico in History: Colonialism to Revolution
description: Drawing from the world-class Latin Americana Collection at The Bancroft Library, Mexico in History explores over four centuries of Mexico's history, from the beginning of Spanish colonisation c.1500 up to the turbulent years of the Mexican Revolution. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer .

name: Middle East & Africa Database (ProQuest)
description: Ongoing full-text academic journals published in Middle Eastern and African countries. Covering business, science, technology, engineering, social sciences, education, and humanities.

name: Middle Eastern and North African Newspapers, 1870-2021

description: The Middle Eastern and North African Newspapers collection includes publications from across this dynamic region, providing insights into the history of individual countries, as well as broad viewpoints on key historic events from the late nineteenth century until the present

name: Middle English Dictionary
description: Analysis of lexicon and usage for the period 1100-1500. See Dictionary of Old English and Oxford English Dictionary to provide a full description of the vocabulary of English.

name: Migration to New Worlds
description: Explores the movement of peoples from Great Britain, Ireland, mainland Europe and Asia to the New World and Australasia. Focusing on both the personal stories of migrants and the wider context of the history of migration. Accessibility statement for Migration to New Worlds.

name: Military Database (ProQuest)
types: Full-text resource; Indexing and abstracting database
description: Covering topics across all government and military branches, including international relations, political science, criminology, defense, aeronautics and space flight, communications, civil engineering, and more. It includes around 550 titles, with more than 400 available in full-text.

name: Mintel: UK, China and USA Reports, Mintel Trends and Mintel Market Sizes
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. Mintel consumer reports combine exclusive consumer research with trustworthy market data and expert analysis. By tracking trends, analyzing and interpreting consumer behavior, Mintel Trends helps users understand changes in culture, markets and brands. Mintel Market Sizes contains market size, market share and forecast data for thousands of consumer goods categories worldwide.

name: MIRABILE

description: MIRABILE is the knowledge management system for study and research on medieval culture developed by the Societ Internazionale per lo Studio del Medioevo Latino and the Fondazione Ezio Franceschini ONLUS of Florence, in partnership with other institutions.

name: Mirror Historical Archive, 1903-2000
description: Cross-search with other Gale/Cengage primary sources in Gale Primary Sources . The Mirror Historical Archive features more than 800,000 pages of full text searchable, scans of the complete run of the Mirror from 1903-2000, including the Sunday Mirror.

name: MLA Directory of Periodicals
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . MLA Directory of Periodicals provides detailed records for journals and book series published in the MLA International Bibliography’s areas of coverage

name: MLA International Bibliography
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . International database on language, literature, linguistics and folklore.

name: Montana Newspapers
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Access via the Public Access Portal. Free access to over 2.5 million pages from over 150 Montana newspapers dating from 1864-2018

name: Monumenta Germaniae Historica (MGH)
description: Digitised version of the print Monumenta Germaniae Historica, a collection of medieval historical sources for the study of Germany, Austria and Switzerland in the Middle Ages.

name: Moscow News Digital Archive: 1930-2014
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Can also be viewed and cross-searched within East View Global Press Archive . Moscow News was the oldest English-language newspaper in Russia. From a mouthpiece of the Communist party to an advocate for social and political change, it reflected the shifting ideological, political, social and economic currents that swept through the Soviet Union and Russia in the last century.

name: Mother Tongue
alternate_names: Mother Tongue: The Preservation of Jewish Languages and Cultures in memory of Hayyim (Marani) Trabelsy.
description: The “Mother Tongue” project is focusing on preserving Jewish languages ​​and cultures that are at risk of extinction. name: Moudjahid Digital Archive, 1957-1962

description: As the official voice of the National Liberation Front (FLN) during the Algerian War of Independence (1954-1962), El Moudjahid served as a tool for both internal mobilization and international advocacy.

description: Database of critically evaluated phase diagrams and related materials property data for metals, alloys, non-metals, and composites.. Accessibility statement for SpringerLink .

name: Museum Studies Bibliographies

name: Music Database (ProQuest)

description: Previously titled International Index to Music Periodicals (IIMP) Full Text. Providing indexing and abstracts for more than 440 international music periodicals, plus full text for 130 journals from 1874 to the present. N

To this end, they corresponded in writing with all important contemporaries. Accessibility statement for De Gruyter .

name: Narodna Hazeta Digital Archive: 1990-2009
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Can also be viewed and cross-searched within East View Global Press Archive . This Ukrainian-language publication was pro-independence, anti-communist, and provided detailed coverage of the lead-up to the first democratic elections held in the Ukrainian SSR.

name: Nation Archive, 1865-2020
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . Covering 150 years of the Nation Magazine, this archive contains thousands of historic articles, editorials, letters, reviews, poems, and puzzles dating back to the magazine's first issue in 1865.

name: National Archives

Responsible for collecting and making available the records of central government and the courts of law. Covers records from 11th Century onwards.

name: National Archives ARCHON Directory
description: Directory of contact details for record repositories in the United Kingdom and also for institutions elsewhere in the world which have substantial collections of manuscripts noted under the indexes to the National Register of Archives.

name: National Centre for Education Statistics (NCES)
description: The NCES fulfills a Congressional mandate to collect and analyse data relating to education in the US and internationally.

name: National Criminal Justice Reference Service Abstracts
description: The US Department of Justice NCJRS Abstracts Database contains more than 220,000 collection records for US criminal justice, juvenile justice, and substance abuse resources housed in the NCJRS Virtual Library collection. description: Providing comprehensive access to one of the Nigeria's most influential and enduring newspapers. Accessibility statement for Brill Reference Works .

name: New Pauly Supplements Online II & Der Neue Pauly Supplemente II Online
description: Featuring 7 reference volumes for study of the Ancient World and its reception in later centuries, the collection consists of the following titles: Band 8: Historische Gestalten der Antike – Rezeption in Literatur, Kunst und Musik / Volume 7: Figures of Antiquity and their Reception in Art, Literature and Music; Band 9: Renaissance-Humanismus – Lexikon zur Antikerezeption / Volume 8: The Reception of Antiquity in Renaissance Humanism; Band 10: Frühgeschichte der Mittelmeerkulturen – Historisch-archäologisches Handbuch / Volume 9: The Early Mediterranean World, 1200 - 600 BC; Band 11: Byzanz – Historisch-kulturwissenschaftliches Handbuch / Volume 10: History and Culture of Byzantium; Band 12: Militärgeschichte der griechisch-römischen Antike – Lexicon / Volume 11: Greek and Roman Military History; Band 13: Das 18. Jahrhundert – Lexikon zur Antikerezeption in Aufklärung und Klassizismus / Volume 12: The Reception of Antiquity in the Enlightenment; Band 14: Die Germanen und das Römische Reich – Historisch-archäologisches Lexikon / Volume 13: The Germanic Peoples and Ancient Rome . description: Complete back file of The New York Times

name: NewsVault

name: Nineteenth Century Collections Online : Asia and the West
description: Cross-search with other Gale/Cengage primary sources in Gale Primary Sources . Accessibility statement for Nineteenth Century Collections Online.

name: Nineteenth Century Collections Online : Children's Literature and Childhood
description: Cross-search with other Gale/Cengage primary sources in Gale Primary Sources . Providing a wide range of primary sources related to the experience of childhood in the long nineteenth century, the archive includes books, periodicals, newspapers, primers, pamphlets, documents and photos. Accessibility statement for Nineteenth Century Collections Online.

name: Nineteenth Century Collections Online : Europe and Africa, Colonialism and Culture
alternate_names: Europe and Africa, Colonialism and Culture: NCCO
description: Cross-search with other Gale/Cengage primary sources in Gale Primary Sources . Accessibility statement for Nineteenth Century Collections Online.

description: Cross-search with other Gale/Cengage primary sources in Gale Primary Sources . Featuring collections of photographs, photograph albums, photographically illustrated books, and texts on the early history of photography found in libraries and archives across the globe. description: Cross-search with other Gale/Cengage primary sources in Gale Primary Sources . Accessibility statement for Nineteenth Century U.S. Newspapers .

description: Primary source material from archives in the UK, USA and Australia, including prompt books, programmes, company records, photographs and playbills, allow exploration of the multi-faceted nature of the nineteenth-century theatre industry, the lives and careers of well-known actors and actresses and the production, performance and reception of popular plays of the time. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Nixon Years, 1969-1974 (Archives Direct)

Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.
