name: Social Policy and Practice
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to Ovid . This database can be accessed by no more than 4 users at a time. Abstracts of evidence-based social science research for policy-makers, practitioners, educators and students working within economic and social development, social administration, social services, and care management. Incorporates ChildData.

name: Social Science Database (ProQuest)
types: Full-text resource; Indexing and abstracting database
description: Offering over 1000 titles with the majority full-text. This database covers core disciplines across the social sciences including sociology, social work, anthropology, politics and features journals from over 50 countries.

name: Social Sciences Citation Index (part of WoS Core Collection)
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to Web of Science . 2,697 journals across 55 social science disciplines, as well as selected items from 3,500 of the world's leading scientific and technical journals.

name: Social Sciences Index Retrospective: 1907-1983 (H.W. Wilson)
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . Forms part of the Humanities & Social Sciences Index Retrospective: 1907-1984 (H.W. Wilson)

name: Social Sciences: a Quarterly Journal of the Russian Academy of Sciences, Digital Archive: 1970-2022
description: Conceived as a scholarly publication tasked with promoting the Marxist-Leninist approach to social sciences worldwide. Since Gorbachev’s perestroika, however, the periodical’s ideological framework underwent certain modifications becoming a vivid chronicle of the collapse of the old communist dogmas and the transition to new ways of approaching social, economic and historical issues.

name: Social Security Country Profiles (International Social Security Association)
description: The Country Profiles serve as an overview of social security programmes in the Americas, Africa, Asia and the Pacific, and Europe. Scheme descriptions are provided for over 170 countries and territories, and profiles of complementary and private pensions in 50 countries.

name: Social Services Abstracts (SSA)
description: Abstracting and indexing over 1,300+ serials publications, including dissertations and citations to book reviews, this database provides coverage of current research focused on social work, human services and related areas- including social welfare, social policy and community development.

name: Social Theory
description: This database offers an extensive selection of documents that explore the complexities and interpret the nature of social behavior and organization. Particular care has been taken to index this material so that it can be searched more thoroughly than ever before. The current release features more than 150,000 pages of content by major theorists.

name: Socialism on Film: The Cold War and International Propaganda
types: Full-text resource; Primary Sources; Video streaming
description: This collection of films from the communist world reveals war, history, current affairs, culture and society as seen through the socialist lens. It spans most of the twentieth century and covers countries such as the USSR, Vietnam, China, Korea, much of Eastern Europe, the GDR, Britain and Cuba. Accessibility statement for Socialism on Film.

name: Society of American Archivists
description: Information about the Society of American Archivists, North America's oldest and largest national archival professional association.

name: SocINDEX with Full Text
types: Full-text resource; Indexing and abstracting database
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . S ociology research database, which features more than 2.1 million records with subject headings from a 20,000+ term sociological thesaurus designed by subject experts and expert lexicographers. Containing full text for more than 860 journals dating back to 1908, 830 books and monographs, and over 16,800 conference papers.

name: Sociological Abstracts
description: This Indexing and Abstracting database covers the international literature in sociology and related disciplines in the social and behavioral sciences. Pulled from nearly 2,000 serial publications, including journal articles, conference papers, books, dissertations.

name: Sociology Database (ProQuest)
description: Covering the international literature of sociology and social work this collection provides full-text coverage of many core titles indexed in Sociological Abstracts and Social Services Abstracts. Includes hundreds of full text scholarly journals and over 500 recent full-text doctoral dissertations on sociology.

name: Sol and Evelyn Henkind Talmud Text Databank (Saul Lieberman Institute)
description: Also searches Index of References Dealing with Talmudic Literature and Primary Textual Witnesses to Tannaitic Literature

name: South Asian Newspapers, 1850-1992
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Chronicling conflicts as well as contemporary perspectives on independence movements, early statehood, and the extensive economic and social growth taking place in the region during this time. The collection covers several countries, including Bangladesh (formerly East Pakistan), India, Nepal, Pakistan, and Sri Lanka, and features multiple languages such as Bengali, Dari, English and Nepali.

name: South Ossetia Presidential Election, 2011-2012
description: Collection of election related ephemera to date documenting the presidential election process in the breakaway Republic of South Ossetia. It contains hundreds of pages of primary source material collected in South Ossetia and in Ossetian diaspora communities in the Russian Federation.

name: Southeast Asian Newspapers, 1839-1976
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Covering countries including Myanmar (formerly Burma), Indonesia, Philippines, Thailand, and Vietnam, and multiple languages including Dutch, English, French, Javanese, Spanish, and Vietnamese, the Southeast Asian Newspapers collection incorporates a wealth of coverage and perspectives on major regional and global events of the late 19th and 20th centuries.

name: Sovetskaia Kul'tura Digital Archive, 1929-
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Kul'tura (Culture) is an important Russian weekly newspaper. An indispensable source of information on the developing and ever changing attitudes towards arts and culture in the Soviet and Russian societies.

name: Sovetskii Ekran Digital Archive (1925-1998)
description: Published from 1925 to 1998, Sovetskii Ekran (Советский экран, Soviet Screen) was more than just a film journal – it was a cultural barometer of its times, chronicling the evolution of Soviet film against the backdrop of significant societal and political changes

name: Sovetskoe Zdravookhranenie Digital Archive : 1942-1992
description: Established in 1942 by the Ministry of Health of the USSR, the journal Sovetskoe Zdravookhranenie (Soviet Healthcare) was Soviet Union’s premier scientific public health journal covering issues related to public health, social hygiene, health policy, and health education.

name: Soviet Cinema Online - Archival Documents from RGALI 1923-1935
description: Documents from the period 1923-1935 when state monopoly control over the Soviet cinema industry was being established. Accessibility statement for Brill Primary Sources .

name: Soviet Cinema Online: Periodicals and Newspapers, 1918-1942
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Information on domestic and foreign films shown on screens in Russia and the USSR from 1918-1942, including full text of film magazines and newspapers, detailed description of films, reviews by critics and censored materials. Accessibility statement for Brill Primary Sources .

name: Soviet Woman Digital Archive, 1945-1991
description: Soviet Woman was a: “A magazine devoted to social and political problems, literature and art…” It began as a bimonthly illustrated magazine tasked with countering anti-Soviet propaganda by introducing Western audiences to the lifestyle of Soviet women, including their role in the post-WWII rebuilding of the Soviet economy, and their achievements in the arts and the sciences

name: Specify-it
description: Accessible via IHS - select "Specify-it" from the menu. Product and supplier information for building and civil engineering.

name: SPORTDiscus with Full Text
types: E-journal collection; Full-text resource; Indexing and abstracting database
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . This database can be accessed by no more than 8 users at a time. Index of publications covering sport, fitness and related disciplines.

name: Spreading the Word, 1808-1967
description: Comprising of the collections: America in Records from Colonial Missionaries, 1635-1928; Australia in Records from Colonial Missionaries, 1808-1967; 'Bray Schools' in Canada, America and the Bahamas, 1645-1900; Canada in Records from Colonial Missionaries, 1722-1952; Colonial Missionaries' Papers from America and the West Indies, 1701-1870; Colonial Women Missionaries of the Committee for Women's Work, 1861-1967; Ghana in Records from Colonial Missionaries, 1886-1951; Indian and Sri Lankan Records from Colonial Missionaries, 1770-1931; Indigenous Cultures and Christian Conversion in Ghana and Sierra Leone, 1700-1850; Methodist Publications, 1855-1919; The Methodist Recorder, 1861-1919; New Zealand & Polynesian Records from Colonial Missionaries, 1838-1958; South Africa in Records from Colonial Missionaries, 1819-1900; South American Missionaries' Records, 1844-1919; Tanzania and Malawi in Records from Colonial Missionaries, 1857-1965; and Wesleyan and Primitive Methodist Periodicals, 1744-1960

name: Springer Protocols
description: Laboratory protocols in the life and medical sciences. Accessibility statement for SpringerLink .

name: SpringerMaterials
description: SpringerMaterials provides curated data and advanced functionalities to support research in materials science, physics, chemistry, engineering, and other related fields. Accessibility statement for SpringerLink .

name: SpringerMaterials Interactive
description: SpringerMaterials Interactive is a set of advanced functionalities for visualizing and analyzing data. Examples of these functionalities include interactive graphs, dynamic data tables, and side-by- side comparisons of materials/properties. Accessibility statement for SpringerLink.

name: SSRN - Social Science Research Network
description: Social Science Research Network (SSRN) is devoted to the rapid worldwide dissemination of social science research. UCL has access to the Abstract Database.

name: Stalin Digital Archive
types: Full-text resource; Images; Indexing and abstracting database; Primary Sources
description: Compatable with IE9, Firefox and Chrome. A collection of archival and secondary research documents that have previously only been available at the RGASPI archive in Russia

name: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy
description: Online encyclopedia of philosophy, dynamically updated by experts in the field. Can be searched or browsed. Includes an archive of periodically fixed editions for the purpose of citation.

name: State Papers Online
description: Cross-search with other Gale/Cengage primary sources in Gale Primary Sources . Access to: Parts I-II: The Tudors, 1509-1603; Parts III-IV: The Stuarts and Commonwealth, James I - Anne I, 1603-1714; Eighteenth Century, 1714-1782, Parts 1-4; The Stuart and the Cumberland Papers

name: Statista
description: Access for UCL students and staff only . Statista is an online portal for statistics consolidating statistical data on over 80,000 topics from more than 22,500 sources and covering over 170 different industries. UCL users do not have access to the Company database or the Global Consumer Survey. The Research AI assistant can provide useful insights into Statista data, but be aware of the limitations of using generative AI for your academic work.

name: Statistical Abstract of the U.S., 2013-
description: Modeled after the discontinued Census Bureau document this database offers over 1,400 expertly curated tables, with a historical archive from 2013.

name: Statistical Data Warehouse (European Central Bank)
description: The Statistical Data Warehouse (SDW) provides access to a vast quantity of statistical data and metadata available at the ECB, and will be extended to other data in the future. Data in the SDW is organised into datasets, such as BOP, BSI and EXR.

name: StatProb: The Encyclopedia Sponsored by Statistics and Probability Societies
description: Encylopaedia of articles which synthesise existing knowledge on topics in statistics and probability. Users can register to submit articles for consideration by the editors, or to suggest corrections.

name: StoneKeep Atlas: In-Depth Guides to the Castles of Europe
description: 132 guides to castles, châteaux and fortresses across Germany, France, Scotland, Wales and England. All researched from primary sources, asking who built them, what survives today, and how to visit.

name: Structurae: International Database and Gallery of Structures
description: Information on works of structural engineering, architecture or construction, from the Egyptians and Romans to the present day. Structurae deals mostly with bridges, tunnels, dams, skyscrapers, stadiums, towers, etc.

name: Struggles for Freedom: Southern Africa : JSTOR
alternate_names: JSTOR Struggles for Freedom: Southern Africa
description: This resource focuses on the complex and varied liberation struggles in the region, with an emphasis on Botswana, Mozambique, Namibia, South Africa, and Zimbabwe. Accessibility statement for JSTOR

name: Sunday Times Historical Archive, 1822-2021
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Cross-search with other Gale/Cengage primary sources in Gale Primary Sources .  The Sunday Times Historical Archive features two centuries of news, providing the complete run of the newspaper and its supplements, in one platform. Accessibility statement for Gale Primary Sources .

name: Supplementum Epigraphicum Graecum Online
description: Online version of the annual publication Supplementum Epigraphicum Graecum (SEG). SEG collects newly published Greek inscriptions and studies on previously known documents (from archaic Greek texts up to the 8th century A.D.) and presents the complete Greek text and critical apparatus of new inscriptions

name: SUR, 1931-1992
description: Cross-search with other Gale/Cengage primary sources in Gale Primary Sources . Accessed via Archives Unbound, SUR is one of the most influential literary magazines published in Latin America in the twentieth century. This collection includes more than 50,000 pages of images of the complete magazine, including covers, photographs and advertisements.

name: Survey of English Usage
description: Research in English Linguistics, based in the Department of English Language and Literature at UCL. Details and results of current and completed research projects, based on samples of naturally-occurring language, collected for the purposes of description and analysis.

name: Sustainable Views (FT)
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. Username and password required for login, request this via the Contact the E-Resources Team form . Sustainable Views covers information on developments in ESG policy and regulation, the impact of sustainability metrics on capital markets, and the transition to a green and just economy.

name: Svobodné Slovo Digital Archive, 1945-1948
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: The Svobodné Slovo Digital Archive offers a window into the fragile democratic period of post-war Czechoslovakia, from 1945 to 1948 T

name: Teacher Reference Center
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . The Teacher Reference Center provides indexing and abstracts for over 280 of the most popular teacher and administrator trade journals to assist professional educators.

name: Teachers TV from Education in Video
description: Provides access to all 3,530 globally-acclaimed instructional videos produced in 2008 by the United Kingdom's Department of Education to train and develop teachers' skills through demonstrations and commentary by teachers, administrators, and other educational experts

name: Telecommunications Database (ProQuest )
description: Covering the telecommunications industry and its technology, the database includes over 140 titles, with more than 115 available in full text.

name: Telegraph Historical Archive, 1855-2021
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Cross-search with other Gale/Cengage primary sources in Gale Primary Sources . Generally seen as the start of a new era of journalism that emerged following the repeal of stamp duty the Telegraph was directed at a wealthy, well-educated readership and is commonly associated with traditional Toryism despite its more liberal beginnings.

name: Television and Radio Index for Learning and Teaching (TRILT)
description: For full access click on 'Log in' and select UCL from the menu. Database of UK television and radio information. Helps identify both forthcoming and already broadcast audio-visual material to support research and study.

name: Testaments to the Holocaust
description: Cross-search with other Gale/Cengage primary sources in Gale Primary Sources . Documents and rare printed materials from the Wiener Library, London. A collection of eyewitness accounts from the World's oldest Holocaust museum, founded by Alfred Wiener as the "Jewish Central Information Office" in 1939.

name: THE (Times Higher Education)
description: Access for UCL students and staff only, register with your @ucl.ac.uk email for password to allow full access

name: Theatre in Video
description: Streaming video of performances of more than 100 plays and 60 film documentaries, including the BBC Shakespeare Series. When complete, it will include more than 350 plays and documentaries from the 1930s onwards.

name: Thesaurus Linguae Aegyptiae
description: The TLA is an online dictionary for the Ancient Egyptian language, covering lemma from the Old Kingdom through to the Ptolemaic Period, including Demotic. Login as a ‘guest’

name: Thesaurus Linguae Graecae
description: Users must register for an account on first use. Further uses will require logging in with username and password to get full content. Digital library of Greek literature.

name: Thesaurus Linguae Latinae
description: TLL Online is a comprehensive, ongoing scholarly dictionary of ancient Latin from the earliest times through AD 600. The content of TTL online is identical to that of the printed version of the Thesaurus. Each year the contents of the newly printed fascicles will be added to the database. Open-access PDFs are available on the Thesaurus Linguae Latinae's website . Accessibility statement for De Gruyter .

name: Time Magazine Archive
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to EBSCOhost . Collection of the prominent weekly news magazine dating back to its first issue in March 1923 until December 2000, presented in a cover-to-cover format.

name: Times Digital Archive, 1785-2019
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Cross-search with other Gale/Cengage primary sources in Gale Primary Sources . Full text of The Times (London) newspaper from 1785-2019. Full facsimile images of either a specific article or a complete page.

name: Times Educational Supplement Historical Archive, 1910-2000
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Cross-search with other Gale/Cengage primary sources in Gale Primary Sources . The Times Educational Supplement (TES) is one of the most well-regarded primary and secondary education news sources. Founded just before the onset of World War I, TES became the leading publication on public policy and pedagogical practice over the decades, not only in the United Kingdom but worldwide. Accessibility statement for Gale Primary Sources .

name: Times Literary Supplement Historical Archive, 1902-2024
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Cross-search with other Gale/Cengage primary sources in Gale Primary Sources . More than 250,000 reviews, letters, poems and articles in more than 5,000 issues of the TLS are available, and-for the first time-the identities of anonymous contributors are disclosed.

name: Times of India, 1838 - 2011 : ProQuest Historical Newspapers
description: The full content of The Times of India from 1838–2011, including news articles, photos, advertisements, classified ads, obituaries, cartoons, and more

name: Trade Catalogues and the American Home
description: This resource presents highly illustrated primary source documents that highlight commercial tastes and consumer trends in domestic consumerism, life and leisure in America between 1850-1950. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Trade in Early Modern London: Livery Company Records, 1450-1750
description: Trade in Early Modern London brings together court records and financial accounts from some of London's principal livery companies, covering more than 300 years of history. The documents provide insights into the world of early modern London, through the lens of the trade guilds that dominated the economic, social, cultural, and political life of the city. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer .

name: Transatlantic Slave Trade, 1675-1907
description: Comprising of the collections: American Slave Trade Records and Other Papers of the Tarleton Family, 1678-1838; Antigua, Slavery and Emancipation in the Records of a Sugar Plantation, 1689-1907; Scottish Trade with Africa and the West Indies in the Early 18th century, 1694-1709; Slave Trade Records from Liverpool, 1754-1792; Slave Trading Records from William Davenport & Co., 1745-1797; Slavery, Exploitation and Trade in the West Indies, 1759-1832; Slavery in Jamaica, Records from a Family of Slave Owners, 1686-1860; and Slavery Through Time: from Enslavers to Abolitionists, 1675-1865

name: Transformation of Shopping: Department Stores, Social Change and Consumerism 1830 - 1994
description: The Transformation of Shopping brings together collections of primary source material from world-renowned institutions, enabling research into the vibrant sociocultural history of the retail industry with material from over 300 stores. Content is drawn from across the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, trade literature, staff newsletters and photographs. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer .

name: Translated Texts for Historians E-Library
description: The translated Texts for Historians E-Library makes available historical sources from A.D. 300–800 translated into English.

name: Translation Studies Bibliography (TSB)
description: Containing abstracts and summaries of journal articles and other published material and without any national, regional, cultural or thematic limitations TSB is aimed at scholars of translation and intercultural studies, and related disciplines.

name: Transplant Library
description: See the LibrarySkills@UCL guide to Ovid . The Transplant Library is the bibliographic database of the Centre for Evidence in Transplantation (CET). It contains randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and systematic reviews on all aspects of solid organ transplantation. Consisting of over 8,800 references of RCTs published from 1970.

name: TransportXtra (includes RUDI content)
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. Requires UCL users to register onsite or via Desktop@UCL Anywhere on initial use to create a password for a personal account. TransportXtra includes RUDI content. RUDI is concerned with all aspects of urban design, but in particular physical design, within the Western cultural context.

name: Transvaler Digital Archive, 1938-1987
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Die Transvaler (named after Transvaal province, once part of the Boer republics) was established in 1937 as a newspaper that would promote the cause of Afrikaner nationalism within the Afrikaner-dominated National Party.

name: Travel Writing, Spectacle and World History
description: Bringing together hundreds of accounts by women of their travels across the globe from the early nineteenth century to the late twentieth century. Topics include architecture, art, the British Empire, climate, customs, exploration, family life, housing, industry, language, monuments, mountains, natural history, politics and diplomacy, race, religion, science, shopping and war. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Treasury of Linguistic Maps Online
description: Presenting linguistic maps selected from various atlases and other publications that have been published over the years by De Gruyter, De Gruyter Mouton and other De Gruyter imprints. Accessibility statement for De Gruyter .

name: Treatise on Geochemistry
description: Encyclopaedia covering all disciplines and topics in the field of geochemistry.

name: TRIP
description: The TRIP Database is a clinical search engine designed to allow clinicians to quickly find answers to their clinical questions using the best available evidence.

name: Trismegistos
description: Database of metadata of all published and semi-published papyrological and epigraphical texts from Egypt and the Nile valley, between roughly BC 800 and 800 AD.

name: Trove
types: Indexing and abstracting database; Primary Sources
description: To find theses: go to the homepage, type in your search terms and tick the ‘Australian content’ box below the search box. The select the Books zone and choose the ‘theses’ facet on the left-hand side. Change the ‘Sort by’ option to Date (latest first) to view the most recently published theses.

name: Turkey Database (ProQuest)
description: Ongoing full-text academic journals that are locally published in Turkey. Covering business, science, technology, engineering, social sciences, education, and humanities

name: TVTimes Project 1955-1985
description: Searchable database of the programmes listed in television listings magazine TVTimes from September 1955 to March 1985. U

name: U.S. Declassified Documents Online
description: Cross-search with other Gale/Cengage primary sources in Gale Primary Sources . This collection provides access to previously classified federal records spanning the twentieth and twenty-first centuries. Accessibility statement for U.S. Declassified Documents Online.

name: UCAS Course Search
description: Database of all courses offered by UK Higher Education institutions, for the information of potential applicants. Replaces the former printed 'Big Guide' which is no longer produced.

name: UCL Archives
description: Index of archive collections at UCL Special Collections and UCL SSEES. Includes a range of search options for over 8000 descriptions, some to file level, including the archives of George Orwell and Sir Francis Galton.

name: UCL Discovery
description: Open access repository that collects the work of UCL researchers and makes it freely available. Search covers the full-text of the works in the repository.

name: UCL Library Services Card Catalogue
description: Digital version of the card catalogue system for recording items acquired by UCL Library Services until the early 1980s when the computerised catalogue began.

name: UK & Ireland Database (ProQuest)
description: Ongoing full-text academic journals published in the United Kingdom and the Republic of Ireland. Covering business, science, technology, engineering, social sciences, education, and humanities

name: UK Data Archive
description: Website of the UK Data Archive, curator of social sciences and humanities data and partner in the Economic and Social Data Service (ESDS).

name: UK Data Service
types: Data and statistics; Full-text resource; Primary Sources
description: The UK Data Service is a comprehensive resource funded by the ESRC to support researchers, teachers and policymakers who depend on high-quality social and economic data. Registration is required if you wish to download, order or analyse data online, where this is possible. Use your UCL username and password.

name: UK Parliament
description: Official website containing a wealth of information, including the full text of Hansard, bills before parliament, appeals to the House of Lords and their judgments, and an archive of parliamentary publications.

name: UK Parliamentary Papers (ProQuest)
types: Full-text resource; Policy documents; Primary Sources
description: Full text of all papers issued by the House of Commons from 1715-2004 (with supplementary material back to 1688) and House of Lords, 1714-1805. These are the working documents of government for all areas of social, political, economic, and foreign policy. Fully searchable digitized images of original documents. Accessibility statement for UK Parliamentary Papers (ProQuest) .

name: Ukraine Parliamentary Election, 2012 : Election Ephemera Collection
description: Collection of election related ephemera and primary source material documenting the contentious Ukrainian Rada elections of October 28, 2012. It contains over 12,000 pages of unique print materials collected in Kiev, Kharkov, Simferopol, Crimea and elsewhere throughout Ukraine.

name: Ukraine Parliamentary Election, 2014 : Election Ephemera Collection
description: The 2014 snap elections of the Verkhovna Rada marked a new era in Ukrainian politics, arguably the most reformist-minded as well as the most pro-Western since the Ukrainian independence. This database contains important documents and election campaign materials enabling insight into the political thinking that has gained currency in Ukraine in the wake of the Euromaidan revolution.

name: Ukraine Parliamentary Election, 2019 : Election Ephemera Collection
description: The Early Parliamentary Elections took place in Ukraine in July of 2019 amid Ukraine’s ongoing conflict with Russia. They were held not long after the spring presidential elections which shook up the political scene after the victory of Volodymyr Zelensky. This database comprises of leaflets, flyers, brochures and newspapers relating to the campaign.

name: Ukraine Presidential Election, 2014 : Election Ephemera Collecton
description: Collection of presidential ephemera from the May 2014 Early Presidential Election in Ukraine

name: Ukraine Presidential Election, 2019 : Election Ephemera Collection
description: The surprising win by the comedian turned politician Volodymyr Zelensky over the incumbent Petro Poroshenko by a landslide, was hailed as a manifestation of Ukraine’s democratic credentials and a continuation of the democratic logic behind of the 2014 Revolution of Dignity. The first round of elections featured 39 candidates, this database consists of ephemera produced by these candidates during the election season.

name: Ukrainian National Bibliography
description: Comprehensive bibliography of Ukrainian printed works. Content includes citations from books, newspapers, journals, documentary materials, literary criticism and reviews, fine arts, sheet music, dissertations, and cartographic publications.

name: Ulrichsweb
description: Information on virtually every active and ceased periodical (journal), annual, irregular publication, and monographic series published throughout the world, plus thousands of newpapers.

name: UN Comtrade (United Nations Commodity Trade Statistics Database)
description: On first use select ‘Login’ then ‘Sign up now’ with your @ucl.ac.uk email address . UCL users should see My Comtrade Premium when registered. To request the API subscription key, please follow this guide . UN Comtrade contains detailed imports and exports statistics reported by statistical authorities of approx 200 countries or areas. It concerns annual trade data from 1962 to the present.

name: UNdata
description: The United Nations Statistics Division (UNSD) data service brings UN statistical databases within easy reach of users through a single entry point.

name: UNESCO Bangkok: Online Resources for Arts and Culture
description: UNESCO Bangkok has compiled online learning resources about cultural heritage which can be used to raise general awareness, for self-paced learning and as reference materials

name: UNESCO Database of National Cultural Heritage Laws
description: The UNESCO Database of National Cultural Heritage Laws allows free and easy access to cultural heritage laws currently in force as well as a rapid consultation of other relevant national cultural rules and regulation

name: UNESCO Library & Archives
description: Gateway to archival resources, projects and organisations, mainly in the UK, providing descriptions, contact details and web links. The portal can either be searched, or browsed by name, subject category or geographical area.

name: UNESDOC Database
types: Full-text resource; Indexing and abstracting database
description: Contains the full text and bibliographic records of documents and publications published by UNESCO since 1945 and bibliographic records of library acquisitions. Covering all areas of its activities: education, natural sciences, social and human sciences, culture, communication and information.

name: UNICEF Data: Monitoring the Situation of Children and Women
description: UNICEF maintains several databases for tracking the situation of children and women globally. The databases include only statistically sound, nationally representative data from household surveys and other sources. They are updated annually.

name: Union List of Serials (M25)
description: Union catalogue of journal holdings of the constituent libraries of the University of London and the University of Westminster.

name: United Nations Law Collection
description: Exact reproductions of major United Nations legal publications, including the complete collection of the United Nations Treaty Series, the International Court of Justice publications, the League of Nations Treaty Series, the Monthly Statement of Treaties & International Agreements, the United Nations Legislative Series and much more. Finding Aids and additional features make it easy to pull up a UN Treaty by entering a UNTS Citation, search for a UN Treaty, and link to law review articles that cite a UN Treaty.

name: United Nations Treaty Collection
description: A collection of full-text databases containing treaties deposited with the United Nations.

name: United States pharmacopeia: the national formulary (USP-NF)
description: Access for UCL students and staff only . To access USP-NF you will first need to register for an account using your UCL email address and create a password . You will receive an email to activate your account. Once you have done this, you will be able to use it to login to the USP-NF both on and off campus. If you cease to be a member of staff or current student at UCL, your account will be deleted . Book of public pharmacopeial standards for chemical and biological drug substances, dosage forms, compounded preparations, excipients, medical devices, and dietary supplements. Monographs for drug substances, dosage forms, and compounded preparations are featured in the USP. Monographs for dietary supplements and ingredients appear in a separate section of the USP. Excipient monographs are in the NF.

name: University of London Research Library Services
description: Combined library catalogue of Senate House Library and the libraries of the Institutes of the School of Advanced Study.

name: US Newsstream (ProQuest)
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: US Newsstream enables users to search the most recent premium U.S. news content, as well as archives which stretch back into the 1980s featuring top newspapers, newswires, blogs, and news sites in active full-text format

name: USDA National Agricultural Library
description: Previously known as AGRICOLA . Providing a simple, one-stop access to more than 8 million records covering all aspects of agriculture and related disciplines. Search Everything for results from the Catalog and Articles database (AGRICOLA), PubAg, and the NAL Digital Collections (NALDC). Or you can limit your search to PubAg by selecting it at the top of the advanced search form.

name: USPTO Patent Database
description: The database includes information about all US patents (including utility, design, reissue, plant patents and SIR documents) from the first patent issued in 1790 to the most recent issue week. V

name: VADS : Visual Arts Database
description: VADS provides a national collection of over 140,000 images from over 300 art and design collections across the UK. The images cover the broad range of the visual arts including applied arts, architecture, design, fashion, fine art, and media

name: Vestnik Evropy Digital Archive : 1802-1830
description: One of the first literary and political journals in Russia

name: Victorian Popular Culture
description: Focused on popular entertainment in the 19th and early 20th centuries, it is divided into 4 sections: Spiritualism, Sensation and Magic; Circuses, Sideshows and Freaks; Music Hall, Theatre and Popular Entertainment; Moving Pictures, Optical Entertainments and the Advent of Cinema. Accessibility statement for Victorian Popular Culture.

name: Victorians on Film
description: Featuring the British Film Institute’s Victorian Film Collection and the Mitchell and Kenyon Collection, Victorians on Film provides a glimpse into the lives of the late Victorians and Edwardians captured by some of Britain’s earliest film pioneers and innovators. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Video Data Bank (VDB) Streaming
description: Offering access to a collection of video art and experimental moving image work by and about contemporary artists. The VDB’s collection includes the work of more than 600 artists and 6,000 video art titles.

name: Virginia Company Archives
description: This resource documents the founding and economic development of Virginia as seen through the papers of the Virginia Company of London, 1606-1624. It includes the complete Ferrar Papers. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Visible Body Human Anatomy Atlas 2020
description: Visible Body is a 3D interactive anatomy visualization and education tool. The Human Anatomy Atlas modules includes all body systems, gross anatomy, and select microanatomy

name: vLex Justis
types: Full-text resource; Indexing and abstracting database
description: In addition to the full text of all UK Acts as enacted from 1235 to the present day, vLex Justis also contains the largest collection of transcripts of UK court judgments available online, dating back to 1852. Importantly, it also features an integrated legal index and citator, providing links to the full text of case reports and consolidated versions of legislation in other databases, including Lexis+ UK and Westlaw UK.. Please see the user guide

name: Vogue Archive
description: A complete searchable archive of American Vogue, from the first issue in 1892 to the current month, reproduced in high-resolution color page images.

name: Voprosy Istorii Digital Archive : 1926-
description: The oldest Soviet and Russian academic history journal, Voprosy istorii (“Issues of History”) has offered scholarly perspectives on events in Russia and the world since 1926

name: Voprosy Literatury Digital Archive : 1957-
description: The most authoritative journal of literary criticism for more than half a century. It offers articles, essays and roundtable transcripts dealing with problems of Russian and world literature, history and theory of literature. W

name: Web of Science
alternate_names: WOS Core Collection Web of Knowledge
description: See the  LibrarySkills@UCL guide to Web of Science . Defaults to Web of Science Core Collection, which searches citation indexes containing details of scholarly journal articles, conference proceedings and selected book chapters from all academic disciplines; select 'All Databases' option from the drop down menu to cross-search all UCL's subscribed Web of Science products, including Biosis.

name: Weimar and Nazi Germany : History Commons
description: Documenting an intense time of hyperinflation, political extremism, and seizures of power this collection details the aftermath of World War I, recovery following the war, the Great Depression, and Hitler’s rise, providing contemporaneous accounts, documents, reports, and correspondence of how Western democracies struggled with fascism and autocracy.

name: Wellesley Index to Victorian Periodicals, 1824-1900
alternate_names: The Wellesley Index to Victorian Periodicals
description: Wellesley assists scholars in assessing the significance of Victorian periodical articles by delivering accurate information on their provenance. Wellesley is an index to the authorship of articles, and a bibliography of articles written by each contributor, using each pseudonym.

name: Westlaw UK
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. Links to Westlaw International and Westlaw US have now been added to the 'Browse by Topic' menu . Users need to register with their name and UCL email address on initial login. Information will be processed by Westlaw in accordance with their privacy policy . Primary/secondary law and current awareness service for UK legal, regulatory and academic markets.

name: WHO COVID-19 Database
description: This free database gathers the latest international multilingual scientific findings and knowledge on COVID-19, including preprints and ongoing clinical trials.

name: Who's Who and Who Was Who
description: Biographical information on more than 30,000 living people of influence and interest in all fields, from all parts of the world. Also includes over 100,000 entries from the archives of Whos Who dating back to 1898.

name: WIPO Lex
types: Full-text resource; Indexing and abstracting database
description: WIPO Lex is a one-stop search facility for national laws and treaties on intellectual property (IP) of WIPO, WTO and UN Members.It also features related information which elaborates, analyzes and interprets these laws and treaties.

name: Witchcraft and Magic in England, c. 1400–1920
description: Bringing together over 57,000 images, this unique collection charts the evolution of witchcraft and magic in England over five centuries. It comprises documents sourced from The National Archives (UK), British Library, University College London Special Collections, and The Folklore Society. Librarian Review Hide Librarian Review Part of POA EBA (although there would be a large discount as UCL content)

name: Women in The National Archives (Archives Direct)
alternate_names: Archives Direct: Women in The National Archives AM Explorer
description: This collection consists of two distinct elements. First as a finding aid to women's studies resources in The National Archives, and second to provide original documents on the suffrage question in Britain, the Empire and colonial territories. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Women's Magazine Archive, 1846-2005
description: Access to collection 3 only.  Primary sources to facilitate the examination of the events, trends, and attitudes of the late-19th century through to 2005. Among the research fields served by this material are gender studies, social history, economics/marketing, media, fashion, politics, and popular culture. Collection 3 offers an international perspectives with five major UK plus one Canadian lifestyle and fashion titles including the UK editions of premier titles – Good Housekeeping and Cosmopolitan – among other major brands originating in the UK (Prima, She, Company) and Canada (Flare). Accessibility statement for Women's Magazine Archive, 1846-2005 .

name: Women's Studies
description: Offering a breadth of printed and manuscript sources and providing a multitude of perspectives on the changing roles of women in history. This collection includes the works and legacy of many notable and influential women, but also a chance to hear the voices of forgotten and ordinary women. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: Women's Voices and Life Writing, 1600-1968
description: Women’s Voices and Life Writing, 1600-1968 brings together diaries and oral histories for the study of the lives and experiences of less well-known women, told through their own words. Featuring content from both regional and national archives across the UK and Ireland, users can explore the life course of hundreds of individuals from a diverse range of backgrounds. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer .

name: Women’s Studies Archive: Issues and Identities
description: Cross-search with other Gale/Cengage primary sources in Gale Primary Sources . Providing an opportunity to witness history from the female perspective. Offering coverage of the nineteenth and twentieth centuries. Accessibility statement for Gale Primary Sources

name: World Bank
description: Website of the World Bank, a multilateral lending agency of 184 member countries, which provides financial and technical assistance to developing countries. Composed of two agencies, the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) and the International Development Association (IDA).

name: World Bank Documents and Reports
description: Repository of World Bank Group’s final and official documents and reports from 1946 to the present

name: World Bank Open Data
description: Statistics on development in countries around the globe, collated by the World Bank. Consists of a number of datasets including development indicators, debt statistics and trade logistics statistics. Openly available.

name: World Bank Open Knowledge Repository (OKR)
description: The World Bank’s official open access repository for its research outputs and knowledge products.

name: World Cinema Collection : Films on Demand
description: Streaming films from Africa, America, Asia, Europe, Latin America and the Middle East, from the silent era, the mid-20th century, as well as award-winning contemporary works.

name: World Events and the Media
types: Audio; Full-text resource; Primary Sources; Video streaming
description: This collection explores various practices in journalism: from investigative journalism to crisis and war reporting, to the impact of technological advancements on the media. This multimedia resource covers approaches to journalism that draw upon first-hand accounts, memoirs, historical accounts, videos and archival records . Accessibility statement for Alexander Street.

name: World Heritage Sites: Africa : JSTOR
description: This resource links visual, contextual, and spatial documentation of African heritage sites.  Accessibility statement for JSTOR .

name: World News Connection
description: News from around the world, translated into English, typically within 24-72 hours from the time of the original publication or broadcast.

name: World News in Indian Newspapers, 1782-1908
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: This collection contains copies of three English language newspapers published in India during the period 1782-1908: The India Gazette (1782-1834); The Bengal Hurkaru and Chronicle (1822-1866); and The Bengal Times (1876-1908

name: World of Children - Artek Pioneer Camp Archives, 1944-1967
description: Containing government documents on Soviet social and health policies, administrative, medical and financial records, transcripts of meetings, materials on educational and ideological work carried out in the camp statistical reports, food rations and provision standards, letters from Soviet and foreign children, diaries etc. Accessibility statement for Brill Primary Sources .

name: World Shakespeare Bibliography
description: Provides annotated entries for all important books, articles, book reviews, dissertations, theatrical productions, reviews of productions, audiovisual materials, electronic media, and other scholarly and popular materials related to Shakespeare and published or produced between 1960 and 2016.

name: World Treaty Library (HeinOnline)
types: Full-text resource; Indexing and abstracting database
description: Indexes to treaties and many full text treaties, bibliographies and scholarly articles. Worldwide coverage. Accessibility statement for World Treaty Library (HeinOnline) .

name: World Wars: Firepower & Fascism at Home & Abroad, 1863-1974
description: Comprising of the collections: British Diplomacy from the Unification of Germany to the Spanish Civil War, 1863-1939; Censorship: Policy and Practice During the Second World War; Conscientious Objection During World War 1; Life on the Front Line: Diaries, News, and Letters from the First World War, 1914-1919; Life under Nazi Rule: Reports by Anti-Fascists in Occupied Europe, 1933-1945; Military Intelligence Files: Land, Sea & Air, 1938-1974; Military Tactics and the Rise of Modern Warfare, 1881-1935; Paris Peace Conference and Beyond, 1919-1939; Prosecuting the Holocaust: British Investigations into Nazi Crimes, 1944-1949; Secrecy, Sabotage, and Aiding the Resistance: How Anglo-American Cooperation Shaped World War II; and ‘Thou Shalt Not Kill’: Missionaries in Asia during the World Wars, 1914-1946

name: World's Fairs
description: Focusing on the World's Fairs from Crystal Palace in 1851 and the proliferation of North American exhibitions, to fairs around the world and twenty-first century expos. This database contains official records, monographs, publicity, artwork and artifacts. Accessibility statement for Adam Matthew Explorer.

name: WorldCat.org
description: Freely-available union catalogue of thousands of libraries worldwide (US-based).

name: WorldLII
description: WorldLII provides a single search facility for databases from Legal Information Institutes: AustLII; BAILII; CanLII; HKLII; LII (Cornell); and PacLII. It also includes databases of decisions of international Courts and Tribunals, databases from several Asian countries and South Africa.

name: WorldTradeLaw.net Dispute Settlement Commentary Service
description: Legal research tool for World Trade Organisation (WTO) dispute settlement. Provides summary and critical analysis of all new WTO Panel and Appellate Body reports within 1-3 weeks after they are circulated to the WTO Members.

name: Worldwide Political Science Abstracts (WPSA)
description: Indexing and abstracting over 1,500 serials, books and working papers. WPSA covers the international literature of political science and international relations, along with complementary fields including international law and public administration/policy.

name: WRDS (Wharton Research Data Services)
description: Access for UCL students and staff only. Includes Compustat, CRSP, FactSet Revere Relationship and Orbis data. Revelio Lab individual profile data is included until August 2027. Access is via a WRDS account: select the Register tab, complete the Account Request form to create a username and password and wait for a confirmation access email (this can take a few days). Y

name: Yahoo Image Search
description: Search for images on the Web. Part of the Yahoo! web search engine.

name: Yearbook of the Imperial Theaters
description: Journal collection covering the late Imperial stage in Russia, 1890-1915. Accessibility statement for Brill Primary Sources .

name: Yiddish Dictionary
description: A comprehensive Yiddish-English Dictionary with a broad coverage of Yiddish words of all origins: Hebrew-Aramaic, Slavic, Romance as well as Germanic. Z

name: Za Vil’nu Ukrainu Digital Archive: 1990-2007
types: Full-text resource; News and newspapers; Primary Sources
description: Can also be viewed and cross-searched within East View Global Press Archive . Ukrainian-language newspaper Za Vil’nu Ukrainu (За Вільну Україну, For a Free Ukraine) was founded in July 1990 as an outlet of the Regional Council of Workers' Deputies with the purpose of uniting national-patriotic forces and Ukrainian ideals.

name: Zetoc
description: Index of approximately 20,000 current journals and 16,000 conference proceedings published per year, across all subject areas (science, technology, medicine, engineering, business, law, finance, the arts and humanities).

name: Zoological Record
types: Indexing and abstracting database; Reference works
description: Zoological Record is the world's oldest continuing database of animal biology. It is considered the world's leading taxonomic reference and has long acted as the world's unofficial register of animal names. The broad scope of coverage ranges from biodiversity and the environment to taxonomy and veterinary sciences. #
